AI.research_question: 如何将量子维度整合到SBME（sense building mechanics engineering）理论中，以扩展生成创新AI（GIAI）的理论框架？
AI.motivation: SBME研究领域通过生成量子系统（GQS）模型意外地以指数方式扩展，需要将量子维度整合到现有理论中，而不是简单地将其作为另一个独立模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: SBME（sense building mechanics engineering）理论框架，生成创新AI（GIAI）理论，生成量子系统（GQS）模型
AI.method: 理论扩展与整合方法，将量子维度系统地融入现有SBME理论框架
AI.findings: 成功将量子维度整合到SBME理论中，形成了更完整的生成创新AI理论体系
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了SBME理论框架，将量子计算概念整合到生成创新AI理论中，提供了更全面的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程实践提供了包含量子维度的创新AI设计框架，可能推动量子计算在创新工程中的应用

title: Sterlite Copper Plant Case (Thoothukudi): A Case Study on Environmental Justice
affiliations: Kurukshetra University

detail.title: Sterlite Copper Plant Case (Thoothukudi): A Case Study on Environmental Justice
detail.abstract: The Sterlite Copper Plant of Vedanta Group, located in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu was opposed by the local people from day one due to possible environmental and health issues. The local people expressed their concerns against the plant to various relevant authorities. In 2013, the National Green Tribunal shut the plant for two weeks on the ground of gas leakage. But the local communities and NGOs wanted to shut it permanently. As authorities were failed to resolve the matter, the locals had no choice except to give a call for hunger strike to compel the government to take the strict action against the plant. Despite numerous complaints and over hundred days of protest, the government responded on May 22, 2018 not with the dialogue but with bullets, which took the life of 13 people and several were injured. Six days later, the Tamil Nadu government shut down the plant. This research paper critically analyses the Sterlite case and compares it with other cases of industrial disasters. Paper also discusses the role of media in this regard.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析印度韦丹塔集团Sterlite铜厂的环境冲突事件，探讨了工业污染、社区抗争和政府应对之间的关系，并比较了其他工业灾难案例。
AI.research_question: Sterlite铜厂环境冲突事件中，企业、政府、社区和媒体各自扮演了什么角色？此类工业环境冲突的解决机制存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 2018年印度泰米尔纳德邦Sterlite铜厂抗议活动中发生的暴力冲突导致13人死亡，这一事件凸显了工业发展与环境安全、社区权益之间的深刻矛盾，需要系统分析其成因和教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境正义理论、利益相关者理论、社会运动理论、危机管理理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过对Sterlite铜厂事件的详细梳理，并与其他工业灾难案例进行对比分析
AI.findings: 1.当地社区从项目初期就持续反对，但诉求未得到有效回应；2.政府监管失效，最终以暴力手段应对和平抗议；3.媒体在事件中发挥了双重作用；4.此类环境冲突暴露了印度工业监管体系的系统性缺陷
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家环境正义研究，提供了工业环境冲突中多方博弈的理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定工业环境政策、企业履行社会责任、社区维权运动提供实践参考，促进工业发展与环境保护的平衡

title: Dust on the Lungs, Scars on the Soul Ethnographic Perspectives on Pneumoconiosis in China
affiliations: Independent and University of Chicago

detail.title: Dust on the Lungs, Scars on the Soul Ethnographic Perspectives on Pneumoconiosis in China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a narrative ethnography of China's pneumoconiosis crisis, focusing on migrant workers who developed dust lung disease during the country's rapid industrialization. Drawing on surveys, interviews, and case materials collected between 2014 and 2024, we show how occupational illness functions as a form of structural violence: an embodied cost of economic growth disproportionately borne by rural laborers. Through life histories of first-generation construction workers, a younger cohort of "post-90s" artificial stone cutters, and the families caring for them in so-called "dust villages," we reveal how illness, poverty, and stigma intersect to reproduce social marginality. The analysis is framed by Whyte's insights on community networks, Wacquant's theory of advanced marginality, Klinenberg's concept of disaster neglect, and Sontag's critique of illness metaphors. International comparisons with Australia, the United States, and Europe situate China within a global resurgence of dust-related diseases. We conclude by discussing policy implications and advocating for stronger occupational protections to prevent future generations from being left in the dust.

AI.tldr: 本文通过叙事民族志研究中国尘肺病危机，揭示职业病作为结构性暴力的本质，展现经济增长背后农村劳工承担的不成比例的健康代价。
AI.research_question: 中国尘肺病危机如何作为结构性暴力形式运作，以及职业病、贫困和污名如何交织再产生社会边缘性？
AI.motivation: 研究中国快速工业化过程中农民工罹患尘肺病的危机，揭示经济增长背后隐藏的人力成本和社会不公。
AI.theoretical_framework: Whyte的社区网络理论、Wacquant的先进边缘性理论、Klinenberg的灾难忽视概念、Sontag的疾病隐喻批判
AI.method: 叙事民族志方法，基于2014-2024年收集的调查、访谈和案例材料
AI.findings: 尘肺病作为结构性暴力形式，是经济增长的具体化成本，主要由农村劳动力承担；疾病、贫困和污名相互交织，再生产社会边缘性
AI.theory_contributions: 将尘肺病危机理论化为结构性暴力，整合多理论框架分析职业病的多重社会维度
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定更强有力的职业保护政策提供依据，防止未来世代继续遭受尘肺病危害，具有国际比较的政策启示

title: Contrarian Motives in Social Learning: Information Cascades with Nonconformist Preferences
affiliations: and National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) - International College of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Contrarian Motives in Social Learning: Information Cascades with Nonconformist Preferences
detail.abstract: We embed a taste for nonconformity into a canonical Bikhchandani-Hirshleifer-Welch sociallearning model. Agents value both correctness and choosing the minority action (fixed or proportion-based bonus). We study exogenous signals and endogenous acquisition with a fixed entry cost and convex cost of precision in a Gaussian-quadratic specification. Contrarian motives shift equilibrium cutoffs away from one-half and expand the belief region where information is purchased, sustaining informative actions; conditional on investing, chosen precision is lower near central beliefs. Welfare is shaped by a trade-off: mild contrarianism counteracts premature herding, whereas strong contrarianism steers actions against informative social signals and induces low-value experimentation. A tractable characterization delivers closed-form cutoffs, comparative statics, and transparent welfare comparisons. Applications include scientific priority races and academic diffusion, where distinctiveness yields rents yet excessive contrarianism erodes information aggregation.

AI.tldr: 本文在经典社会学习模型中引入非从众偏好，研究了个体既追求正确性又偏好少数派行为的决策模式。通过高斯-二次规范分析，发现适度的非从众动机可以防止过早从众，但过强的非从众会导致低价值实验并削弱信息聚合。
AI.research_question: 当个体同时重视正确性和选择少数派行为时，非从众偏好如何影响社会学习过程中的信息获取、行动选择和福利？
AI.motivation: 传统社会学习模型假设个体只关注正确性，但现实中人们往往也重视独特性。在科学优先权竞争和学术传播等场景中，独特性能带来额外收益，但过度非从众可能损害信息聚合效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bikhchandani-Hirshleifer-Welch社会学习模型，引入非从众偏好（固定或比例奖励），采用高斯-二次规范设定。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，包含外生信号和内生信息获取（固定进入成本和凸精度成本），推导闭式截止点和比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 1) 非从众动机使均衡截止点偏离1/2；2) 扩大信息购买的信令区域，维持信息性行动；3) 适度非从众抵消过早从众，强非从众导致低价值实验；4) 投资时中心信念附近的精度选择较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将非从众偏好纳入社会学习理论框架；2) 提供非从众社会学习的闭式解和比较静态；3) 揭示非从众与信息聚合的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为科学优先权竞争提供理论解释；2) 指导学术传播中的独特性与正确性平衡；3) 帮助理解现实决策中非从众行为的影响。

title: Mission-Driven Learning Theory: Ordering Knowledge and Competence to Life Mission
affiliations: Open Christian University and Open Christian University

detail.title: Mission-Driven Learning Theory: Ordering Knowledge and Competence to Life Mission

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve the collection of any primary data on human participants, animals, or sensitive materials; therefore, formal ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work. All research activities and associated costs were covered by the authors’ own resources and institutional effort.

detail.abstract: Background: Prevailing learning theories refine the means of education-behaviour, cognition, construction, connection, competence, yet leave its end (telos) to chance, producing graduates skilled but mission-adrift. Purpose: This paper advances Mission-Driven Learning Theory (MDLT), a teleological framework that realigns knowledge and competence with a discerned life mission under God, thereby restoring purpose to the centre of educational design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了使命驱动学习理论（MDLT），这是一个目的论框架，旨在将知识和能力与在上帝指引下的明确人生使命重新对齐，从而将目标重新置于教育设计的中心位置。
AI.research_question: 如何将教育的目的（telos）从偶然性转变为明确的使命导向，以解决毕业生虽有技能但缺乏使命方向的问题？
AI.motivation: 主流学习理论（行为主义、认知主义、建构主义、连接主义、能力主义）虽然改进了教育的手段，但却让教育的目的（telos）听任偶然，导致毕业生虽有技能但缺乏使命方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使命驱动学习理论（MDLT），这是一个目的论（teleological）框架，基于在上帝指引下的明确人生使命。
AI.method: 理论构建和框架提出，通过整合现有学习理论并引入目的论维度。
AI.findings: MDLT能够将知识和能力与人生使命重新对齐，从而恢复教育设计中的目的性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的目的论学习理论框架，填补了现有学习理论在目的性方面的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育设计提供了以使命为中心的新范式，帮助教育机构培养既有技能又有明确使命方向的毕业生。

title: Meta Dynamic Pricing with Nonparametric Empirical Bayes
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and

detail.title: Meta Dynamic Pricing with Nonparametric Empirical Bayes
detail.abstract: Modern e-commerce firms often need to make real-time pricing decisions for a large catalog of products, where many "long-tail" items receive only sparse customer interactions or sales. This creates a fundamental challenge: with limited data available at the individual product level, accurately estimating demand curves and setting effective prices becomes particularly difficult at scale. To address this challenge, we introduce a nonparametric empirical Bayes (NPEB) framework for multi-product online pricing that learns shared demand structure across a product catalog and dynamically adapts pricing over time. Specifically, we propose a cycle-based online pricing algorithm that alternates between exploration and exploitation phases. During the exploration phase, the algorithm aggregates meta-level data to extract meta insights that enhance demand estimation, thereby effectively pooling and transferring information throughout the entire product catalog. During the exploitation phase, the algorithm integrates this shared meta information and individual product data to guide pricing decisions. Our theoretical analysis shows that the algorithm achieves sublinear regret over time and only polylogarithmic dependence on the number of products, without requiring any parametric assumptions on the underlying meta structure. Empirically, across both synthetic data and a real-world loan pricing application, our method consistently outperforms benchmarks that either impose specific parametric modeling assumptions or treat products independently. Together, these results highlight NPEB as a flexible, robust approach to real-time pricing in large-scale, data-scarce product catalogs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个非参数经验贝叶斯框架，用于解决电商平台中长尾产品的实时定价问题。该框架通过在产品目录中学习共享需求结构，并交替进行探索和利用阶段，有效解决了数据稀疏情况下的定价难题。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据稀疏的长尾产品环境中，实现有效的实时定价决策？
AI.motivation: 现代电商平台面临大量长尾产品，这些产品客户互动和销售数据稀疏，导致在个体产品层面准确估计需求曲线和设置有效价格变得困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数经验贝叶斯（NPEB）框架，结合元学习和在线学习理论。
AI.method: 基于循环的在线定价算法，交替进行探索阶段（聚合元数据提取元洞察）和利用阶段（整合共享元信息和个体产品数据指导定价）。
AI.findings: 算法实现了随时间变化的次线性遗憾，并且对产品数量的依赖仅为多对数级别，无需对底层元结构做任何参数假设。在合成数据和实际贷款定价应用中均优于基准方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个无需参数假设的灵活定价框架，理论上证明了算法的收敛性和有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模、数据稀缺的产品目录提供了灵活、稳健的实时定价方法，可应用于电商平台和金融服务等领域。

title: The Cinematic Influence: Human-AI Relationships and Crafting Organizational Governance Pathways
affiliations: Drexel University, Saint Joseph's University and New Jersey Institute of Technology

detail.title: The Cinematic Influence: Human-AI Relationships and Crafting Organizational Governance Pathways
detail.abstract: We delved into how AI and humans interact in workplace settings as depicted in movies. We examined the scripts of thirteen movies to uncover the roles, relationships and themes portrayed in these interactions. The findings highlighted that humans and AI have the potential to mutually influence and transform one another not only in these fictional settings, but also in workplaces. We drew broader insights into the roles AI might play and the nature of relationships between humans and AI in the workplace. Additionally, we identified prominent themes within these cinematic portrayals. Importantly, the outcomes suggested that these movies offered valuable perspectives to executives and employees seeking to establish governance systems for AI that align with human values and organizational objectives. Our analysis of these movies provided pathways for responsibly understanding and managing AI systems in the workplace, as an aid in shaping human interactions with intelligent AI.

AI.tldr: 通过分析13部电影中AI与人类在工作场所的互动，研究发现双方具有相互影响和转化的潜力，为建立符合人类价值观的AI治理系统提供了宝贵见解。
AI.research_question: 电影中描绘的AI与人类在工作场所的互动角色、关系和主题是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索虚构作品中AI与人类互动对现实工作场所AI治理的启示价值
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于影视叙事分析的理论框架，探讨人机交互的社会建构意义
AI.method: 对13部电影的剧本进行内容分析，识别角色、关系和主题模式
AI.findings: 人类与AI具有相互影响和转化的潜力；电影提供了AI角色定位和人机关系性质的深刻见解；识别了突出的主题模式
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了人机交互理论，提供了基于影视叙事的分析视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和员工建立符合人类价值观的AI治理系统提供实践指导；为负责任地理解和管理工作场所AI系统提供路径

title: Regulating corporate social responsibility in energy and extractive industries: The case of international oil companies in a developing country
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University and Hamad Bin Khalifa University

detail.title: Regulating corporate social responsibility in energy and extractive industries: The case of international oil companies in a developing country
detail.abstract: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) of business enterprises to reduce and redress the adverse impacts of their operations on the environment and local communities is a controversial topic, especially in developing countries. Drawing lessons from the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (KRI), this article aims to know the role of laws and regulations at the local level in promoting the practice of CSR in energy and extractive industries. The research also seeks to know to what extent International Oil Companies (IOCs) have considered social and environmental problems in the communities where they operate. To achieve these aims, an online survey questionnaire was conducted with major IOCs in the Kurdistan region to know their perspectives on CSR and the scope and extent of their legal obligations in this regard. Then, we analysed annual reports, social responsibility reports, and other publicly available documents to support our arguments and investigate the issue deeply. The article found that while there are broad legal provisions relating to CSR with respect to social and environmental protection, enforcement of such legal requirements remains the main challenge in adapting CSR in developing countries, including the KRI. The results revealed that CSR had been used as a mask by the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) to convince the public, opposition parties, and the federal government regarding the transparency and legitimacy of KRG's oil and gas policy in the region. On the other hand, the IOCs highlighted CSR in their reports to convince their shareholders and enhance their reputation. However, their actual contribution to the Kurdistan region's social and environmental condition is minimal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究伊拉克库尔德斯坦地区法律规范对能源和采掘业企业社会责任(CSR)的促进作用，发现虽然存在相关法律条款，但执法不力是主要挑战。研究发现CSR被地方政府用作政策合法化的工具，而国际石油公司的实际社会和环境贡献有限。
AI.research_question: 地方法律法规在促进能源和采掘业企业社会责任实践中的作用是什么？国际石油公司在运营社区中对社会和环境问题的考虑程度如何？
AI.motivation: 企业社会责任在发展中国家的争议性，特别是在减少企业对环境和当地社区负面影响方面的重要性
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、法律规制理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 在线问卷调查（针对库尔德斯坦地区主要国际石油公司）+ 文件分析（年度报告、社会责任报告等公开文件）
AI.findings: 1) 存在广泛的社会和环境保护相关CSR法律条款但执法不力；2) CSR被库尔德斯坦地区政府用作政策合法化工具；3) 国际石油公司主要将CSR用于股东关系和声誉管理，实际贡献有限
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了发展中国家CSR实践中的法律执行困境，丰富了CSR在能源和采掘业背景下的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家制定有效的CSR监管机制提供实践启示，揭示了CSR工具化使用的风险

title: Social Media Co-Attention and Investment Co-Bubbles
affiliations: Dublin City University, NEOMA Business School, Canadian University Dubai and University of Waikato

detail.title: Social Media Co-Attention and Investment Co-Bubbles
detail.abstract: This paper investigates retail investor co-attention and price co-explosivity across equity and cryptocurrency markets. Using hourly data from 2023 to 2024, we find that NVIDIA, Bitcoin, and Ethereum, experienced simultaneous episodes of price co-explosivity and retail attention spikes on social media platforms such as Reddit's WallStreetBets. These findings indicate that price cobubbles across markets are not isolated anomalies but recurring patterns driven by retail behavior shaped and amplified on social media. The study also distinguishes between asset price co-bubbles and market connectedness, suggesting that they reflect different forms of price interdependence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了散户投资者在股票和加密货币市场中的关注度共同性和价格爆发性共同性。发现NVIDIA、比特币和以太坊在社交媒体平台上同时出现价格爆发和散户关注度高峰，说明跨市场价格泡泡是由社交媒体改变散户行为引发的重复模式。
AI.research_question: 股票和加密货币市场中散户投资者的关注度共同性和价格爆发性共同性是否存在？这种跨市场价格泡泡现象的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体对散户投资者行为的影响日益增强，需要研究跨市场价格泡泡的形成机制和驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体影响投资者行为理论、关注度理论、市场泡泡理论和跨市场价格传导机制。
AI.method: 使用2023-2024年小时数据，分析NVIDIA、比特币和以太坊的价格爆发性和Reddit等社交媒体平台上的散户关注度数据。
AI.findings: 发现NVIDIA、比特币和以太坊在社交媒体平台上同时出现价格爆发和散户关注度高峰，跨市场价格泡泡是由社交媒体改变散户行为引发的重复模式，而非孤立异常。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了资产价格共同泡泡与市场连通性的差异，为跨市场价格依存性研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者、监管机构和企业预防跨市场价格泡泡提供实证支撑，有助于识别和管理跨市场风险。

title: Academic Apostille: Validating Diplomas and Transcripts for International Education

detail.title: Academic Apostille: Validating Diplomas and Transcripts for International Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Isaidy Pinto, is the founder of Miami Dade Apostille (www.miamidadeapostille.com), a private company specializing in apostille, notarization, certified translation, and document legalization services in Miami, Florida. No human participants, personal data, or experimental subjects were involved in this research. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of apostilles in validating academic diplomas and transcripts for international education. With increasing student mobility, universities worldwide require officially authenticated documents to ensure credibility. The paper highlights the process of academic apostilles, challenges faced by students in Miami, and the broader implications for global education.

title: Social Learning from Experts with Uncertain Precision

detail.title: Social Learning from Experts with Uncertain Precision
detail.abstract: We study social learning from multiple experts whose precision is unknown and who care about reputation. The observer both learns a persistent state and ranks experts. In a binary baseline we characterize per-period equilibria: high types are truthful; low types distort onesidedly with closed-form mixing around the prior. Aggregation is additive in log-likelihood ratios. Light-touch design-evaluation windows scored by strictly proper rules or small convex deviation costs-restores strict informativeness and delivers asymptotic efficiency under design (consistent state learning and reputation identification). A Gaussian extension yields a mimicry coefficient and linear filtering. With common shocks, GLS weights are optimal and correlation slows learning. The framework fits advisory panels, policy committees, and forecasting platforms, and yields transparent comparative statics and testable implications.

AI.tldr: 研究多个精度未知且关心声誉的专家在社会学习中的行为。观察者既学习持久状态又对专家进行排名。在二元基准模型中，高能力专家诚实报告，低能力专家单向扭曲报告。通过轻量级设计（如评估窗口或小偏差成本）可以恢复信息有效性并获得渐近效率。高斯扩展得到模仿系数和线性滤波。存在共同冲击时，GLS权重最优且相关性减缓学习速度。
AI.research_question: 当多个精度未知且关心声誉的专家参与社会学习时，观察者如何同时学习持久状态并对专家进行排名？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中存在许多专家咨询小组、政策委员会和预测平台，专家既提供信息又关心自身声誉，但观察者不知道专家的真实能力。需要理解这种双重目标下的学习机制和均衡行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会学习理论、声誉模型、贝叶斯学习、信号提取理论、专家评估机制
AI.method: 构建二元状态基准模型分析每期均衡，使用对数似然比加总信息，扩展到高斯环境，分析共同冲击下的最优权重
AI.findings: 高能力专家诚实报告，低能力专家单向扭曲；轻量级设计可恢复严格信息有效性；高斯扩展得到线性滤波；共同冲击下GLS最优但相关性减缓学习
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了精度未知且关心声誉的专家社会学习框架，提供了均衡特征和渐近效率条件，扩展了社会学习和专家评估理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为咨询小组、政策委员会和预测平台的设计提供指导，包括评估机制设计和权重分配策略，具有可检验的比较静态和实证含义

title: Exogenous Social Norms Drive Fisheries Compliance in the Absence of Adequate Enforcement: Insights from a Novel Experimental Game
affiliations: James Cook University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Sydney, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Exogenous Social Norms Drive Fisheries Compliance in the Absence of Adequate Enforcement: Insights from a Novel Experimental Game
detail.abstract: Compliance with rules and laws is critical to societal function and may be driven more by social pressures than enforcement penalties. In conservation, many protected areas closed to hunting and fishing have been rendered ineffective due to inadequate compliance. Here, we explore the role of social norms in compliance decisions by using a novel experimental game to study real anglers’ decisions to fish ‘illegally’ in a simulated marine protected area (MPA) or ‘legally’ in an open access fishing ground. We demonstrate that a descriptive social norm, exogenously created by computer confederates posing as other players, can increase or decrease compliance over time, as participants conformed to confederate decisions even though these were irrelevant to their final payouts. Results build on past common pool resource games studying cooperation as a viable long-term strategy in fisheries, showing how cooperative (or non-cooperative) behaviors can be driven by conformity to group norms. Additionally, we developed a model to predict participants’ compliance decisions, which revealed that normative influence accumulated, such that each rulebreaker observed over time makes individuals more likely to eventually break the rules themselves. Noncompliance was also more likely after losses due to poor catch, but being caught and fined had a weaker influence on rulebreakers than catch or norms, suggesting a ‘resetting effect’ where apprehended rulebreakers believed future fines were now less likely.

AI.tldr: 通过实验游戏研究真实钓者的遵循行为，发现社会规范比扣款罚款更能影响保护区的遵循率，规范影响具有积累效应，而被扣款的规则破坏者容易出现"重置效应"
AI.research_question: 社会规范如何影响保护区的遵循行为？规范影响与扣款罚款的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 许多禁止猎捕的保护区因为遵循率低而失效，但当前对于社会压力与扣款罚款在驾驭遵循行为中的相对重要性了解不够
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会规范理论、共同资源游戏、从众行为理论
AI.method: 采用新颖实验游戏，让真实钓者在模拟海洋保护区和开放渗地之间选择，通过电脑同伴创造外生社会规范
AI.findings: 描述性社会规范可以增加或减少遵循率，规范影响具有积累效应，每个规则破坏者都会增加个体破坏规则的可能性，捕捉不佳导致的损失比被罚款更容易引发违规行为
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了共同资源游戏理论，证明合作或非合作行为可能由于从众社会规范驱动，而非简单的理性计算
AI.practical_contributions: 为保护区管理提供实证支撑，建议重视社会规范建设而非仅依靠扣款罚款，规范干预可以有效提升遵循率

title: Risky Advice and Reputational Bias
affiliations: , Ecole Polytechnique and National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) - International College of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Risky Advice and Reputational Bias
detail.abstract: We study expert advice under reputational incentives, with sell-side equity research as the lead application. A long-lived analyst receives a continuous private signal about a binary payoff and recommends a risky (Buy) or safe action. Recommendations and outcomes are public, and clients' implementation effort depends on current reputation. In a recursive, belief-based equilibrium: (i) advice follows a cutoff in the signal; (ii) under a simple diagnosticity asymmetry, the cutoff is (weakly) increasing in reputation (reputational conservatism); and (iii) comparative statics are transparent-higher signal precision or a higher success prior lowers the cutoff, whereas stronger career concerns raise it. A success-contingent bonus implements any target experimentation rate via a closed-form mapping. The model predicts that high-reputation analysts make fewer risky calls yet attain higher conditional hit rates, and it clarifies how committee thresholds and monitoring regimes shift behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究声誉激励下的专家建议行为，发现在诊断不对称性条件下，高声誉分析师会更保守，做出更少风险推荐但获得更高命中率，并提出了基于成功奖金的激励机制设计。
AI.research_question: 声誉激励如何影响专家的建议行为？特别是在股票研究背景下，分析师如何平衡声誉维护与提供有价值建议的关系？
AI.motivation: 理解专家（如股票分析师）在声誉考虑下的决策行为，解释为什么高声誉分析师往往更保守，以及如何设计激励机制来优化建议质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于声誉理论的动态博弈模型，采用递归信念均衡分析专家建议行为，引入诊断不对称性概念来解释保守行为。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，分析师接收连续私有信号并给出建议，客户根据声誉决定实施努力，通过均衡分析推导最优建议策略。
AI.findings: (i)建议遵循信号临界值；(ii)诊断不对称性导致声誉越高建议越保守；(iii)信号精度越高或成功先验越高，临界值越低；职业关注越强，临界值越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了声誉激励下专家建议的理论框架，解释了声誉保守主义现象，提供了比较静态分析的清晰结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了基于成功奖金的激励机制设计方法，可以精确控制实验率，对委员会决策和监督制度设计具有指导意义。

title: Pursuing the Green Signal: Determinants of Firm Adjustments to Target ESG Score
affiliations: Singapore Institute of Technology, Singapore Institute of Technology and Singapore Institute of Technology

detail.title: Pursuing the Green Signal: Determinants of Firm Adjustments to Target ESG Score
detail.abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) scores have become central indicators of corporate sustainability, influencing investor decisions, capital access, and firm reputation. Drawing on signaling theory and the resource-based view, this study investigates how firms adjust their sustainability initiatives in pursuit of target ESG scores. We find that firms already close to the top of their ESG grade often make only small improvements but still move up to the next grade. In contrast, firms lower in their grade tend to put in more effort and achieve bigger score increases, reflecting greater effort when closer to the lower boundary. These patterns suggest strategic optimization consistent with the signaling-cost dilemma: Firms will act strategically, weighing the benefits of looking good to investors against the costs of improving their ESG practices.

AI.tldr: 企业根据ESG评分等级边界进行战略性调整：接近高等级边界的企业仅做小幅改进即可升级，而接近低等级边界的企业需要付出更大努力才能获得显著分数提升，体现了信号成本困境下的战略优化行为。
AI.research_question: 企业如何调整其可持续发展举措以追求目标ESG评分？
AI.motivation: ESG评分已成为企业可持续性的核心指标，影响投资者决策、资本获取和企业声誉，但企业在追求ESG评分时的战略行为尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（企业通过ESG表现向市场传递质量信号）和资源基础观（企业资源分配决策）
AI.method: 实证研究分析企业ESG评分变化模式
AI.findings: 接近ESG等级顶部的企业只需小幅改进即可升级，而等级较低的企业需要付出更大努力才能获得显著分数提升
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业在ESG评分追求中的战略性行为，验证了信号-成本困境理论在可持续发展领域的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者识别企业ESG战略行为提供洞察，帮助企业更有效地制定ESG改进策略

title: David Klasing on IRS John Doe Summons: Ensuring Crypto Tax Compliance-What Can Be Done?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: David Klasing on IRS John Doe Summons: Ensuring Crypto Tax Compliance-What Can Be Done?
detail.abstract: It is often said that the most accurate records in government are tax records. That's because the IRS has a powerful tool to ensure compliance: the John Doe Summons. Used on cryptocurrency exchanges and other financial institutions, this summons helps the IRS find mismatches between the crypto activities of account holders and the taxes they've reported. When crypto brokers receive a John Doe Summons, they are legally obligated to provide the IRS with a trove of user data, including a record of their crypto transactions. This raises a critical legal question: Do these broad-sweeping demands for private information violate the Fourth and Fifth Amendments of the U.S. Constitution? To delve into this complex issue, Olayimika Oyebanji speaks with David Klasing, the California-based founder and Managing Partner of Tax Law Offices David Klasing. In this interview, Klasing shares valuable insights into the John Doe Summons and the significance of voluntary disclosure in the evolving crypto tax landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国国税局使用John Doe传票从加密货币交易所获取用户数据是否违反宪法第四和第五修正案的问题，通过与税务律师的访谈分析了自愿披露在加密货币税务环境中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 美国国税局通过John Doe传票从加密货币交易所获取用户数据的行为是否违反宪法第四和第五修正案？
AI.motivation: 随着加密货币交易的普及，国税局使用John Doe传票强制获取用户交易数据的做法引发了关于隐私权和宪法权利的重要法律争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国宪法第四修正案（禁止不合理搜查和扣押）和第五修正案（反对自证其罪）的法律理论框架，分析政府执法权力与个人隐私权的平衡。
AI.method: 采用质性研究方法，通过对加州税务律师David Klasing的深度访谈，获取专业法律见解和实践经验。
AI.findings: John Doe传票作为国税局的强大执法工具，虽然在技术上合法，但在宪法层面存在争议；自愿披露策略对加密货币投资者具有重要的法律保护意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字资产时代的政府监管权力与个人宪法权利冲突提供了重要的法律理论分析，丰富了加密货币税务合规的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币投资者和交易所提供了应对国税局审查的实际策略建议，强调了自愿披露在避免法律风险中的关键作用。

title: Trading on Tension: Geopolitical Motives and Market Distortions
affiliations: University of Sydney Business School

detail.title: Trading on Tension: Geopolitical Motives and Market Distortions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to report Joakim Westerholm, Claire Liu, Yancheng Qiu, Ben Hines
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not apply Joakim Westerholm, Claire Liu, Yancheng Qiu, Ben Hines
declarations.funderStatement: Nothing to report Joakim Westerholm, Claire Liu, Yancheng Qiu, Ben Hines

detail.abstract: Using hand-collected data on public short-selling campaigns targeting U.S.-listed Chinese firms, we examine whether geopolitical tensions impair market efficiency. We find strong evidence that activist short sellers strategically time the release of their reports by targeting Chinese firms during periods of heightened U.S.-China tensions. In contrast to those released during stable periods, reports issued during high-tension periods contain more negative sentiment, trigger sharper immediate declines in targeted stock prices, but also exhibit substantial price reversals. Furthermore, financial fraud allegations made during high U.S.-China tension periods are significantly less accurate. These patterns suggest that geopolitically salient short selling may distort market perceptions, as short sellers appear to exploit anti-China sentiment primarily for trading profits rather than to enhance informational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 研究发现公演空头在美中关系紧张期间目标化中国公司，利用反华情绪获利，这些报告情绪更负面、股价下跌更深但回华更大，资讯准确性更低，影响市场效率
AI.research_question: 地缘政治紧张是否会影响市场效率？公演空头在美中关系紧张期间的行为特征和影响如何？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治因素对金融市场效率的影响日益受到关注，特别是美中关系紧张可能会被利用来获取交易利润，而非提高信息效率
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率偏差理论、地缘政治对金融市场影响、公演空头行为理论、投资者情绪和认知偏差

AI.findings: 1）空头在紧张期间更经常攻击中国公司 2）紧张期报告更负面、股价下跌更深 3）但股价回华也更大 4）资讯准确性明显低于稳定期
AI.theory_contributions: 实证地缘政治紧张会造成市场效率偏差，提供了公演空头利用情绪获利的实证证据，丰富了地缘政治对金融市场影响的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒监管机构和投资者关注地缘政治因素对市场信息的影响，帮助识别空头的策略性行为，促进更合理的投资决策

title: The Big Picture Vision and the Environment: An International Perspective
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: The Big Picture Vision and the Environment: An International Perspective
detail.abstract: Because environmental problems usually manifest themselves on a global scale, global modelling tools are needed to study them and to design possible solutions. Starting from a concept of global biogeochemical cycles, proposed by Vernadsky, through a series of insights provided by the modellers, such as Moiseev, Naess, Lovelock, the chapter approaches the criteria for judging global models. Several major contributions to the global modelling literature are reviewed and models are compared on a range of parameters, such as the most frequently used modelling technique, the presence of the time dimension, the treatment of population change, energy, agriculture, prices, trade and environmental pollution. Drawn from the experience of D. Meadows and accompanied by the charts, depicting various dimensions of EU development on the regional scale, this chapter is designed to introduce the subject of global modelling to readers, who will find a plethora of additional literature focused on this subject following the references provided.

AI.tldr: 本章介绍了全球建模工具在环境问题研究中的重要性，回顾了从Vernadsky到Meadows等学者的主要贡献，比较了不同全球模型在技术方法、时间维度、人口变化、能源、农业等方面的处理方式。
AI.research_question: 如何评估和比较全球模型在处理环境问题时的有效性？
AI.motivation: 环境问题具有全球性特征，需要全球建模工具来研究和设计解决方案，因此需要建立评判全球模型的标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Vernadsky的全球生物地球化学循环概念，整合Moiseev、Naess、Lovelock等学者的建模见解。
AI.method: 文献综述和比较分析方法，从建模技术、时间维度、人口变化、能源、农业、价格、贸易和环境污染等多个参数维度比较不同全球模型。
AI.findings: 识别了全球模型的主要技术特征和差异，提供了评估模型有效性的标准框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了全球模型的评判标准框架，整合了多学科建模理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境问题研究者提供了选择和应用全球模型的指导，包含欧盟区域发展案例和丰富的参考文献。

title: Planetary Constitutionalism: Can (German) Constitutional Law Save the Planet? (forthcoming in: International Journal of Constitutional Law - I-CON)
affiliations: Free University of Berlin (FUB) - Department of Law

detail.title: Planetary Constitutionalism: Can (German) Constitutional Law Save the Planet? (forthcoming in: International Journal of Constitutional Law - I-CON)

contentType.other: accepted for publication in the International Journal of Constitutional Law (forthcoming in I-CON)

detail.abstract: Constitutional and rights-based climate litigation has led to significant doctrinal developments in several jurisdictions over the last decade. These developments have brought much attention to climate change (law) but they risk overshadowing other urgent 'planetary crises'. Earth system science reveals humanity has crossed six of nine planetary boundaries, with climate change being only one. To respond to these insights, the article introduces the concept of planetary constitutionalism. This concept builds on earlier notions of environmental constitutionalism-while also advancing beyond them. Based on proposals de constitutione ferenda, in Switzerland and Germany, the article theorizes how national constitutions could explicitly establish legal limits to the planetary footprint of their economies, including externalized environmental harm. Considering the slim chances for explicit constitutional reform, the article then focuses on the interpretative potential of constitutional rights and constitutional environmental provisions in Germany to provide for planetary legal boundaries. By drawing on debates already unfolding in Germany, and the arguments raised in its first constitutional biodiversity litigation case, the article analyses whether legal doctrines developed within climate litigation, such as the much-debated construct of intertemporal guarantees of freedom, could also be applied to the second 'core planetary boundary' namely biosphere integrity and whether they would cover the entire planetary footprint of a country. The article provides a nuanced conclusion highlighting significant contributions of German constitutional doctrine, but also severe limitations in determining 'fair' planetary legal limits, and the need for further research on planetary constitutionalism both in Germany and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行星宪政主义概念，探讨如何通过宪法改革和解释来建立国家经济对地球系统的法律限制，特别关注德国宪法在应对生物圈完整性等行星边界问题上的潜力和局限。
AI.research_question: 国家宪法如何能够明确建立对其经济行星足迹（包括外部化环境损害）的法律限制？宪法权利和环境条款的解释潜力能否为行星法律边界提供依据？
AI.motivation: 气候诉讼虽然推动了重要法律发展，但可能掩盖其他紧迫的行星危机。地球系统科学显示人类已跨越九个行星边界中的六个，需要更全面的法律应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行星宪政主义，建立在环境宪政主义基础上但超越其范畴，结合地球系统科学和宪法理论。
AI.method: 基于瑞士和德国的宪法改革提案进行理论构建，重点分析德国宪法权利和环境条款的解释潜力，借鉴气候诉讼中的法律学说。
AI.findings: 德国宪法学说在建立行星法律边界方面有重要贡献，但在确定'公平'行星法律限制方面存在严重局限，需要进一步研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了行星宪政主义的新概念，拓展了环境宪政主义的理论框架，为应对多重行星危机提供了宪法层面的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宪法改革提供了具体建议，分析了现有宪法条款的解释潜力，为司法实践提供了理论指导，特别是在生物多样性诉讼等新兴领域。

title: Design Principles for Explainable AI in Finance: A Multi-Stakeholder Framework
affiliations: UCL Centre for Blockchain Technologies

detail.title: Design Principles for Explainable AI in Finance: A Multi-Stakeholder Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the research design, data collection, analysis, or interpretation presented in this manuscript. The author has no financial stakes in or consulting relationships with the electronic marketplace platforms discussed in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All participants provided informed consent for participation and recording. Data handling followed GDPR requirements with anonymization of identifying information regarding individuals, organizations, and specific platform products. Participants retained the right to withdraw consent and request data deletion.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as independent academic research.

detail.abstract:
Electronic marketplaces increasingly deploy AI for critical decisions, onboarding, pricing, approvals, and fraud detection. Effective explainable AI (XAI) must satisfy diverse stakeholders while maintaining technical accuracy. This research presents qualitative methods analyzing 24 semi-structured interviews across five specialized groups: retail users, advisors, developers, risk officers, and regulators from nine European countries. The investigation examined lending and buy-now-pay-later platforms through two scenarios - credit-limit changes and fraud-flag reviews - using validated XAI evaluation techniques.

Three patterns emerged. First, process-oriented explanations that explain "why this case" enhance fairness perceptions and clarify actions. Second, progressive disclosure frameworks - beginning with concise text, then offering detailed visualizations - optimize comprehension without overload. Third, raw confidence metrics create uncertainty, whereas counterfactual examples demonstrate decision-altering factors effectively. These patterns, derived through systematic thematic analysis, challenge conventional approaches that prioritize algorithmic transparency over stakeholder comprehension.

The study establishes six design principles for interpretable AI and proposes a multi-stakeholder evaluation framework connecting explanation tools to technical accuracy and human-centered outcomes. This responsible AI approach provides specialized meaning through role-appropriate explanations. The governance toolkit comprises operational performance indicators and audit-compliant documentation protocols, offering practical implementation methods for platform operators and regulators navigating XAI deployment in financial marketplaces.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过定性方法分析五个专业群体对可解释AI的需求，提出了三个关键模式：过程导向解释、渐进式披露框架和反事实示例，挑战了传统优先算法透明度的做法，并建立了六项可解释AI设计原则和多利益相关方评估框架。
AI.research_question: 如何在电子市场中设计有效的可解释AI系统，以满足不同利益相关者的需求同时保持技术准确性？
AI.motivation: 电子市场越来越多地部署AI进行关键决策，但现有可解释AI方法往往优先考虑算法透明度而非利益相关者理解，需要开发能够同时满足技术准确性和多利益相关者需求的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解释AI理论、多利益相关者理论、公平感知理论、渐进式披露理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，包括对来自9个欧洲国家的24个半结构化访谈，涵盖零售用户、顾问、开发者、风险官和监管者五个专业群体，通过信贷额度变更和欺诈标记审查两个场景进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）过程导向解释增强公平感知；2）渐进式披露框架优化理解；3）反事实示例比原始置信度指标更有效地展示决策改变因素
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统优先算法透明度的做法，建立了连接解释工具与技术准确性和人本结果的多利益相关方评估框架，提出了六项可解释AI设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供包含操作绩效指标和审计合规文档协议的治理工具包，为平台运营商和监管机构提供可解释AI在金融市场部署的实用实施方法。

title: Disaster Risk, Saliency Shocks, and Real Estate Markets: Evidence from the Phlegraean Fields
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Social Sciences and Economics and Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Social Sciences and Economics

detail.title: Disaster Risk, Saliency Shocks, and Real Estate Markets: Evidence from the Phlegraean Fields
detail.abstract: Hedonic models say real estate markets price natural disaster risk, especially after catastrophic events. But can salience alone-absent any disaster, and with geological risk already known and pre-existing-shift risk perception and tolerance enough to affect prices? To answer this question, we leverage a natural experiment provided by the unique case study of the Phlegraean Fields, a large volcanic caldera near Naples, Italy. The area is home to over one million residents and is characterized by bradyseism, a geological phenomenon involving cyclic ground uplift and often accompanied by seismic activity perceptible by the population. We show that the recent bradyseismic crisis that began in 2023 has significantly affected local real estate markets, despite minimal damage so far and no abrupt shift in the long-known risks of living in the area. Using granular sub-municipal data, we provide quasi-experimental evidence of sudden declines in residential property sale prices in the most affected areas, alongside a substantial increase in rental prices across the entire caldera that is likely driven by speculation in response to growing demand for safer housing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过意大利那不勒斯附近Phlegraean Fields火山区的自然实验，研究发现即使没有实际灾害发生，仅地质活动的显著性增加就足以显著影响房地产市场，导致受影响区域房价下跌和整个地区租金上涨。
AI.research_question: 在没有实际灾害发生的情况下，仅地质活动的显著性增加是否足以改变风险认知和容忍度，从而影响房地产价格？
AI.motivation: 传统享乐模型认为房地产市场会对自然灾害风险定价，特别是在灾难性事件之后。但本文探讨的是在没有实际灾害、地质风险已知且长期存在的情况下，仅显著性变化是否足以影响价格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 享乐定价模型、风险感知理论、显著性理论
AI.method: 利用Phlegraean Fields火山区的自然实验，使用细粒度次市政数据，提供准实验证据
AI.findings: 2023年开始的缓震危机显著影响了当地房地产市场：受影响最严重区域的住宅销售价格突然下降，同时整个火山口的租金价格大幅上涨（可能是由于对更安全住房需求增长引发的投机行为）
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了风险感知理论，证明即使没有实际灾害发生，仅显著性变化就足以改变风险认知和市场价格
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和房地产投资者提供了关于地质风险显著性如何影响市场动态的重要见解，有助于更好的风险管理和投资决策

title: The Unshakeable Belief in the Economic Impact of Sports

detail.title: The Unshakeable Belief in the Economic Impact of Sports
detail.abstract: There are three problems with economic impact. First, it is an exceptionally complicated estimation problem full of assumptions and fraught with errors. Second, despite this weakness, it is treated as the de facto standard report for event bidders and stadium proponents. This has led to ubiquitous, unchallenged reporting of sports impact as unequivocally positive. Finally, as a result, the public now has an unwavering belief in the existence of positive economic impact from sports. Evidence from a longitudinal study of Super Bowl 50 supports this conclusion. If it is not possible to change the public belief in the meaning or usefulness of economic impact, the solution is to reframe the conversation in terms of financial and redistributive analysis.

AI.tldr: 经济影响分析存在三个问题：复杂性高且充满假设错误、被错误地作为标准报告导致片面正面报道、公众对此产生盲目信任。基于超级碗50的纵向研究支持这一结论，建议转向财务和再分配分析框架。
AI.research_question: 经济影响分析为何存在问题以及如何改进体育赛事经济影响的评估方法？
AI.motivation: 经济影响分析虽然复杂且容易出错，却被广泛用作体育赛事和场馆建设的标准评估工具，导致对体育经济影响的片面正面报道和公众的盲目信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济影响评估理论、公共政策分析和行为经济学，探讨经济影响分析的局限性和公众认知偏差。
AI.method: 采用纵向研究方法，以超级碗50为例进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 研究证实经济影响分析确实存在严重问题：技术复杂性导致估计错误、被不当用作标准工具、造成公众对体育经济影响的盲目乐观信念。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了经济影响分析的理论缺陷和在实际应用中的误导性，为改进体育经济学评估方法提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出从经济影响分析转向财务和再分配分析的实际解决方案，为政策制定者和赛事组织者提供更准确的评估框架。

title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories-Based Approach
affiliations: Indiana University Bloomington - Department of Economics, University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility, Indiana University and Indiana University

detail.title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories-Based Approach

keywords: complementarity between family income and family structure

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 25-18
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high-dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long-term importance of early-life familial conditions for adult economic success.

AI.tldr: 父母收入与家庭结构在童年和青少年时期对成年收入有显著影响，其中中年期和青春期的影响最为强烈，且收入与家庭结构轨迹在关键发展期存在互补关系
AI.research_question: 父母收入和家庭结构在童年和青少年时期的哪个阶段对成年收入影响最大？这些影响是否存在时间上的互补关系？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭背景如何影响代际收入流动性，以及这些影响在个体发展过程中的时间动态特征
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际收入流动性理论、发展心理学理论、家庭经济学理论
AI.method: 使用带函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，采用非参数方法灵活控制个人和家庭特征的高维协变量
AI.findings: 家庭影响在中年期和青春期最为强烈；收入与家庭结构轨迹在关键发展期存在互补关系；早期家庭条件对成年经济成功具有长期重要性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了家庭影响的时间动态模型，揭示了收入与家庭结构影响的互补关系，拓展了代际收入流动性的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于在关键发展期进行干预的时间窗口指导，有助于设计更有效的家庭支持政策

title: Exclusionary Ableism
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business and George Washington University Law School

detail.title: Exclusionary Ableism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: not applicable

detail.abstract: The U.S. immigration system reflects society's values and priorities and shapes the makeup of the country. Since the earliest immigration laws and continuing through today, people with disabilities have been targeted for exclusion and expulsion. This Article employs philosopher Louis Althusser's theory on ideology to analyze and explain how U.S. immigration law not only reflects an ableist ideology, but actively reinforces it. We coin a new term, "exclusionary ableism," to describe this phenomenon. Althusser identified two crucial aspects of how ideology is replicated throughout society. First is the Ideological State Apparatus, which influences people every day through institutions such as family, religion, and schools. Second is the Repressive State Apparatus, which enforces ideology through violent and coercive institutions such as the police, courts, and military. Exclusionary ableism reflects these two components, as this concept both (1) describes the dominant ideology in the United States that rejects and fears people with disabilities and is apparent in our immigration law and policy, and (2) explains how that ideology is actively reproduced through the U.S. immigration system, which functions to exclude and expel noncitizens with disabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文运用阿尔都塞的意识形态理论分析美国移民法如何反映和强化残疾歧视意识形态，提出了"排他性残疾歧视"新概念，揭示了移民系统如何通过意识形态和强制机制排斥残疾人。
AI.research_question: 美国移民法如何反映和强化残疾歧视意识形态？
AI.motivation: 美国移民系统自早期法律至今一直针对残疾人进行排斥和驱逐，这反映了社会的价值观和优先事项，需要理论分析这种系统性歧视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路易斯·阿尔都塞的意识形态理论，包括意识形态国家机器（家庭、宗教、学校等）和镇压性国家机器（警察、法院、军队等）
AI.method: 理论分析框架应用，通过对美国移民法律和政策的概念性分析
AI.findings: 美国移民法不仅反映残疾歧视意识形态，还通过意识形态国家机器和镇压性国家机器积极强化这种意识形态，形成了"排他性残疾歧视"现象
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"排他性残疾歧视"新概念，将阿尔都塞的意识形态理论应用于移民法分析，拓展了残疾研究和移民研究的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了美国移民系统中系统性残疾歧视的运作机制，为政策改革和残疾人权益倡导提供了理论依据和分析工具

title: Dialoguing Power: The Raisina Platform and India's Ascent in Multipolar Geopolitics
affiliations: Kurukshetra University

detail.title: Dialoguing Power: The Raisina Platform and India's Ascent in Multipolar Geopolitics
detail.abstract: This chapter chapter interrogates the Raisina Dialogue as a performativity and strategic apparatus in India's ascent within an increasingly multipolar global order. Framed within the conceptual triad of soft power, dialogical diplomacy, and cognitive cartography, the chapter examines how Raisina functions not merely as a policy platform but as a crucible for worldmaking. It contextualizes Raisina's emergence against the backdrop of declining unipolarity and the rise of post-Western imaginaries in global governance. Tracing India's strategic deployment of the Dialogue to project civilizational autonomy and normative leadership, the chapter explores its thematic expansiveness-from cyber sovereignty and climate justice to vaccine equity and decolonial solidarities. Drawing upon case studies and dialogic moments within Raisina, the analysis foregrounds both the power and paradoxes of the platform. While Raisina amplifies India's aspiration to shape global narratives, it simultaneously contends with critiques around elite capture and epistemic asymmetry. Nevertheless, its increasing engagement with Global South perspectives and counter-hegemonic discourses signals an evolving commitment to pluralistic multilateralism. Ultimately, the chapter argues that Raisina is not simply a mirror of India's global ambitions but a map for recalibrating diplomacy itself. It articulates a model of dialogic statecraft where legitimacy derives not from hegemony but from the ability to convene, listen, and negotiate meaning across divergent worldviews. In doing so, Raisina symbolizes India's endeavor to shift from being a rule-taker to a rule-shaper-affirming that in the 21st century, to rise geopolitically is to lead dialogically.

AI.tldr: 本章分析Raisina对话作为印度在多极全球秩序中崛起的表演性和战略工具，探讨其如何通过软实力、对话外交和认知制图来塑造全球叙事和重构外交模式。
AI.research_question: Raisina对话如何作为表演性和战略工具，在印度多极全球秩序崛起中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 研究Raisina对话在印度全球地位提升中的作用，特别是在单极秩序衰落和后西方全球治理想象兴起的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软实力、对话外交、认知制图三重概念框架
AI.method: 案例研究和对话时刻分析
AI.findings: Raisina对话既是印度塑造全球叙事的平台，也存在精英捕获和认知不对称的悖论；但通过与全球南方视角和反霸权话语的接触，显示出对多元多边主义的承诺。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对话式治国理政模式，强调合法性来源于召集、倾听和协商不同世界观的能力，而非霸权。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度从规则接受者向规则制定者转型提供了实践路径，展示了21世纪地缘政治崛起需要通过对话领导来实现。

title: Globalization and the Hinterland: International Trade and the Rural-Urban Divide
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Department of Political Science and Hebrew University of Jerusalem

detail.title: Globalization and the Hinterland: International Trade and the Rural-Urban Divide
detail.abstract: The growing political divide between rural and urban regions is often attributed to rural deindustrialization and import competition in manufacturing. Yet this cleavage emerged in many countries well before rural industrialization, pointing to underlying economic forces that existing accounts have overlooked. We argue that comparative advantage in agriculture is one such force: rural voters are more likely to support protectionist parties and policies when local agriculture is uncompetitive, as this sector is often central to their communities' economic and social life. Using a new harmonized dataset of surveys from 127 countries and extensive data on voting behavior, we find strong support for our argument. An additional analysis exploiting exogenous subnational variation in agricultural competitiveness in the United States post-NAFTA further corroborates our findings: The political divide between rural and urban voters is pronounced in uncompetitive regions but negligible in those possessing a comparative advantage in agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现农业比较优势是解释城乡政治分歧的重要经济因素，农村选民在农业缺乏竞争力时更倾向于支持保护主义政策和政党。
AI.research_question: 农业比较优势如何影响城乡政治分歧？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将城乡政治分歧归因于农村去工业化和制造业进口竞争，但这种分歧在许多国家农村工业化之前就已出现，表明存在被忽视的深层经济力量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较优势理论，认为农业竞争力是影响农村选民政治倾向的关键因素，农业对农村社区经济和社会生活具有核心重要性。
AI.method: 使用127个国家的新协调调查数据集和大量投票行为数据进行分析，并利用美国NAFTA后农业竞争力的外生次区域变异进行额外验证。
AI.findings: 研究发现强有力的证据支持论点：在农业缺乏竞争力的地区，城乡选民政治分歧显著；而在具有农业比较优势的地区，这种分歧几乎可以忽略不计。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了农业比较优势作为解释城乡政治分歧的新理论视角，补充了现有以制造业为中心的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解农村选民政治行为提供了新见解，有助于设计更有效的农业和贸易政策。

title: Business and Sustainable Development: CSR in Practice
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Business and Sustainable Development: CSR in Practice
detail.abstract: This chapter focuses on the role of business in the quest for sustainable development. It addresses the concept of corporate social responsibility and outlines the history of sustainability reporting, placing emphasis on the Global Reporting Initiative. Central to the chapter is the concept of "stakeholder" as opposed to the "shareholder" of the profi t maximising tradition of the past. The dynamics of CSR publication is shown alongside the full list of CSR reporting criteria. A new way of assessing the sustainability performance of companies is suggested and experience of development of CSR traditions in China, Japan, Germany, UK and France is reviewed. Cross-cultural differences in CSR discourse in the USA, UK and Germany are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨企业在可持续发展中的作用，重点分析了全球报告倡议(GRI)和从股东向利益相关者的转变，并提出了新的可持续性表现评估方法，还比较了中国、日本、德国、英国和法国的公司社会责任传统。
AI.research_question: 企业如何通过公司社会责任(CSR)和可持续性报告在可持续发展中发挥作用？不同国家在CSR实践中存在哪些文化差异？
AI.motivation: 传统上以股东财富最大化为中心的企业模式无法满足可持续发展的需求，需要向利益相关者模式转变，并建立有效的可持续性评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以公司社会责任(CSR)理论、利益相关者理论、可持续发展理论为基础，重点介绍了全球报告倡议(GRI)标准。
AI.method: 文献综述和比较分析法，通过评估不同国家(中国、日本、德国、英国、法国、美国)的CSR实践传统和话语差异。
AI.findings: 不同国家在CSR实践中存在显著的文化差异；从股东向利益相关者模式的转变是实现可持续发展的关键；GRI标准在可持续性报告中发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了CSR和可持续发展理论，提出了新的可持续性表现评估框架，并提供了跨文化CSR实践的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业实践可持续发展提供了具体的报告标准和评估方法，并为不同国家的企业提供了跨文化的CSR实践参考。

title: An Empirical Study on Learning Outcome of Various Courses in Master of Business Administration/ PGDM Programme
affiliations: Surana College, Velalar College of Engineering and Technology and Nehru College of Engineering and Research Centre

detail.title: An Empirical Study on Learning Outcome of Various Courses in Master of Business Administration/ PGDM Programme
detail.abstract: The need for business graduates in every organization is continuously increasing. Expectations from manager are continuously changing as well. Keeping this in mind, the learning outcome of different courses in Master of Business Administration or Post Graduate Diploma in Management programme are articulated and specified in order to create industry oriented professionals. This article throws light on learning outcomes of general and functional related management courses in MBA/PGDM programme of institute of repute in India. General Management courses equips potential leaders better to run a company holistically, specialization courses give domain expertise. It explores the competency development or takeaway for students of Master degree at individual course level. Upon the successful completion of MBA/PGDM programme, students will become industry fit professionals and perform better in their chosen field of career.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度知名商学院MBA/PGDM项目中通识管理课程和专业课程的培养目标，探讨了这些课程如何帮助学生发展能力，使其成为符合行业需求的专业人才。
AI.research_question: MBA/PGDM项目中通识管理课程和专业课程分别如何培养学生的能力，使其成为行业所需的专业人才？
AI.motivation: 企业对商科毕业生的需求持续增长，管理者的期望也在不断变化，因此需要明确MBA/PGDM项目的学习成果，培养符合行业需求的专业人士。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能力培养理论和职业教育理论，关注课程学习成果与行业需求的匹配。
AI.method: 对印度知名商学院MBA/PGDM项目的课程设置和学习成果进行分析研究。
AI.findings: 通识管理课程培养学生全面运营公司的能力，专业课程提供领域专业知识，两者结合使学生成为行业适配的专业人才。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了商科教育中课程设置与能力培养关系的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院课程设计提供参考，帮助学生更好地为职业生涯做准备，满足企业对管理人才的需求。

title: Good-Faith Principle in Gold Transactions Fueled Deforestation in Brazil’s Indigenous Lands
affiliations: University of Bonn

detail.title: Good-Faith Principle in Gold Transactions Fueled Deforestation in Brazil’s Indigenous Lands
detail.abstract: Over the past decade, mining-related deforestation in Brazil's indigenous lands (ILs) has risen substantially. However, the drivers of this increase remain poorly understood. This study explores the case of Law 12.844/2013, which introduced the "good-faith" principle for gold-purchasing establishments. Although mining and deforestation are prohibited in ILs, we hypothesize that relaxing traceability requirements may lower the expected risk of sanction and, in turn, stimulate illegal activity in gold-rich ecosystems. Leveraging the geological distribution of gold deposits as a natural experiment, we employ a differencein-differences approach to assess changes in forest loss post-2013 in ILs with gold deposits compared to those without. Our results indicate that this policy resulted in the loss of ~46,500 hectares of primary forest vegetation (90% CI ± 32,800 hectares), accounting for ~12.3% of the deforestation observed in ILs between 2013 and 2022 (~376,400 hectares).

AI.tldr: 巴西2013年通过的《善意原则》法律降低了黄金采购的可追溯性要求，导致土著领地内非法金矿开采活动增加，造成约46,500公顷原始森林损失，占2013-2022年间土著领地总毁林面积的12.3%
AI.research_question: 巴西2013年《善意原则》法律如何影响土著领地内的非法金矿开采活动和森林砍伐？
AI.motivation: 过去十年巴西土著领地内与采矿相关的森林砍伐大幅增加，但其驱动因素尚不清楚，需要研究政策变化对非法活动的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险预期理论，政策放松可追溯性要求会降低制裁风险预期，从而刺激非法活动在资源丰富的生态系统中发生
AI.method: 利用金矿地质分布作为自然实验，采用双重差分法评估2013年后有金矿与无金矿土著领地的森林损失变化
AI.findings: 该政策导致约46,500公顷原始森林植被损失（90%置信区间±32,800公顷），占2013-2022年间土著领地观测到的总毁林面积（约376,400公顷）的12.3%
AI.theory_contributions: 为政策放松如何通过降低风险预期刺激非法活动提供了理论解释和实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于环境法规执行和可追溯性要求重要性的实证依据，有助于改进土著领地保护政策

title: Healthy, Sustainable and Affordable Food Baskets for Diverse Australian Households
affiliations: Deakin University, The University of Sydney, Deakin University, University of Sydney - George Institute for Global Health, University of New South Wales (UNSW) - The George Institute for Global Health and Deakin University - Centre for Integrative Ecology

detail.title: Healthy, Sustainable and Affordable Food Baskets for Diverse Australian Households
detail.abstract: Sustainable diets must meet nutritional needs affordably while also minimising environmental impact. Achieving this balance is particularly challenging in culturally diverse countries like Australia, where a single optimised food basket cannot reflect varied dietary preferences. Although previous studies have modelled health and environmental outcomes, few have also integrated both cultural acceptability and affordability, and even fewer have created optimised food baskets based on the full array of products available to consumers. This study addresses both gaps by developing food baskets that are nutritionally adequate, sustainable, culturally appropriate, and affordable. We applied mixed-integer linear programming to optimise diets with fresh and packaged foods available in supermarkets, using purchase data from a representative panel of 2,576 Australian households and over 16,800 unique food items. By tailoring optimised baskets to each cultural group and preserving familiar food choices, we achieved average annual reductions of 497 kg CO₂-eq, 4,712 m² of land use, and 741 kilolitres of water use, all within existing nutritional and budget constraints. Our findings demonstrate that healthy and sustainable food baskets are affordable and can be tailored to diverse cultural groups. Our optimised baskets can inform dietary advice and education campaigns that better cater to the cultural diversity of Australian households.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合整数线性规划方法，为澳大利亚不同文化群体开发了营养充足、可持续、文化适宜且负担得起的优化食品篮子，实现了显著的环境效益，同时保持营养和预算约束。
AI.research_question: 如何在澳大利亚这样文化多元的国家，开发既营养充足、环境可持续，又文化适宜且经济实惠的食品篮子？
AI.motivation: 在文化多样性国家如澳大利亚，单一优化食品篮子无法反映不同的饮食偏好，现有研究很少同时整合文化可接受性和经济性，且缺乏基于消费者实际可获得的全系列产品的优化方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续饮食理论框架，整合营养充足性、环境可持续性、文化适宜性和经济可负担性四个维度。
AI.method: 采用混合整数线性规划方法，基于2,576户澳大利亚代表性家庭的购买数据和超过16,800种独特食品项目，优化新鲜和包装食品组合。
AI.findings: 通过为每个文化群体定制优化篮子并保留熟悉的食品选择，实现了年平均减少497公斤二氧化碳当量、4,712平方米土地使用和741千升用水量，同时满足营养和预算约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合文化多样性的可持续饮食优化框架，扩展了传统可持续饮食研究的维度，强调了文化适宜性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可负担的健康可持续食品篮子，可为饮食建议和教育宣传活动提供参考，更好地满足澳大利亚家庭的文化多样性需求。

title: Empirical Evidence for the Inefficiency of Moderate Coercion
affiliations: University of Tromsø - The Arctic University of Norway - School of Business and Economics, University of Tromsø - The Arctic University of Norway - School of Business and Economics and UiT The Arctic University of Norway

detail.title: Empirical Evidence for the Inefficiency of Moderate Coercion
detail.abstract: Does the efficacy of political coercion in building state legitimacy vary by intensity? Using Freedom House, V-Dem, and Polity-5 indices as proxies for coercion, combined with data on legitimacy and regime survival, we identify a mid-level coercion range with negative efficacy. Fewer regimes operate in this range, and those that do exhibit lower legitimacy and survival rates. Time-series analysis reveals authoritarian regimes often reduce coercion into this range, only to increase it abruptly. This suggests applying coercion is costly and regimes' delayed feedback on its impact on legitimacy results in a dynamic overshoot. We present historical evidence supporting the view that the data are driven by an intrinsic negative response to coercion, namely coercion resentment. Policy implications for democracies are discussed.

AI.tldr: 研究发现政治强制的效果存在一个中等强度区间，在该区间内强制反而会降低政权合法性和生存率。威权政权常常会先降低强制强度进入这个负面区间，然后又突然增加强制，表现出动态超调现象。
AI.research_question: 政治强制在建立国家合法性方面的效果是否随强制强度而变化？
AI.motivation: 探讨政治强制对政权合法性的影响机制，特别是不同强制强度下的效果差异，为理解政权稳定性和合法性提供新的理论视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强制怨恨理论，认为民众对政治强制存在内在的负面反应，强制强度与合法性之间存在非线性关系。
AI.method: 使用Freedom House、V-Dem和Polity-5指数作为强制代理变量，结合合法性和政权生存数据，进行时间序列分析和历史证据验证。
AI.findings: 识别出一个中等强制强度区间，在该区间内强制效果为负面；较少政权在此区间运作，且这些政权表现出较低的合法性和生存率；威权政权在强制应用上存在动态超调现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了强制怨恨理论，揭示了强制强度与合法性之间的非线性关系，解释了政权在强制应用上的动态调整行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民主国家提供了政策启示，帮助理解强制策略的局限性，并为政权稳定性管理提供实践指导。

title: When do Sustainability-Linked Bonds Lower Default Risk? A Correlation Threshold
affiliations: Ulm University - Institute of Insurance Science, Ulm University - Institute of Insurance Science and Ulm University

detail.title: When do Sustainability-Linked Bonds Lower Default Risk? A Correlation Threshold
detail.abstract: Issuers of sustainability-linked bonds (SLBs) face higher coupons or other negative consequences if a key performance indicator misses a sustainability target. Within a Merton-type model, we derive closed-form default probabilities for debt structures that incorporate SLBs and compare these probabilities to those associated with conventional debt. The comparison yields a critical correlation threshold ρ * : Under certain conditions, whenever the correlation between asset values and the key performance indicator exceeds ρ * , the SLB strictly lowers default risk. In typical cases that we examine, the correlation threshold is close to zero, and changes in default probabilities are rather small.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Merton模型分析可持续发展挂钩债券(SLBs)对违约概率的影响，发现当资产价值与关键绩效指标的相关性超过临界阈值ρ*时，SLBs能降低违约风险，且在实际案例中该阈值接近零，违约概率变化较小。
AI.research_question: 可持续发展挂钩债券(SLBs)相比传统债券如何影响发行人的违约概率？
AI.motivation: SLBs发行人若未能达到可持续发展目标将面临更高票息或其他负面后果，需要量化分析这种债券结构对违约风险的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Merton模型框架，将SLBs的特殊条款纳入债务结构建模。
AI.method: 建立包含SLBs的债务结构模型，推导闭式违约概率公式，并与传统债券结构进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 存在临界相关阈值ρ*：当资产价值与关键绩效指标的相关性超过ρ*时，SLBs能严格降低违约风险；在典型情况下该阈值接近零，违约概率变化幅度较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在结构化信用风险模型中量化分析SLBs对违约概率的影响，提出了关键的相关性阈值概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为SLBs发行人和投资者提供了风险评估框架，帮助理解SLBs条款设计对信用风险的影响机制。

title: Mechanism Design with Private Communication to Neutralize Fairness Constraints
affiliations: Kwansei Gakuin University - School of Economics and Nihon University - College of Economics

detail.title: Mechanism Design with Private Communication to Neutralize Fairness Constraints
detail.abstract: We study mechanism design under auditable fairness mandates that constrain only the formal rule while allowing off-record private communication between the principal and agents. We model a two-layer environment: a formal rule that maps agents' reports to outcomes and must satisfy the mandate, and private advice in which the principal can provide type-contingent recommendations. We construct a format-preserving randomized encryption (FPRE): the principal randomizes over symmetry-constrained rules and pairs each realization with "password"-like advice. Under FPRE, any Bayesian incentive-compatible social choice function (SCF) is implementable by symmetric formal rules; if the SCF is dominant-strategy incentive-compatible (DSIC), the resulting mechanism achieves DSIC. In contrast, constraints that embed predictable structures-such as strict monotonicity and continuity-cannot be neutralized. We also present an approximate version: continuity is compatible with it. Our results highlight a regulatory-scope insight: if auditors can verify only the format of the rule, format-type fairness does not bind, whereas structurerevealing mandates (i.e., strict monotonicity and continuity) hinder the "encryption" that sustains obedience to private advice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在可审计公平性授权下的机制设计，通过构建格式保持随机加密（FPRE）方法，证明了在仅约束正式规则格式的情况下，任何贝叶斯激励相容的社会选择函数都可以通过对称形式规则实现，而严格的单调性和连续性等结构性约束则无法被规避。
AI.research_question: 在可审计公平性授权下，如何设计机制使得正式规则满足公平性约束，同时通过私下建议实现期望的社会选择函数？
AI.motivation: 现实中的公平性监管往往只约束正式规则的格式，而允许主体与代理之间进行私下沟通，这为规避公平性约束提供了可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、可审计公平性授权、贝叶斯激励相容、占优策略激励相容
AI.method: 构建两层次环境模型：正式规则（满足公平性授权）和私下建议（主体提供类型相关建议），提出格式保持随机加密（FPRE）方法
AI.findings: 1. 任何贝叶斯激励相容的社会选择函数都可以通过对称形式规则实现；2. 如果SCF是占优策略激励相容的，则所得机制也达到DSIC；3. 严格单调性和连续性等结构性约束无法被规避；4. 连续性约束可以通过近似版本兼容
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了格式保持随机加密的理论框架，揭示了公平性授权的监管范围限制：仅验证规则格式的审计无法约束格式型公平性，而结构揭示性授权（如严格单调性和连续性）会阻碍加密效果
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了重要启示：公平性授权需要关注规则的结构性特征而不仅仅是格式，否则容易被规避

title: Building Trust and Customer Engagement in Chit Fund Systems: Strategies for Sustainable Growth
affiliations: Government Arts College, Thiruvananthapuram and Government Arts College

detail.title: Building Trust and Customer Engagement in Chit Fund Systems: Strategies for Sustainable Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship with other people or organisation except the respondents and KSFE with regard to data collection and support.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is not a study with patients or involving any personal information with regard to safety and other related matters. It is just an opnion surevey.
declarations.funderStatement: No Funding for this research and its publications

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper is appeared in Sachetas Journal- https://doi.org/10.55955/420005

detail.abstract: Trust and customer engagement are pivotal to the success of chit fund systems, which rely heavily on community participation, mutual confidence, and the perceived credibility of fund operators. This study explores the key determinants influencing trust-building and customer loyalty within chit funds, with a focus on operational transparency, regulatory compliance, digitalisation, and effective communication strategies. Based on data drawn from four hundred participants, significant behavioural trends were identified-highlighting the role of financial literacy, scheme customisation, and technological integration in improving participant satisfaction. The findings reveal that factors such as the management of chit instalments, information availability, dispute resolution mechanisms, and fund monitoring are critical to sustaining engagement and trust. While most demographic factors like age and locality showed limited variation in perceptions, awareness was significantly higher among urban participants, pointing to a gap in rural outreach and education. The study offers constructive and classified recommendations for key stakeholders. For chit fund operators, implementing blockchain-backed systems, mobile platforms with real-time updates, and certified audits can significantly enhance transparency. Customised schemes and digital customer engagement tools like autopay and live chat support further build rapport. For customers, financial literacy initiatives are essential to understand risks, plan bids effectively, and make informed decisions. Regulatory bodies are encouraged to set uniform digital reporting standards and encourage third-party certification for credibility. The research underscores that in a financial ecosystem built on collective trust, proactive relationship management and technological innovation are not only beneficial but essential for the sustainable growth of chit fund operations.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了合会系统中信任建立和客户忠诚度的关键决定因素，发现运营透明度、监管合规性、数字化和有效沟通策略对维持参与度和信任至关重要。研究为合会运营商、客户和监管机构提供了具体建议。
AI.research_question: 影响合会系统中信任建立和客户忠诚度的关键决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 合会系统严重依赖社区参与、相互信任和基金运营商的信誉，信任和客户参与对其成功至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信任理论、客户参与理论和金融服务透明度理论，探讨合会系统中的信任构建机制。
AI.method: 基于400名参与者的调查数据，分析行为趋势和关键影响因素。
AI.findings: 财务素养、方案定制和技术整合对提高参与者满意度具有重要作用；分期付款管理、信息可获得性、争议解决机制和基金监控是维持参与度和信任的关键因素；城市参与者的意识显著高于农村参与者。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对合会系统中信任构建机制的理解，扩展了金融服务透明度理论在传统集体金融模式中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合会运营商提供了区块链系统、移动平台和认证审计等透明度提升方案；为客户提供了财务素养教育建议；为监管机构制定了数字报告标准和第三方认证指南。

title: The European Commission Kicks Like a Steer: Apple's Article 5(4) DMA Non-Compliance Decision
affiliations: University Villanueva

detail.title: The European Commission Kicks Like a Steer: Apple's Article 5(4) DMA Non-Compliance Decision
detail.abstract:
On 23 April, the European Commission fined Apple €500 million for its lack of compliance with the DMA 1 with respect to its anti-steering provision under Article 5(4). 2 The EC issued the full decision shortly after. 3 A few hidden gems underlie the EC's assessment. Notions of neutrality, effectiveness, and proportionality justified the regulator's intervention when interpreting how a gatekeeper must enable business users to steer end users to offers and the conclusion of contracts outside of their apps. The EC decision demonstrates, once more, that despite most DMA obligations being sufficiently clear to be applied in practice, their interpretation also lies, to a greater extent, in the enforcer's margin of discretion. 

This piece carefully analyses each one of the decision's tenets to demonstrate how such a margin of discretion unfolds in practice. Make it happen, and make it fast Alongside the EC's fining of Meta with €200 million due to its breach of Article 5(2) DMA, the regulator's non-compliance decision relating to Apple's infringement of Article 5(4) is the first decision of its kind. In fact, it is the first time that the regulator has exercised its punitive powers under Article 29 DMA. In line with its 'best endeavours' deadline set out in Article 29(2) DMA, the European Commission took approximately 13 months to trigger and finalise the sanctioning proceedings. The non-compliance decision does not come out of the blue. Two days prior to the first compliance deadline set out for the DMA's obligations (aka 7 March 2024), the EC also sanctioned Apple with €1.8 billion for applying its anti-steering prohibition with respect to music streaming app developers under an exploitative theory of harm. 4 Abiding by the decision, Apple was ordered to refrain from applying the anti-steering prohibition, but the DMA requires something more: to actively enable such steering of users. Article 5(4) imposes a positive obligation upon the gatekeeper, but its roots undoubtedly lie with the same economic evidence and background that the EC set out under its Article 102 TFEU case, and even there is a sense that legal standards were streamlined from one case to the other.
