title: The Mining and Quarrying Industry in Armenia: Changes in Fiscal Regime and Expected Impact on Tax Revenues in the Short Run
affiliations: National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Armenia, National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Armenia,  and Armenian State University of Economics, Yerevan

detail.title: The Mining and Quarrying Industry in Armenia: Changes in Fiscal Regime and Expected Impact on Tax Revenues in the Short Run
detail.abstract: The government of Armenia introduced two major legislative changes in the period 2021–2022: state duties on exports then replacing thereof with a new royalty assessment method to levy additional taxes (including payments) and increase taxes paid by the mines-to-government tax revenue ratio. Therefore, we estimated the impact of real exports (as the only and/or major source of revenue) of copper and other metallic concentrates on the real taxes paid by the largest Armenian taxpayers in the short-run using quarterly data (2013q1–2021q2) and Least Squares (NLS and ARMA) estimation method, to determine how changes in  mining fiscal regime had already affected and would affect the taxes to be paid by the mines from 2023 onward, and new investors’ attraction process. We find that an increase in the real exports of metallic concentrates lagged 1 period could cause a decline in the real taxes paid by major metallic concentrates' exporters. We conclude that the proposed changes had already and would negatively affect companies, thus leading to much higher royalty-to-taxes paid by a company ratio exceeding 70% (on average) if prices hike, and this, in its turn, could negatively affect the decision of investors to invest in Armenia.

AI.tldr: 亚美尼亚政府2021-2022年实施的矿业税收改革（出口关税改为特许权使用费）对主要金属精矿出口商的税收产生了负面影响，可能导致特许权使用费占税收比例超过70%，进而影响投资者决策。
AI.research_question: 亚美尼亚矿业税收制度改革如何影响主要金属精矿出口商的税收支付以及投资者吸引力？
AI.motivation: 亚美尼亚政府在2021-2022年期间实施了两次重大的立法变革，旨在通过新的特许权评估方法增加矿业税收收入，需要评估这些改革对企业和投资者的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收政策变化对企业税收负担和投资决策影响的理论框架，运用时间序列分析方法研究出口与税收之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用2013年第一季度至2021年第二季度的季度数据，采用最小二乘法（NLS和ARMA）估计方法，分析实际金属精矿出口对主要纳税人实际税收的短期影响。
AI.findings: 滞后一期的实际金属精矿出口增加可能导致主要金属精矿出口商的实际税收下降；税收改革已对并将继续对公司产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为矿业税收政策改革对企业税收负担和投资环境的影响提供了实证证据，丰富了税收政策评估的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可为政策制定者提供参考，帮助评估税收改革的效果，避免过高的税收负担影响投资者信心和矿业发展。

title: The Case against Surge Pricing
affiliations: University of Kentucky College of Law

detail.title: The Case against Surge Pricing
detail.abstract: Surge pricing-using data and algorithms to raise prices in response to unexpected increases in demand-has spread across the economy in recent years, from Amazon and Disney World to commuter highways and, of course, Uber, which is infamous for surge pricing rides. Companies claim that surge pricing equilibrates supply and demand, but that is impossible, at least in the short run when demand unexpectedly outstrips supply. What surge pricing really does is to ration existing supply based on ability to pay. That is both distributively unjust and potentially inefficient. It should also be considered a violation of the antitrust laws because it magnifies the harm to consumers of the shortage and concomitant harm to competition associated with a surge in demand relative to supply. As such, surge pricing is similar to price fixing, which, when used by firms that have already been tacitly colluding, magnifies the harm to consumers associated with the demise of competition in the market in which the firms are colluding. Courts should therefore rule surge pricing per se illegal under the antitrust laws, just as they do price fixing today.

AI.tldr: 本文认为动态定价（surge pricing）本质上是一种基于支付能力的供应配给机制，既不公平又低效，应被视为违反反垄断法的行为，类似于价格操纵，法院应将其视为本身违法。
AI.research_question: 动态定价是否违反反垄断法并应被视为本身违法行为？
AI.motivation: 动态定价在经济中广泛扩散，企业声称其平衡供需，但实际上在需求意外超过供应的短期内无法实现，而是基于支付能力配给供应，这既不公平又低效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法理论，特别是关于价格操纵（price fixing）和本身违法原则（per se illegal）的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析，基于经济学原理和法律理论对动态定价的性质和影响进行论证。
AI.findings: 动态定价实际上是通过支付能力来配给现有供应，既分配不公又可能低效，放大了供应短缺对消费者的损害和竞争损害，类似于价格操纵。
AI.theory_contributions: 将动态定价纳入反垄断法分析框架，提出其应被视为本身违法行为，扩展了对新型定价策略的反垄断规制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院和监管机构提供理论依据，建议将动态定价视为违反反垄断法的行为，为消费者保护和市场竞争维护提供实践指导。

title: Workplace Safety of Chinese Immigrant Workers in High-Risk Sectors: Evidence from Hungary and Indonesia
affiliations: Sam Ratulangi University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Corvinus University of Budapest and University of Debrecen

detail.title: Workplace Safety of Chinese Immigrant Workers in High-Risk Sectors: Evidence from Hungary and Indonesia
detail.abstract: This study examines workplace safety among Chinese immigrant workers employed in high-risk and strategically important industries in Hungary and Indonesia. Using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with Multi-Group Analysis (MGA), the research investigates how management safety commitment (MSC), legal protection and compliance (LPC), and social and cultural adaptation (SCA) influence work environment safety (WES). Survey data collected from Chinese workers in Hungary's manufacturing and service sectors and Indonesia's nickel mining industry reveal that all three factors significantly enhance workplace safety perceptions. MSC emerged as the strongest predictor of WES overall, with its effect more pronounced in Indonesia due to weaker institutional enforcement. Conversely, LPC demonstrated greater influence in Hungary, reflecting the impact of European Union regulatory frameworks. SCA consistently contributed to WES across both contexts, although crosscountry differences were not statistically significant. These findings highlight the interplay between organizational commitment, institutional frameworks, and cultural integration in shaping safety outcomes for immigrant workers. The study contributes to occupational safety and migration literature while offering practical insights for policymakers, firms, and international organizations aiming to improve worker welfare in global supply chains.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过对匈牙利和印尼中国移民工人的研究，发现管理层安全承诺、法律保护与遵守以及社会文化适应都显著提升工作环境安全感知，其中管理承诺在印尼效果更明显，而法律保护在匈牙利作用更大。
AI.research_question: 管理层安全承诺(MSC)、法律保护与遵守(LPC)、社会文化适应(SCA)如何影响中国移民工人的工作环境安全(WES)？
AI.motivation: 研究高风险行业中国移民工人的职业安全问题，探索组织承诺、制度框架和文化适应在不同国家环境下对安全结果的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业安全管理理论和移民工人研究理论，构建了组织、制度和文化三维度的安全影响因素框架
AI.method: 采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型(PLS-SEM)和多组分析(MGA)，调查匈牙利制造业服务业和印尼镍矿业的中国工人
AI.findings: 三个因素都显著提升安全感知；MSC是最强预测因素，在印尼效果更明显；LPC在匈牙利作用更大；SCA在两国都有稳定贡献
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了职业安全和移民研究的理论，揭示了组织、制度和文化因素在不同国家环境下的交互作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和国际组织提供了改善全球供应链工人福利的实践见解

title: Local Problems, Local Solutions: Evidence from the Drug-Free Communities Program on Youth Development
affiliations: University of International Business and Economics (UIBE), University of Louisville and Lehigh University

detail.title: Local Problems, Local Solutions: Evidence from the Drug-Free Communities Program on Youth Development

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Drug-Free Communities (DFC) Support Program aims to reduce youth substance use by fostering multi-sector collaboration and implementing locally tailored strategies within the community. This study is among the first to evaluate the program’s impact on youth development outcomes in the United States. Using the Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021) difference-in-differences (CSDID) estimator, we find that the DFC program significantly reduces drug-related juvenile crime and improves academic performance. The effects are particularly pronounced in communities where coalitions include government agencies, highlighting the critical role of institutional coordination in mobilizing local resources. We also explore behavioral mechanisms, documenting reductions in marijuana use and opioid-related inpatient hospitalizations. A cost-benefit analysis indicates substantial welfare gains, suggesting that early-life prevention represents a cost-effective investment in public health.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: DFC项目通过多部门协作显著减少青少年毒品犯罪并提高学业表现，政府机构参与效果更佳，具有显著成本效益
AI.research_question: DFC支持项目对青少年发展成果的影响效果如何？
AI.motivation: 评估DFC项目这一旨在减少青少年药物使用的多部门协作项目的实际效果，填补项目影响评估的研究空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 社区干预理论、多部门协作理论、青少年发展理论
AI.method: 使用Callaway和Sant'Anna(2021)的双重差分(CSDID)估计方法
AI.findings: DFC项目显著减少毒品相关青少年犯罪、提高学业表现，在包含政府机构的社区效果更显著，减少大麻使用和阿片类药物相关住院
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多部门协作在社区干预中的有效性，强调了制度协调在动员地方资源中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期预防项目提供了成本效益证据，证明DFC项目是公共卫生领域的高效投资，为政策制定提供了实证依据

title: Instrumental Freedoms and Constitutional Principles in Colombia
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Instrumental Freedoms and Constitutional Principles in Colombia
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the relationship between Amartya Sen's theory of instrumental freedoms and the fundamental principles enshrined in Title I of the 1991 Colombian Constitution. It examines whether the five freedoms-political freedoms, economic facilities, social opportunities, transparency guarantees, and protective security-are present and articulated in the constitutional text. It also discusses how Sen's concepts of agency and choice offer a deeper framework for evaluating constitutional principles. The analysis adopts an interdisciplinary approach that combines economics, law, and social sciences, focusing on the Colombian context and its challenges related to development and human dignity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论与1991年哥伦比亚宪法第一编基本原则之间的关系，检验了五种自由在宪法文本中的体现情况，并探讨了森的能动性和选择概念如何为评估宪法原则提供更深层次框架。
AI.research_question: 阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论（五种自由）是否在1991年哥伦比亚宪法第一编基本原则中得到体现和表述？
AI.motivation: 探讨发展经济学理论（特别是森的自由发展理论）与宪法原则之间的关联，为评估哥伦比亚的发展挑战和人类尊严问题提供跨学科分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论，包括政治自由、经济条件、社会机会、透明性保证和保护性安全五种自由，以及能动性和选择概念。
AI.method: 采用跨学科研究方法，结合经济学、法学和社会科学，对哥伦比亚宪法文本进行分析，重点关注哥伦比亚的发展背景和相关挑战。
AI.findings: 分析宪法文本中五种自由的体现程度和表述方式，探讨森的框架如何为宪法原则评估提供更深层次的理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将发展经济学理论（森的自由理论）与宪法法学相结合，提供了评估宪法原则的新理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚及其他类似背景国家评估宪法实施效果、促进发展和保障人类尊严提供了实用的分析工具和政策建议。

title: Why is Private Lending So Popular?
affiliations: Fuqua School of Business, Duke University and Duke University - Finance

detail.title: Why is Private Lending So Popular?
detail.abstract: Non-bank lending to small-and medium-sized firms - i.e., private credit - has exploded over the past two decades. To explore the rise in its popularity, we focus on Business Development Companies (BDCs), which comprise a large fraction of the total private debt market and for which we can observe detailed information on portfolio investments. Although many have noted that BDC investments substitute for bank financing in the wake of postcrisis credit tightening, BDCs operate in meaningfully different ways from traditional lenders. BDCs do not merely make alternative bank loans: they offer a complex combination of securities to companies, spanning the debt/equity spectrum. This allows private lenders to tailor contracts to the risk profiles of individual firms. The growth of the asset class is tied directly to this contractual complexity, which is associated with higher interest rates and values at the loan level, yet lower market risk than traditional private equity. By blending lending with traditional private equity investments, the supply of capital is tailored to a growing retail investor segment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非银行借贷（私助信贷）的快速增长，重点分析了业务发展公司（BDCs）的运作模式。发现BDCs通过提供复杂的证券组合（跨货债/股权谱系）来为中小企业量身定制合同，这种合约复杂性带来更高利率和价值，但市场风险较低。该模式还适合了不断增长的零售投资者组细。
AI.research_question: 非银行借贷（私助信贷）为何在过去两十年快速增长？BDCs如何通过不同于传统银行的方式运作？
AI.motivation: 私助信贷市场在过去两十年快速扩张，尤其是在金融危机后信贷收紧的背景下。理解这种增长的驱动因素和BDCs的独特运作模式对于理解现代金融体系的变化至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合约理论和风险管理理论，研究BDCs如何通过复杂的证券组合来为中小企业量身定制融资方案，以及这种模式如何影响利率、价值和风险水平。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，基于BDCs详细的投资组合数据，分析其投资结构、合约特征、利率水平和风险控制等。
AI.findings: BDCs并非简单的银行贷款替代者，而是通过提供跨货债/股权谱系的复杂证券组合来运作。这种合约复杂性导致更高的利率和贷款价值，但市场风险较传统私募股权投资低。同时，这种混合投资模式适合了零售投资者的需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业融资理论，揭示了非银行借贷机构如何通过合约创新来应对中小企业的风险异质性，以及这种模式如何影响金融稳定性和投资者结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中小企业提供了更多充分的融资选择，为投资者提供了一种风险-收益特征不同于传统私募股权的投资模式，同时也为政策制定者提供了监管新兴金融形态的参考。

title: The Institutional Structures and Models for Implementing the Kenyan National ICT Plan
affiliations: University of New Mexico School of Law and University of Nairobi

detail.title: The Institutional Structures and Models for Implementing the Kenyan National ICT Plan
detail.abstract:
This chapter attempts to address several Questions which are aimed at helping the Government of Kenya successful!Y implement its ICT policy after that policy is finalised, hopeful!Y by the close of the year 200S. The need to improve and strengthen Kenya's ICT institutions can have remarkable impact on the overall national objective of securing economic development for the country. The goal for Kenya, in this context, is indeed: to create a .. capable state," with well-designed government institutions as well as effective and legitimate government institutions. The chapter is based on the general Terms of Reference (TORs3) for a research undertaking that sought to identify and to critique the current institutional structures for the impending implementation of Kenya's national

ICT policy. It also makes recommendations for optional institutional structures and strategies, which will facilitate, and hopefully, strengthen the implementation of the national ICT policy.

AI.tldr: 本章旨在为肯尼亚政府成功实施ICT政策提供建议，通过分析现有制度结构并提出优化方案，以促进国家经济发展和建设有效政府机构。
AI.research_question: 如何帮助肯尼亚政府成功实施其ICT政策？哪些制度结构和策略能够促进和加强国家ICT政策的实施？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚需要改善和加强ICT制度机构，这对实现国家经济发展目标具有显著影响，目标是建立一个具备良好设计和有效合法政府机构的"有能力的国家"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论和政府机构有效性理论，关注制度结构设计和政策实施机制。
AI.method: 基于研究任务书(TORs)进行的分析研究，识别和批判现有制度结构，并提出可选制度结构和策略建议。
AI.findings: 提出了促进和加强国家ICT政策实施的可选制度结构和策略建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家ICT政策实施提供了制度设计和机构建设的理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚政府提供了具体的制度结构优化建议和实施方案，有助于成功实施国家ICT政策，促进经济发展。

title: Crime Victimization and the Right-Wing Ceiling
affiliations: Universidad Iberoamericana - Economics and University of Maryland, College Park

detail.title: Crime Victimization and the Right-Wing Ceiling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Does rising crime help the right? Conventional wisdom and theories of issue ownership suggest that insecurity should benefit right-wing candidates, who are widely perceived as stronger on law and order. This paper challenges that assumption, showing that the electoral consequences of crime are non-linear and contingent. Using subnational data from three presidential elections in Colombia, we find that while moderate levels of crime increase support for right-wing candidates, high levels of crime lead to their electoral decline. This reversal reflects a breakdown in issue ownership: as insecurity persists, voters may question the right's competence on public safety and withdraw support. We identify political mobilization as a key mechanism; rising crime increases turnout, particularly in high-crime areas, where newly mobilized voters disproportionately punish the right. These findings contribute to debates on electoral accountability, issue salience, and the limits of partisan advantage, offering new insights into how crime shapes participation and vote choice in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了犯罪率上升必然有利于右翼候选人的传统观点，发现犯罪对选举结果的影响是非线性的：中等犯罪水平增加右翼支持，但高犯罪率导致右翼选举衰退，反映了议题所有权失效和选民问责机制。
AI.research_question: 犯罪率上升是否总是有利于右翼候选人？犯罪水平如何影响选民对右翼候选人的支持和投票行为？
AI.motivation: 传统观点和议题所有权理论认为不安全感应有利于被认为在法治秩序方面更强的右翼候选人，但这一假设需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 议题所有权理论、选举问责理论、政治动员理论
AI.method: 使用哥伦比亚三届总统选举的次国家级数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1) 中等犯罪水平增加对右翼候选人的支持；2) 高犯罪水平导致右翼选举衰退；3) 犯罪上升增加投票率，特别是在高犯罪地区；4) 新动员选民不成比例地惩罚右翼
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战传统议题所有权理论，提出犯罪影响的非线性模型，揭示高犯罪水平下议题所有权失效机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方国家理解犯罪如何影响政治参与和投票选择提供新见解，对竞选策略和公共安全政策制定具有参考价值

title: Instrumental Freedoms and Agency in the Colombian Constitution of 1991 Constitutional Agency
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Instrumental Freedoms and Agency in the Colombian Constitution of 1991 Constitutional Agency
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the relationship between Amartya Sen's theoretical framework, centered on instrumental freedoms-political freedoms, economic facilities, social opportunities, guarantees of transparency, and protective security-and Title II of the 1991 Colombian Constitution, which refers to rights, guarantees, and duties. The study examines whether the Constitution fosters agency and the capacity for effective choice, beyond the formal recognition of rights. From a critical and interdisciplinary perspective, it assesses the extent to which constitutional provisions promote substantive freedoms in accordance with Sen's human development approach.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿马蒂亚·森以工具性自由为核心的理论框架与1991年哥伦比亚宪法第二章的关系，探讨宪法是否在形式权利承认之外促进了主体性和有效选择能力。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚宪法第二章是否促进了主体性和有效选择能力，超越了形式上的权利承认？
AI.motivation: 从批判性和跨学科视角评估宪法条款在多大程度上按照森的人类发展方法促进实质性自由。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阿马蒂亚·森的工具性自由理论框架，包括政治自由、经济设施、社会机会、透明度保障和保护性安全。
AI.method: 批判性和跨学科的分析方法，对宪法文本与理论框架进行对比研究。
AI.findings: 需要具体分析宪法条款与森的理论框架的契合程度，评估实质性自由的实现情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 将森的发展理论应用于宪法分析，为理解权利实现提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚宪法实施和权利保障提供评估框架，有助于识别宪法实践中的差距和改进方向。

title: An Assessment of Cod in the Firth of Clyde
affiliations: University of Strathclyde - Department of Mathematics & Statistics, University of Strathclyde and University of Strathclyde

detail.title: An Assessment of Cod in the Firth of Clyde
detail.abstract:
At  present Clyde cod are assessed by ICES as part of the Northwestern substock that includes part of the North Sea and all of the West of Scotland. Clyde cod are, however, considered to be a substock separate from the West of Scotland and may have different dynamics. This document reports an assessment of cod in the Clyde as a single stock unit.

Data available include a time series of total landings and discards from 1985-2019 based on sampling by the Scottish Government’s Marine Directorate. These data include age compositions for some years. In addition, research vessel surveys provide an index of abundance as well age compositions for the whole period. The level of sampling is generally low and there are gaps in some time series, but data are sufficient to perform a full stock assessment.

An age structured stock assessment model is developed that can estimate stock biomass and fishing mortality despite the data gaps. Sensitivity analysis and retrospective analysis suggest the assessment is robust to a variety of assumptions about the data and the fishery.

A surplus production model that makes different assumptions about the stock population dynamics is developed and applied to the catch and survey data. The results from this model are very similar to the age structured model which suggests the results are not sensitive to model structure.

The assessment estimates very high rates of fishing mortality and a substantial decline in spawning stock biomass. Currently, the high rates of fishing are attributable to bycatch of cod in the Nephrops fishery.

Estimates of Maximum Sustainable Yield (MSY) derived from the assessment show that the spawning stock biomass is less than 10% of the biomass expected at MSY. The stock appears to have collapsed around the year 2000. Fishing mortality from 2001-2014 was at or exceeded values that would be expected to cause stock collapse (Fcrash). Current fishing mortality (as of 2019) is close to Fcrash.

Investigating the productivity of the stock (the number of recruits produced per tonne of spawning biomass) shows that the current productivity is within the historical range and above rates in the mid-1980s. It does not appear that stock decline is the result of impaired productivity.

The most likely cause of the failure of the stock to recover is the high rate of fishing resulting from the bycatch in the Nephrops trawl fishery. Stock recovery needs to focus on measures to reduce bycatch, perhaps by changing gear design. Enhancing productivity through the protection of spawning behaviour is unlikely to be successful at current rates of exploitation.

AI.tldr: 本文对克莱德鳕鱼作为独立种群单位进行评估，发现该种群因对虾拖网渔业的兼捕导致过度捕捞而崩溃，产卵群体生物量不足MSY水平的10%，需要采取减少兼捕的措施来促进种群恢复。
AI.research_question: 克莱德鳕鱼作为独立种群的现状如何？其种群动态特征和衰退原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 目前ICES将克莱德鳕鱼作为西北亚种群的一部分进行评估，但克莱德鳕鱼可能具有不同的种群动态，需要作为独立种群单位进行评估以制定有效的管理措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于年龄结构种群评估模型和剩余产量模型两种渔业种群评估理论框架
AI.method: 使用1985-2019年的总上岸量和丢弃量数据、年龄组成数据以及科研船调查的丰度指数，开发年龄结构种群评估模型和剩余产量模型进行分析
AI.findings: 克莱德鳕鱼经历了严重的过度捕捞，产卵群体生物量大幅下降，目前生物量不足MSY水平的10%；种群在2000年左右崩溃，2001-2014年捕捞死亡率达到或超过导致种群崩溃的水平；当前种群生产力仍在历史范围内，衰退主要源于对虾渔业的兼捕
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在数据有限的情况下仍可进行可靠的种群评估，验证了不同模型结构对评估结果的一致性
AI.practical_contributions: 为克莱德鳕鱼的独立管理提供了科学依据，指出需要重点减少对虾拖网渔业的兼捕，改进渔具设计是种群恢复的关键措施

title: Losing Grip? The Quantity Theory of Money under Currency Competition
affiliations: Simon Fraser University (SFU) - Department of Economics, University of Ottawa and Washington University in Saint Louis, John M. Olin Business School

detail.title: Losing Grip? The Quantity Theory of Money under Currency Competition
detail.abstract: This study examines currency competition between the Dollar and Bitcoin, focusing on monetary policy. Using theory and lab experiments, we show that proportional transfers (interest on Dollar balances) operate in two regimes. Depending on inflation expectations, policy may raise Dollar trade shares and reduce velocity, weakening price pass-through and generating Bitcoin inflation spillovers despite its rigid supply. Alternatively, passthrough can be strong with little effect on trade. Expectations drive these self-fulfilling dynamics and endogenously shape Dollar price stickiness. Even with flexible prices, money need not be neutral. Our results reveal limits of central bank influence in dual currency systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过理论和实验方法分析美元与比特币的货币竞争，发现比例转移支付（美元余额利息）存在两种机制：根据通胀预期可能提高美元交易份额、降低流通速度，或对交易影响很小但价格传导强烈。预期驱动自我实现的动态并内生塑造美元价格粘性。
AI.research_question: 在美元和比特币的双货币体系中，货币政策（特别是比例转移支付）如何影响货币竞争、价格传导和货币中性？
AI.motivation: 随着比特币等加密货币的出现，传统法定货币面临新的竞争，需要理解中央银行在双货币体系中的政策有效性限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币竞争理论、货币政策传导机制、预期形成理论、价格粘性理论
AI.method: 理论建模与实验室实验相结合的方法
AI.findings: 比例转移支付存在两种机制：1）提高美元交易份额、降低流通速度，削弱价格传导并产生比特币通胀溢出；2）价格传导强烈但对交易影响很小。预期驱动自我实现动态并内生塑造价格粘性，即使在价格灵活情况下货币也非中性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了双货币体系中预期驱动的自我实现动态机制，证明了即使在价格灵活情况下货币非中性的可能性，发展了货币竞争理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行在加密货币竞争环境下的政策制定提供理论依据，揭示了央行在双货币体系中影响力的局限性，对货币政策设计具有重要启示。

title: PPP Comparative Study Based on Type, Terminology, And Model Adaptation
affiliations: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University and

detail.title: PPP Comparative Study Based on Type, Terminology, And Model Adaptation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest related to our study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: This research work has been not supporting by anyone.

detail.abstract: Public-private partnerships (PPPs) have emerged as a crucial mechanism for infrastructure development, particularly in nations facing fiscal constraints and technical limitations. This study conducts a comparative analysis of PPP projects globally, focusing on three critical aspects: types of models, adaptability of models, and the terminology used. Various countries define and implement PPP differently, influenced by their legal frameworks, economic conditions, and project-specific needs. The study aims to identify the different characteristics of the PPP model, the highly adaptive model, and the various terminologies used for PPP. The research identifies a formula for determining PPP models based on asset involvement, partner participation, and payment mechanisms. Findings reveal that greater private sector involvement correlates with higher PPP adaptability models, such as Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) and Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain (DBFOM) are among the most widely adopted. Additionally, the study highlights the inconsistencies in PPP terminology across different jurisdictions, underscoring the need for a globally unified framework to enhance efficiency and cross-border collaboration, reinforcing the necessity for standardized policies to streamline global PPP implementation.

AI.tldr: 本研究对全球PPP项目进行对比分析，重点研究模型类型、适应性和术语使用，发现私营部门参与度越高PPP适应性越强，BOT和DBFOM等模式最常用，同时揭示了不同司法管辖区PPP术语的不一致性问题
AI.research_question: PPP模式有哪些不同特征？哪些是高度适应性模型？PPP使用了哪些不同术语？
AI.motivation: PPP已成为基础设施发展的重要机制，特别是在面临财政约束和技术限制的国家，但各国对PPP的定义和实施存在差异
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产参与、合作伙伴参与和支付机制确定PPP模型的理论框架
AI.method: 比较分析法，对全球PPP项目进行对比研究
AI.findings: 私营部门参与度越高，PPP适应性模型越强；BOT和DBFOM是最广泛采用的模式；不同司法管辖区PPP术语存在不一致性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于资产参与、合作伙伴参与和支付机制的PPP模型确定公式
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了建立全球统一框架的必要性，以提升效率和跨境合作，需要标准化政策来简化全球PPP实施

detail.abstract: Remote work has redefined global management practices in the post-COVID era, transforming organizational dynamics across developed and developing countries. This paper explores the productivity implications of remote work in the USA, Australia, and India. Using comparative productivity data, adoption trends, and a multinational case study approach, the study evaluates challenges and identifies sustainable management strategies. Graphical analysis, including bar charts and line graphs, illustrate productivity shifts and adoption patterns. The paper proposes strategic frameworks for effective remote workforce management and concludes with global recommendations based on international practices.

title: Enforcing compliance with labor regulations and firm outcomes: Evidence from Brazil
affiliations: Instituto de Ensino e Pesquisa (INSPER), Insper Institute of Education and Research and Brazilian Central Bank

detail.title: Enforcing compliance with labor regulations and firm outcomes: Evidence from Brazil
detail.abstract: In developing economies, many formal firms hire a portion of their workforce informally to bypass the costs of stringent labor regulations. While labor inspections serve as an important policy tool to ensure compliance, promoting a more competitive labor market, they may also have unintended consequences on firms’ outcomes. Using a unique set of administrative data that includes information on labor inspections, matched employer–employee data (RAIS), and credit registry data from the Central Bank of Brazil, this paper provides novel findings on post-inspection dynamics at the firm level within Brazil’s heavily regulated labor market. Employing a difference-in-differences approach, we observe a surge in formal employment without any immediate impact on revenue, suggesting that inspected firms tend to formalize their unregistered workers after an inspection. However, our results also reveal a large negative impact on firm performance and an increased likelihood of exit in the long run, indicating that audited firms struggle to offset the costs of formal labor. In addition, we find that inspected firms face tighter credit conditions, emphasizing the broader economic implications of enforcing labor regulations. By exploring heterogeneity across municipalities, we discern that the adverse effects of inspections are more pronounced in areas with lower informality rates. All in all, this research fills a gap in understanding how labor law enforcement affects firm dynamics, offering insights into the trade-offs faced by firms in heavily regulated environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了巴西劳动力检查对企业的影响，发现检查后企业会增加正式雇佣但长期面临业绩下滑和退出风险，同时在低非正规化地区负面影响更显著

AI.motivation: 发展中国家许多正规企业通过非正规雇佣规避严格劳动法规成本，劳动力检查作为重要政策工具可能对企业产生意外后果

title: The Shifting Frames of the Council of Europe: From Totalitarianism to Authoritarianism, from Populism to Democratic Backsliding

detail.title: The Shifting Frames of the Council of Europe: From Totalitarianism to Authoritarianism, from Populism to Democratic Backsliding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The research for this paper was supported by the Volkswagen Foundation under its funding framework ’NEXT: Law between Normativity and Reality’.

detail.abstract:
Over the past two decades, several European states have undergone a notable shift away from liberal democracy and human rights. These trends have disrupted the foundational discourses of the Council of Europe (CoE), which historically has positioned Europe as a bastion of human rights and democracy. Various terms—including illiberalism, populism, authoritarianism, and democratic backsliding—have been used to describe these developments. In the CoE context, “populism” and “democratic backsliding” have become dominant frames for defining internal trends against the image that the CoE constructs for Europe, while “totalitarianism” and “authoritarianism” have been used to frame its past and present external Others.

 

This article examines how these four concepts—totalitarianism, authoritarianism, populism, and democratic backsliding—are deployed within the CoE to analyse their discursive functions across different phases of the CoE’s history. Drawing on frame analysis, it traces how and to which effect these concepts have been mobilized in the CoE context. The article concludes that these concepts are employed less to denote clearly differentiated political forms or categories with distinct political and legal implications; rather, they are used as discursive tools to frame Europe as associated with human rights and democracy, in opposition to its external Others.

AI.tldr: 本文分析欧洲委员会如何运用极权主义、威权主义、民粹主义和民主倒退四个概念作为话语工具，将欧洲建构为人权和民主的堡垒，而非用于区分明确的政治形式。
AI.research_question: 欧洲委员会如何部署极权主义、威权主义、民粹主义和民主倒退这四个概念来分析其在不同历史阶段的话语功能？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年欧洲多国出现背离自由民主和人权的趋势，这动摇了欧洲委员会将欧洲定位为人权和民主堡垒的基础话语。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架分析理论，用于追踪这些概念在欧洲委员会语境中的动员方式和效果。
AI.method: 采用框架分析方法，追溯这些概念在欧洲委员会历史不同阶段的部署方式和效果。
AI.findings: 这些概念并非用于表示具有明确政治和法律含义的差异化政治形式，而是作为话语工具来构建欧洲与人权和民主的关联，以区别于外部他者。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了国际组织如何通过概念框架来建构和维护特定的地缘政治身份和意识形态边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解欧洲委员会的话语策略和政治定位提供了重要见解，有助于分析国际组织在应对民主倒退时的修辞手段。

title: Fiscal Capacity and Execution at the Local Level: New Evidence from Brazil

detail.title: Fiscal Capacity and Execution at the Local Level: New Evidence from Brazil

declarations.funderStatement: World Bank

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a new disaggregated and harmonized dataset on public procurement and budget execution by Brazilian subnational entities, which currently covers half of Brazilian municipalities and spans the years 2003-21. This dataset provides key information that was previously unavailable from aggregate data, such as the identities of suppliers, details on purchases of goods and services, and granular information on the life cycle of each expenditure action. It then uses these data to provide new stylized facts about local public finance. First, it shows that about one-quarter of government purchases are locally procured and discusses implications for efficiency. Second, it demonstrates that close to 15 percent of payments exceed the 30-day threshold and that payment timeliness is systematically correlated with the income level of the municipality.

title: Self- And Organizationally Initiated Learning and Their Impact on Technical and Environmental Efficiency: Evidence from Rice Producers in Bangladesh
affiliations: , University of Missouri and University of Missouri

detail.title: Self- And Organizationally Initiated Learning and Their Impact on Technical and Environmental Efficiency: Evidence from Rice Producers in Bangladesh

publicationDetails.detailsText: Mobarok, M. H., Skevas, T., & Thompson, W. (2025). Self- and organizationally initiated learning and their impact on technical and environmental efficiency: Evidence from rice producers in Bangladesh. Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies, 1– 20. https://doi.org/10.1108/JADEE-08-2024-0251

detail.abstract:
Purpose: We investigate the dual impact of self-initiated and organizationally initiated learning on the technical and environmental efficiency of rice producers in Bangladesh.

Design/methodology/approach: We use Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to measure technical efficiency (rice output relative to inputs) and environmental efficiency (minimizing N₂O emissions with given inputs). These scores are analyzed using bootstrap truncated regression to assess the effects of self- and organizationally initiated learning, using data from Bangladeshi rice farms in 2015/16 and 2018/19.

Findings: Self-initiated learning channels are positively associated with environmental efficiency, particularly through farmer visits to NGOs, access to educational institutions, and internet use. Organizationally initiated channels do not have any statistically significant impact on environmental efficiency. Moreover, no learning channel is found to have significant impact on technical efficiency.

Managerial or policy implications: Facilitating access to NGOs, education, and the internet can support self-initiated learning for environmental efficiency. However, investing in institutionally initiated learning to support technical efficiency might not be effective without first understanding why existing capacity might not be effective.

Originality/value: This research provides unique insights into how different learning channels affect farm efficiency. It highlights their distinct impacts on environmental efficiency and overall failure to deliver technical efficiency, offering important implications for policy-making and future research.

AI.tldr: 研究发现孟加拉国稻农的自主学习渠道（如访问NGO、教育机构和互联网使用）与环境效率正相关，而组织发起的学习渠道对环境效率无显著影响。所有学习渠道对技术效率均无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 自主发起的和组织发起的两种学习渠道如何影响孟加拉国稻农的技术效率和环境效率？
AI.motivation: 研究不同学习渠道对农业效率的影响，特别关注技术效率和环境效率的差异，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学习理论和效率分析理论，探讨不同学习渠道对农业生产效率的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用数据包络分析（DEA）测量技术效率和环境效率，然后采用bootstrap截断回归分析自主学习与组织学习的影响。数据来自2015/16和2018/19年孟加拉国水稻农场。
AI.findings: 自主学习渠道（访问NGO、教育机构、互联网使用）与环境效率正相关；组织学习渠道对环境效率无显著影响；所有学习渠道对技术效率均无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同学习渠道对技术效率和环境效率的差异化影响，丰富了学习理论在农业环境效率领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：应优先支持农民通过NGO、教育和互联网进行自主学习来提升环境效率，而非过度投资组织发起的培训项目。

title: Delegatio Ex Machina: Institutions Without Agency
affiliations: Universidad de la Republica

detail.title: Delegatio Ex Machina: Institutions Without Agency
detail.abstract: This article examines the disappearance of agency in institutional governance when predictive systems become the locus of delegation. Delegatio Ex Machina proposes that institutional authority is no longer anchored in decision-makers but in compiled rules that execute without reference to a subject. Central banks, international agencies, and automated audit systems illustrate how syntactic delegation replaces political acts with repetitive formal structures. By tracing this displacement, the paper defines a framework for understanding authority without agency and its risks for accountability in predictive societies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了当预测系统成为委托核心时，制度治理中代理的消失现象。提出了"机器委托"概念，指出制度权威不再锚定于决策者，而是存在于无需主体参考即可执行的编译规则中。通过央行、国际机构和自动化审计系统的案例，展示了句法委托如何用重复性形式结构取代政治行为。
AI.research_question: 当预测系统成为委托的核心时，制度治理中的代理是如何消失的？这种权威无代理的现象对问责制有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着预测系统和自动化决策在制度治理中的广泛应用，传统基于人类决策者的权威和问责机制正在发生根本性变化，需要理论框架来理解这种新型权威形式及其风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: Delegatio Ex Machina（机器委托）理论框架，强调制度权威从决策者向编译规则的转移，句法委托取代政治行为的概念。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，通过中央银行、国际机构和自动化审计系统等案例进行实证说明。
AI.findings: 预测系统的普及导致制度权威不再基于人类决策者，而是嵌入在无需主体参考即可执行的编译规则中，这种句法委托用重复性形式结构取代了政治行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"Delegatio Ex Machina"理论框架，为理解预测社会中权威无代理现象提供了新的理论视角，丰富了制度理论和治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了识别和应对自动化决策系统中问责制风险的框架，有助于改善预测社会的治理机制。

detail.title: Cultural Metasynergy and Diversity in Virtual Environments
detail.abstract: The theory of Cultural Metasynergy proposes an innovative framework for understanding how different virtual environments—the Natureverse, the Sacroverse, the Cosmoverse, the Socioverse, the Polisverse, and the Ultrafantasy —shape digital culture in the metaverse. This article proposes a critical and multidisciplinary approach that explores the interdependence of these spaces in the construction of inclusive communities, citizen participation, spiritual experiences, and creative freedom. From a conceptual, methodological, and normative perspective, it analyzes how cultural metasynergy can strengthen identity, digital ethics, and diversity in emerging virtual worlds.

title: Justice, Power, and Misrecognition: Reclaiming Civic Impact from the Margins of Evaluation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Justice, Power, and Misrecognition: Reclaiming Civic Impact from the Margins of Evaluation
detail.abstract: Civic actors throughout the Global South are crucial in safeguarding rights, transforming institutional structures, and contesting authoritarian tendencies. Yet, their immediate or long term contributions frequently evade recognition within standard monitoring and evaluation (M&E) frameworks. Dominated by managerial logic and echoes of colonial authority, mainstream M&E tends to prioritise quantifiable outcomes and circumscribed forms of “evidence.” This paper intervenes by advancing a decolonial framework, contending that civic impact must be accounted for along three often-neglected dimensions: symbolic significance, legal acknowledgement, and shifts in narrative. Drawing on case studies from civic education, litigation, and social movements, the analysis critiques the prevailing obsession with quantitative metrics and foregrounds the inherently political character of evaluation practices. Rather than advocating for M&E’s abandonment, the argument is for its transformation into a space for solidarity, collective meaning-making, and the cultivation of shared power. Through such a reimagining, evaluation emerges as an accountability tool and a practice capable of reinforcing collective struggles for justice and democratic renewal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个去殖民化的评估框架，认为公民社会影响应从象征意义、法律认可和叙事转变三个被忽视的维度来衡量，批判主流评估对量化指标的迷恋，主张将评估转变为团结、集体意义建构和共享权力培育的空间。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个去殖民化的监测与评估框架来更好地识别和衡量全球南方公民行动者的贡献？
AI.motivation: 主流监测评估框架受管理逻辑和殖民权威影响，过度强调可量化结果，忽视了全球南方公民行动者在权利保障、制度转型和抵制威权倾向方面的重要贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去殖民化理论框架，批判主流评估实践中的殖民性，强调评估的政治性特征。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于公民教育、诉讼和社会运动的案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 公民社会影响需要通过象征意义、法律认可和叙事转变三个维度来全面衡量；主流评估对量化指标的迷恋存在局限性；评估实践具有内在的政治性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个创新的去殖民化评估理论框架，拓展了公民社会影响的理论理解维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了新的评估工具和方法，将评估转变为促进团结、集体意义建构和权力共享的实践空间，支持正义斗争和民主复兴。

title: The LEGO Legacy: How Innovation Drives Success and Growth
affiliations: NodesPay Tekh Pte Ltd

detail.title: The LEGO Legacy: How Innovation Drives Success and Growth
detail.abstract: In current digital age, innovation plays a vital role in an organization to attain competitive advantage. This is applicable to all organizations regardless of which sector they are operating in. This management report focuses on LEGO group, a global leader in toy industry. Since started in 1931, LEGO has gone through significant transitions where innovation had played a vital role in its success. This report analyses LEGO's organization characteristics that enable its innovation process, covers both internal and external factors. This include LEGO's organization culture, leadership style, learning focused environment, and collaborative practices that promote creativity, and continuous improvements. Also, this report covers LEGO's innovation strategies such as open innovation, incremental innovation, and Ansoff matrix. Key partnerships with organizations such as MIT Media Lab, and Universal pictures have given LEGO a chance to expand beyond physical toys. The report also examines LEGO's history of innovation and the struggles that pushed LEGO to reinvent itself. Also, currently LEGO encountering challenges related to product counterfeiting which require LEGO to enforce strict protection methods in order to protect its identity, as well as product design. However despite these challenges, LEGO has significant opportunities that help enhance its market position by focusing on areas such as sustainability, digital transformation, and inclusive innovation.

AI.tldr: 本报告分析乐高集团如何通过组织文化、领导力、学习环境和合作实践等内部外部因素推动创新，探讨其开放创新、渐进式创新等策略，以及面临的假冒产品挑战和可持续发展等机遇。
AI.research_question: 乐高集团的组织特征如何促使其创新过程成功？
AI.motivation: 在数字化时代，创新对组织获得竞争优势至关重要，乐高作为玩具行业全球领导者，其创新历程具有重要研究价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织创新理论、开放创新理论、Ansoff矩阵理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过对乐高集团的历史发展、组织特征和创新策略进行深入分析
AI.findings: 乐高通过独特的组织文化、学习型环境、领导风格和合作实践成功推动创新；采用开放创新和渐进式创新策略；与MIT媒体实验室等关键伙伴合作扩展业务范围
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了组织创新理论在传统制造业的应用案例，提供了开放创新在玩具行业的具体实践证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他组织提供可借鉴的创新管理实践，包括如何构建创新友好的组织环境、应对外部挑战以及把握市场机遇

title: Navigating Precarity: Organizational Diversity in Iran's Industrial Labor
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - Stony Brook, Students

detail.title: Navigating Precarity: Organizational Diversity in Iran's Industrial Labor
detail.abstract: How do workers organize under financialized and repressive labor regimes? This study examines four cases of Iranian industrial labor struggles (Haft-Tappeh Sugarcane Company (HTSC), Iran National Steel Industrial Group (INSIG), Heavy Equipment Production Company (HEPCO), and Chadormalou Mining and Industrial Company (CMIC)) to analyze how workers develop distinct resistance strategies in response to financialization, labor precarity, and state repression. Drawing on social movement theory, industrial relations scholarship, and financialization studies, I argue that workers' organizing strategies are not solely determined by economic hardship but are shaped by prior mobilization experiences, political traditions, and access to broader social networks. Using protest event analysis, archival research, and digital ethnography, this study demonstrates that while financialization weakens traditional unions, it also compels workers to pursue alternative organizing strategies, ranging from grassroots councils and informal alliances to engagement with state-controlled labor institutions. By situating Iran's labor struggles within broader global trends, this study contributes to debates on precarious work, labor agency under financialization, and the role of historical and socio-political contexts in shaping resistance strategies in authoritarian economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析伊朗四个工业劳工抗争案例，探讨工人在金融化和高压劳动体制下的组织策略，发现工人的抵抗策略不仅由经济困境决定，还受到先前动员经验、政治传统和社会网络的影响。
AI.research_question: 工人在金融化和高压劳动体制下如何组织？
AI.motivation: 研究金融化、劳动力不稳定和国家镇压背景下工人的组织策略，填补对专制经济体劳工抗争研究的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会运动理论、劳资关系研究和金融化研究
AI.method: 抗议事件分析、档案研究和数字民族志
AI.findings: 金融化削弱传统工会，但迫使工人寻求替代组织策略，包括基层委员会、非正式联盟和与国家控制劳工机构的接触
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融化下的劳工能动性、不稳定工作以及历史和社会政治背景在塑造抵抗策略中的作用等辩论做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解专制经济体中工人组织策略提供了实证案例，对全球劳工运动研究具有参考价值

title: Fan Networks in Women's Sport: An Egocentric Analysis of Social Fans and IsoFans
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst, University of Massachusetts Amherst, University of Massachusetts Amherst and

detail.title: Fan Networks in Women's Sport: An Egocentric Analysis of Social Fans and IsoFans
detail.abstract: Guided by network theory, the purpose of this paper is to explore the consumption networks of Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) fans. Through an egocentric network analysis, the authors utilize hierarchical linear modeling to examine the strength of consumption ties among WNBA fans during the 2019 season. Initial results revealed an unexpected findingthe presence of participants who reported having no fan-to-fan ties, whom we term IsoFans. A second sample of men's basketball fans was then collected to serve as a comparative confirmation of the unexpected result, whereby IsoFans occurred in the men's sport sample at a much lower rate. In the third step of the study, the authors examine the differences between WNBA fans consuming in isolation, IsoFans, and WNBA fans consuming with alters, whom we call Social Fans. Results from the hierarchical linear modeling of Social Fans revealed that attributes of both ego (i.e., focal fan) and alter (i.e., individual with whom ego shares a tie) affect the strength of fan-to-fan ties within the women's sport context.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于网络理论，通过自我中心网络分析探索WNBA球迷的消费网络，发现了独特的IsoFans现象（无球迷间联系的孤立球迷），并通过比较男子篮球球迷样本验证了这一现象的独特性，最后分析了社会球迷与孤立球迷的差异及其影响因素。
AI.research_question: WNBA球迷的消费网络特征是什么？女性体育背景下球迷间联系强度的决定因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 探索女性体育背景下球迷消费行为的网络特征，特别是球迷间联系的形成机制和强度影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络理论，特别是自我中心网络分析和联系强度理论。
AI.method: 采用分层线性建模的自我中心网络分析方法，分三步：首先分析WNBA球迷样本，然后收集男子篮球球迷样本进行对比验证，最后比较孤立球迷与社会球迷的差异。
AI.findings: 1）发现了独特的IsoFans现象（无球迷间联系的孤立球迷）；2）IsoFans在男子体育样本中出现率显著较低；3）社会球迷的联系强度同时受到自我（焦点球迷）和他人（联系对象）属性的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了网络理论在体育消费领域的应用，提出了IsoFans这一新概念，丰富了女性体育消费研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为WNBA和其他女性体育组织提供了关于球迷消费行为模式的深入洞察，有助于制定更有效的球迷互动和营销策略。

title: An Anthology of Interference in Law School Clinics
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - School of Law and Washington University in St. Louis - School of Law

detail.title: An Anthology of Interference in Law School Clinics
detail.abstract: An Anthology of Interference in Law School Clinics explores interference in law school clinics in the United States, addressing its long history and the legal ethics, academic freedom, and First Amendment responses to that interference. Law clinics have faced interference in their representation of clients from elected officials, business groups, alumni and, at times, even their own school administrators. This interference has targeted clinics for providing individuals and nongovernmental organizations with legal representation on important matters, including racial and gender discrimination, environmental issues, prisoner rights litigation, death penalty cases, and immigration and human rights matters. In each instance, the interference has sought to subvert the legal process by preventing clinics from representing their clients rather than addressing the legal merits of their clinic clients’ claims. Interference with law clinic client representation also appears to be part of the broader attacks on public interest lawyers and other lawyers representing clients in disputes with governmental entities, business interest, or other more powerful adversaries. This book is designed to serve as a reference and resource to address future interference.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国法学院诊所面临的干预问题，分析其历史背景、法律伦理影响以及学术自由和第一修正案的应对措施，旨在为未来干预提供参考资源。
AI.research_question: 美国法学院诊所面临的外部干预如何影响其客户代理工作，以及法律伦理、学术自由和第一修正案如何应对这种干预？
AI.motivation: 法学院诊所在代理客户时经常面临来自政府官员、商业团体、校友甚至学校管理层的干预，这些干预试图阻止诊所代理重要案件，而非解决案件的法律实质问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律伦理学、学术自由理论、第一修正案法理、公共利益法律实践理论
AI.method: 文献综述和案例分析，通过历史案例和干预实例进行质性研究
AI.findings: 干预主要针对诊所代理种族性别歧视、环境问题、囚犯权利、死刑案件、移民和人权等重要案件；干预试图颠覆法律程序而非解决法律实质问题；这种干预是更广泛攻击公共利益律师的一部分
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了法学院诊所干预现象的理论框架，丰富了法律伦理和学术自由在诊所教育中的应用研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为法学院诊所提供了应对未来干预的参考资源和实践指南，有助于保护诊所教育和客户代理的完整性

title: Sustainable Development: Measuring Progress
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Sustainable Development: Measuring Progress
detail.abstract: This chapter focuses on the new approach to assessing progress towards sustainability based on the application of multicriteria decision-aid tools. Russia was chosen as a case study because of the 20 years of economic and social change, which have had a substantial impact on regional and sectoral patterns of the development of its economy, infrastructure, the quality of the environment, and the well-being of its people. The method is particularly suitable for countries in transition, where development has often been less than harmonious. The chapter employs the UN Sustainable Development Framework of Indicators and assesses the sustainability of Russia using multi-criteria evaluation methods, namely the uncertainty randomization multi-criteria evaluation method "Analysis and Synthesis of Parameters under Information Defi ciency" (ASPID). The analysis covers economic, environmental, and social trends in Russia's development between 1985 and 2007 and assesses the sustainability of this development from the point of view of multiple criteria. The results show the potential of multi-criteria methods for sustainability assessment at the macro level and offer useful insights into the multidimensional nature of sustainability and the role of priority setting in the evaluation process. Such an analysis reveals the degree of harmony in sustainable development policy. It shows how different sets of priorities determine the outcome of multidimensional analysis of sustainability and might potentially help in assessing progress and designing new policy instruments. This chapter is one of the fi rst to apply multi-criteria methods to macro sustainability analysis in a dynamic setting.

AI.tldr: 本章应用多标准决策工具评估俄罗斯可持续发展进展，使用ASPID方法分析1985-2007年经济、环境和社会趋势，揭示多维度可持续性的本质和优先级设置的作用。
AI.research_question: 如何应用多标准决策工具评估转型国家（以俄罗斯为例）的可持续发展进展？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯20年的经济和社会变革对区域和部门发展模式、基础设施、环境质量和人民福祉产生了重大影响，需要新的方法来评估其可持续发展进展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合国可持续发展指标体系框架，多标准决策理论，特别是ASPID（信息不足下参数分析与综合）方法。
AI.method: 采用多标准评估方法，特别是ASPID不确定性随机化多标准评估方法，分析俄罗斯1985-2007年的经济、环境和社会发展趋势。
AI.findings: 多标准方法在宏观层面可持续性评估方面具有潜力，揭示了可持续性的多维性质以及优先级设置在评估过程中的作用，显示了可持续发展政策的协调程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在多标准方法应用于动态环境下的宏观可持续性分析方面做出贡献，为转型国家的可持续发展评估提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估进展和设计新政策工具的方法，展示了不同优先级设置如何影响多维度可持续性分析的结果，有助于实现更协调的可持续发展政策。

title: Time-Series Efficient Factors and the Cross-section of Returns *

detail.title: Time-Series Efficient Factors and the Cross-section of Returns *
detail.abstract: A practical mean-timing approach systematically enhances asset pricing models and generates higher Sharpe ratios across a broad range of assets. Evaluating 206 anomaly portfolios, I document a significant improvement in models that incorporate time-series efficient (TSE) factors for pricing returns. On average, models using TSE factors correctly price 17.6% more anomaly portfolios than original models. This improvement extends beyond renowned asset pricing models; randomly constructed three-factor models using TSE factors outperform their counterparts that employ original factors. Notably, time-series efficient trading strategies exhibit an average 21.7% increase in out-of-sample Sharpe ratios, underscoring their potential value for real-time investors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种实用的均值时序方法，通过时间序列有效(TSE)因子系统性地增强资产定价模型，在206个异常投资组合中显著提高了定价能力，并实现了更高的夏普比率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过时间序列有效因子来提升资产定价模型的定价能力和投资表现？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价模型在解释市场异常现象方面存在局限，需要开发更有效的方法来改进模型性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间序列效率理论，构建时间序列有效(TSE)因子来优化资产定价模型。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，评估206个异常投资组合，比较原始模型和使用TSE因子模型的定价表现。
AI.findings: 使用TSE因子的模型平均多定价17.6%的异常投资组合；随机构建的三因子TSE模型优于原始因子模型；TSE交易策略的样本外夏普比率平均提高21.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了时间序列有效因子的理论框架，为资产定价模型的改进提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实时投资者提供了具有更高风险调整收益的交易策略，显著提升了投资组合的夏普比率。

title: Efficient Large-Scale Intrusion Identification and Prevention in Distributed Cloud Networks Using Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: The Huntington National Bank

detail.title: Efficient Large-Scale Intrusion Identification and Prevention in Distributed Cloud Networks Using Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of distributed cloud networks has significantly increased cybersecurity threats, particularly DDoS attacks that disrupt system stability and performance. An employ of AI-driven solutions is necessary since traditional intrusion detection systems are unable to effectively detect changing assault patterns. This study presents a highly efficient intrusion detection system leveraging the LSTM model trained on the CICDDoS2019 dataset. Comprehensive data preprocessing, including encoding, scaling, and adaptive synthetic sampling (ADASYN), enhances model learning. As compared to more conventional machine learning models like Logistic Regression, ENN, and Bayes CNN, the suggested model achieves a remarkable 99.9 percent accuracy. A model's ability to identify malicious and benign traffic with a high recall and precision of 99.9 percent demonstrates its efficacy in reducing false positives. Confusion matrices, ROC curves, and trends in training-validation loss, among other performance assessment measures, corroborate robust generalization and low overfitting. A dependable solution for intrusion detection and prevention in large-scale cloud networks, LSTM stands out due to its excellent classification capabilities, as shown by comparative analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于LSTM的高效入侵检测系统，在CICDDoS2019数据集上实现了99.9%的准确率，优于传统机器学习方法，为大规模云网络提供了可靠的DDoS攻击检测解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI驱动的LSTM模型有效检测和预防分布式云网络中的DDoS攻击？
AI.motivation: 分布式云网络的快速扩张导致网络安全威胁增加，特别是DDoS攻击破坏系统稳定性和性能，传统入侵检测系统无法有效检测变化的攻击模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习理论，特别是长短期记忆网络(LSTM)在处理序列数据和时间依赖性方面的优势。
AI.method: 使用CICDDoS2019数据集，进行全面的数据预处理（包括编码、缩放和ADASYN采样），构建LSTM模型并与传统机器学习模型（逻辑回归、ENN、贝叶斯CNN）进行比较。
AI.findings: LSTM模型达到99.9%的准确率，召回率和精确率均为99.9%，在恶意和良性流量识别方面表现优异，泛化能力强且过拟合程度低。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了LSTM在网络安全领域的应用价值，为AI驱动的入侵检测提供了理论支持和方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模云网络提供了高效的DDoS攻击检测解决方案，具有高准确率和低误报率，可实际部署用于网络安全防护。

title: EuroSky: Independent Social Media Infrastructure in Europe
affiliations: Supramundane Agency

detail.title: EuroSky: Independent Social Media Infrastructure in Europe

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract:
Any structural system that is hard to replace, has a great diversity of uses, and enables its operator
to enforce rules on its users is infrastructure for the community that relies on it, and critical
infrastructure if its misuse or failure can lead to serious disruptions. Due to its role in informing
people, in providing traffic to media, and setting the political conversation, social media fits this
description.
We can only have a thriving ecosystem of competing social media services, as well as security
and resilience for the European information environment, if the social media infrastructure that we
rely on operates in Europe and under European law. That is not the case. In the current geopolitical
moment, as Europe faces significant threats from both east and west.
Eurosky has the technology, skills, and popular momentum to deliver such infrastructure quickly
and reliably. This makes a European ecosystem of social web services possible that can deliver
democracy, innovation, competitiveness, and societal resilience through pluralism, rooting European
values in infrastructure that can also thrive globally. Most importantly, this future ecosystem is not
merely theoretical; thanks to Bluesky it already has 38 million potential users and is growing fast.
This document details a plan for immediate action that can begin having an impact inside of
2025.

AI.tldr: 本文认为社交媒体是欧洲的关键基础设施，提出建立基于欧洲法律和技术的主权社交媒体生态系统Eurosky，利用Bluesky技术快速构建具有3800万潜在用户的平台，以增强民主、创新和欧洲价值观。
AI.research_question: 如何建立欧洲自主的社交媒体基础设施以应对地缘政治威胁并保护欧洲信息环境？
AI.motivation: 当前社交媒体基础设施主要位于欧洲境外且不受欧洲法律管辖，在欧洲面临东西方威胁的地缘政治时刻，需要建立本土化、受欧洲法律保护的社交媒体基础设施来确保信息安全、民主价值和社会的韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施理论：将社交媒体定义为具有不可替代性、用途多样性和规则执行能力的关键基础设施；数字主权理论：强调技术基础设施对国家主权和价值观保护的重要性。
AI.method: 提案分析法，基于现有技术（Bluesky）和用户基础（3800万潜在用户），提出具体的实施计划和时间表（2025年内见效）。
AI.findings: Eurosky具备快速可靠地交付欧洲社交媒体基础设施的技术能力和用户基础，能够通过多元化实现民主、创新、竞争力和社会韧性。

title: Navigating Divergent Institutional Interests Across the Banking Regulatory Landscape
affiliations: Greenberg Traurig, LLP and University of Nevada, William S. Boyd School of Law

detail.title: Navigating Divergent Institutional Interests Across the Banking Regulatory Landscape

contentType.other: Forthcoming in University of Illinois Law Review

detail.abstract: The collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, as well as the other financial institutions that failed during this time, highlights the risks faced by banks with business models serving a concentrated depositor base. Despite the need to consider differences between banks, policymakers may fail to appreciate significant differences between banking institutions and their business models. This essay differentiates banking institutions and discusses how different business models may influence bank enthusiasm and support for particular reforms.

title: European Union Approaches to Europe's Romani People: The Potential of a Capabilities Approach to Law and Policy Making
affiliations: City University London and University of Sussex

detail.title: European Union Approaches to Europe's Romani People: The Potential of a Capabilities Approach to Law and Policy Making
detail.abstract: This chapter critiques the European Union's efforts to support Romani people in overcoming the disadvantaged positions they hold in EU Member States (MS). It reviews current EU measures and developments and argues that these have produced limited results for the improvement of the lives of Romani people in Europe. The chapter argues that the EU should revise its approach for potentially more effective impacts, by gearing its efforts towards empowering Romani people to take up the opportunities that the EU and its MS offer in a manner which allows them to lead lives of their choosing. To this end, this chapter adopts Sen's capabilities approach as a way forward, which suggests that people need to have the freedom (capability) to choose a variety of lifestyles, and thus require empowerment to make choices and implement these in their lives. The capabilities approach goes beyond having access to goods and services and requires authorities to create the conditions to empower citizens to make effective use of those goods and services. This chapter elaborates on Sen's capabilities theory and assesses whether the EU supports it, and how it might (further) do so in the future. It concludes that to enhance the capabilities of Romani people in the EU, the EU institutions should adopt a multipronged strategy based on: greater use of Article 7 TEU and infringement procedures; the introduction of a hard law, Romani-specific measure; and the creation of a Roma Truth and Reconciliation Commission.

AI.tldr: 本文批判欧盟对罗姆人的支持措施效果有限，建议采用Sen的能力方法，通过赋权让罗姆人自主选择生活方式，并提出三项具体政策建议。
AI.research_question: 欧盟如何通过修订其方法，更有效地支持罗姆人克服在欧盟成员国中的不利地位？

AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，评估欧盟现有措施并基于能力方法提出改进建议。
AI.findings: 欧盟现有措施对改善罗姆人生活成效有限，需要转向赋权导向的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Sen的能力方法应用于欧盟罗姆人政策分析，为该领域提供了新的理论视角。

title: Resistance to Doing Right: Rising Cost of Misconduct from Body-Worn Cameras Adoption and its Unintended Consequences for De-Policing and Crime in Vulnerable Areas
affiliations: Centro de Estudos das Cidades do Insper and Centro de Estudos das Cidades do Insper

detail.title: Resistance to Doing Right: Rising Cost of Misconduct from Body-Worn Cameras Adoption and its Unintended Consequences for De-Policing and Crime in Vulnerable Areas
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of body-worn cameras (BWCs) on police behavior in São Paulo, Brazil, focusing on de-policing: a decline in proactive policing in response to criticism or the threat of punishment. Although BWCs have been widely studied for their effects on police violence and accountability, their unintended consequences on police retreat and consequently crime rates remain underexplored, especially in Brazil. Using a quasi-experiment methodology, we find strong evidence of de-policing in areas where BWCs were implemented, accompanied by a notable increase in crime. These findings address a critical gap in the literature and highlight the complex and unexpected effects of BWC adoption.

AI.tldr: 巴西圣保罗警察佩戴执法记录仪导致消极执法现象，犯罪率显著上升
AI.research_question: 执法记录仪对巴西圣保罗警察行为的影响，特别是对消极执法现象的影响

title: A Comparative Study on Carbon Tax Resistance: Mitigating the Impact of Job Risk Beliefs through Information and Worker Compensation
affiliations: University of Basel - Faculty of Business and Economics,  and University of Bern

detail.title: A Comparative Study on Carbon Tax Resistance: Mitigating the Impact of Job Risk Beliefs through Information and Worker Compensation
detail.abstract: The implementation of disruptive policies requires public support, but they are often politically contested. Carbon taxes are cost-effective climate policies, but remain broadly unpopular, particularly due to concerns about potential policy-induced job risks. The claim that carbon taxes destroy jobs, leveraged by the opposition, lacks strong empirical support. However, this narrative persists, resonating both with workers who genuinely fear job displacement and with individuals who adopt it as a seemingly rational justification for ideological opposition. We study how beliefs about job risk influence resistance to carbon taxation, investigating two strategies to address concerns related to job risk from carbon taxation: information and compensation. We conduct two online survey experiments (N=5,487) in four countries: Germany, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United States. First, we use an information provision experiment to confront workers with policy-induced job risk based on their job profiles. We assess their tendency to update job risk beliefs based on ideological predispositions. Second, using a conjoint choice experiment, we analyze whether packaging carbon taxes with different types of compensation schemes for fossil fuel workers increases public support. Our findings reveal that job risks associated with climate policy tend to be exaggerated in the public. However, efforts to counter these concerns with information campaigns have limited effect on carbon tax support. Notably, they can introduce even more polarized views into the discourse because of selective information take-up rooted in directional motivated reasoning. In contrast, offering compensation to at-risk workers via labor market programs (e.g., retraining programs) increases the support for carbon taxation both among at-risk workers and in the wider public. The positive effect of packaging outweighs the negative effect of a change in the tax rate from 10 to 50 USD/tCO2. While certain uses of carbon tax revenue, such as earmarking for climate protection or supporting low-income households, widen the political divide between the left and right, compensation for fossil fuel workers increases support across the political spectrum. Our study underscores the importance of understanding how economic concerns, belief systems, and political ideology interact to shape public responses to disruptive policies, particularly in politically polarized contexts.

AI.tldr: 研究发现公众对碳税带来的就业风险存在夸大认知，信息宣传活动效果有限且可能加剧观点极化，而通过劳动力市场项目为高风险工人提供补偿能有效提升碳税支持度，且这种补偿方案能跨越政治光谱获得支持。
AI.research_question: 关于就业风险的信念如何影响对碳税的抵制？如何通过信息和补偿策略来解决碳税相关的就业风险担忧？
AI.motivation: 破坏性政策需要公众支持但往往面临政治争议，碳税作为成本有效的气候政策却因就业风险担忧而不受欢迎，尽管缺乏实证支持，这种叙事仍然持续存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 方向性动机推理理论，意识形态倾向对信息接收的影响，经济关切与政治意识形态的交互作用
AI.method: 两个在线调查实验（N=5,487），在德国、瑞典、瑞士和美国四个国家进行：1）信息提供实验评估基于意识形态倾向更新就业风险信念的倾向；2）联合选择实验分析不同类型补偿方案对碳税支持度的影响
AI.findings: 公众倾向于夸大气候政策相关的就业风险；信息宣传活动对碳税支持度影响有限，且可能因选择性信息接收而加剧观点极化；为高风险工人提供劳动力市场补偿能显著提升碳税支持度，其正面效应超过税率变化（10-50美元/吨CO2）的负面影响；补偿方案能跨越政治光谱获得支持
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了经济关切、信念体系和意识形态如何交互影响公众对破坏性政策的反应，特别是在政治极化背景下；验证了方向性动机推理理论在环境政策领域的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了有效策略：通过劳动力市场补偿方案而非信息宣传来提升碳税接受度；证明了补偿方案能跨越政治分歧获得广泛支持，为碳税实施提供了可行的政治解决方案

title: Fiscal Consolidation: Lessons for the U.S
affiliations: Brookings Institution , Brookings Institution and London School of Economics

detail.title: Fiscal Consolidation: Lessons for the U.S
detail.abstract: How should the U.S. respond to its unsustainable fiscal outlook? How and when a country should fiscally consolidate depends on its existing circumstances, policies, and institutions. We review the experiences of other countries that attempted consolidations and highlight lessons applicable to the U.S. We find that (a) the U.S. does not face a short-term crisis, so it can employ gradual adjustments, which may minimize short-term harm, (b) consolidation should occur in a strong economy with monetary accommodation, and (c) tax increases (spending cuts) could plausibly play a larger (smaller) role in US consolidations than in European adjustments.

title: Using Did_Multiplegt_Stat to Estimate Static Treatment Effects in Complex Designs: Overview, and Two Examples Based on Real Datasets
affiliations: Princeton University - Princeton School of Public and International Affairs, SciencesPo - Sciences Po - Department of Economics, Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST), National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies (INSEE) - Center for Research in Economics and Statistics (CREST) and University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Using Did_Multiplegt_Stat to Estimate Static Treatment Effects in Complex Designs: Overview, and Two Examples Based on Real Datasets
detail.abstract:
This paper presents the did_multiplegt_stat Stata command, available from the SSC repos-
itory (ssc install did_multiplegt_stat). The command computes estimators proposed by
de Chaisemartin et al. (2025), de Chaisemartin and D’Haultfœuille (2020), and de Chaisemartin
and D’Haultfœuille (2023). It can be used with a binary, discrete, or continuous treatment, and
the treatment can be continuous at all time periods including the first one in the data. For the
command to be applicable, only one condition needs to hold: the data should contain one pair
of consecutive time periods between which the treatment of some units, the stayers, does not
change. The baseline estimators computed by the command assume a static model: the outcome
does not depend on the treatment’s lags. The command has options that one can use to partly
relax this assumption. It can also be used when there are several treatment variables, and one
wants to estimate the effect of a treatment controlling for the other treatments. Finally, it can
compute IV-DID estimators, under a parallel-trends assumption with respect to an instrument
rather than the treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了did_multiplegt_stat Stata命令，用于计算多种DID估计量，支持二元、离散或连续处理变量，并可在静态模型和部分动态设定下使用。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个灵活的Stata命令来计算多种差分中的差分（DID）估计量，以处理不同类型的处理变量和数据条件？
AI.motivation: 现有的DID方法在处理连续处理变量、多个处理变量以及动态设定时存在局限性，需要开发一个更通用的工具来满足实证研究的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于de Chaisemartin等人的DID理论框架，包括静态模型假设、平行趋势假设以及工具变量DID方法。
AI.method: 开发Stata命令did_multiplegt_stat，实现多种DID估计量的计算，支持二进制、离散和连续处理变量，并提供处理动态设定和多个处理变量的选项。
AI.findings: 成功开发了一个灵活的Stata命令，能够处理各种类型的处理变量和数据条件，为实证研究者提供了强大的DID分析工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了DID方法的应用范围，提供了处理连续处理变量和多个处理变量的理论框架，并引入了工具变量DID的新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了一个易于使用的Stata命令，大大简化了DID分析的实施过程，支持更复杂的研究设计。

title: Optimal Ridge Regressions are Singular Value Decomposition
affiliations: AbleMarkets.com

detail.title: Optimal Ridge Regressions are Singular Value Decomposition
detail.abstract: Researchers often need to identify which variables matter most when analyzing data, a challenge known as feature selection. Ridge regression has been widely used to select the most important features. Meanwhile, eigenvalue-based methods have become increasingly popular for uncovering the underlying simplified structure hidden within complex datasets. This paper shows that eigenvalue methods are, in fact, optimal ridge regression models. Eigenvalue approaches offer a principled way to achieve superior penalized regression outcomes. Ridge Regression (Hoerl and Kennard (1970), McDonald and Schwing (1973)) is a mainstay feature selection methodology in machine learning. Ridge regression uses a quadratic penalty function to minimize the influence of selected variables or features, while prominently highlighting other features. The process of identifying the most significant features is called feature selection. Recent studies using ridge regressions include Elmachtoub and Grigas (2022) and Bertsimas et al. (2018). However, machine learning methods and ridge regression in particular are often criticized for their lack of transparency: human decision makers have a hard time trusting suggestions that they do not fully understand. The complex machine learning algorithms that are not easily interpretable are often referred to as "black-box" models, the black box being a prop often used by on-stage magicians. A black box financial forecast generated by a neural network may have an impressive backtest on historical data, but without being properly understood by human decision makers, it may end up being ignored. This paper shows that the technique known as Singular Value Decomposition (Crone (1972) and others) is the optimal specification of a Ridge Regression.

AI.tldr: 本研究表明特征值方法（如奇异值分解）实际上是最优的岭回归模型，为特征选择提供了理论基础和透明度提升。

AI.motivation: 解决机器学习中岭回归等方法的"黑箱"问题，提高模型透明度和可解释性，使决策者能够更好地理解和信任模型结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于岭回归理论（Hoerl和Kennard，1970）和奇异值分解理论（Crone，1972），建立特征值方法与岭回归的最优性关系。
AI.method: 理论分析和数学推导，证明奇异值分解是岭回归的最优规范。
AI.findings: 特征值方法（特别是奇异值分解）确实是最优的岭回归模型，能够提供更好的惩罚回归结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了特征值方法与岭回归之间的理论联系，证明了奇异值分解作为最优岭回归规范的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特征选择提供了更透明、可解释的方法，帮助决策者更好地理解和信任机器学习模型的输出结果，减少"黑箱"问题。

title: State Control and Global Fragmentation
affiliations: California Institute of Technology

detail.title: State Control and Global Fragmentation
detail.abstract: How can American capitalism compete globally with Chinese socialism? I study this question in a strategic trade model of hegemonic competition. Because the Chinese government controls a vast share of national wealth, it can provide broad-based subsidies that shift profits from American to Chinese firms. China cannot credibly commit to restraint, and thus, the U.S. may ultimately find it optimal to fragment the global economy into exclusive trading blocs. This shields American firms from subsidized competition but reduces welfare in the rest of the world. The analysis highlights how extensive state control over resources undermines the sustainability of great power cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过战略贸易模型分析中美霸权竞争，发现中国政府控制大量国家财富能够提供广泛补贴，将利润从美国企业转移到中国企业。由于中国无法可信地承诺克制，美国最终可能选择将全球经济分裂为排他性贸易集团，以保护美国企业免受补贴竞争，但这会降低世界其他地区的福利。
AI.research_question: 美国资本主义如何在全球范围内与中国社会主义竞争？
AI.motivation: 研究中美两种不同经济体制在全球竞争中的动态和影响，特别是国家控制资源对大国合作可持续性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略贸易模型和霸权竞争理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析
AI.findings: 中国政府控制大量国家财富使其能够提供广泛补贴，转移利润；中国无法可信承诺克制；美国可能选择经济分裂为贸易集团；这种分裂保护美国企业但降低全球福利
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了广泛国家资源控制如何破坏大国合作的可持续性，为理解不同经济体制的全球竞争提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于中美经济竞争动态的见解，指出了全球经济分裂的可能性和后果

title: Energy big data center and firm green innovation
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology, University of International Business and Economics and Monash University

detail.title: Energy big data center and firm green innovation
detail.abstract: We use data for a large sample of Chinese firms over the 2017-2022 period to show that the establishment of Energy Big Data Center (EBDC) positively influences Green Innovation (GI) performance. The impact is notably stronger in firms located in regions where there is greater public attention on air quality and in the eastern region. Moreover, the effect is amplified for companies with less negative news coverage and those with strong environmental management systems. Additional evidence reveals that the EBDC contributes to an increase in both utility and invention green patents and overall number of patents granted to a company. Our findings suggest that the EBDC promotes GI by enhancing energy efficiency diagnostics, thereby facilitating green transformation in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 能源大数据中心的建立通过提升能源效率诊断能力，显著促进中国企业的绿色创新绩效，特别是在空气质量关注度高、东部地区、负面新闻少和环境管理体系强的企业中效果更明显
AI.research_question: 能源大数据中心（EBDC）的建立如何影响企业的绿色创新（GI）绩效？
AI.motivation: 探讨新兴经济体中数字基础设施（如EBDC）对促进企业绿色转型和创新表现的作用机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字基础设施与绿色创新关系的理论框架，结合环境管理和公众关注度的调节作用
AI.method: 使用2017-2022年中国大型企业样本数据，采用实证分析方法

title: Valuing MicroStrategy
affiliations: University of Miami - Department of Finance, University of Miami and Florida International University

detail.title: Valuing MicroStrategy
detail.abstract: Bitcoin treasury stocks present a novel situation in which a firm's assets and equity are traded independently. Surprisingly, the market value of equity can at times be significantly larger than the market value of assets. We build a continuous--time structural credit model to replicate this pattern, assuming the firm is able to issue new debt at a premium to fair value during a "hype state", thereby violating Modigliani-Miller conditions.  This violation creates a "financing franchise"' owned by shareholders that can be valuable enough to push the market value of equity above the market value of the assets. Our model is consistent with data showing that limits to arbitrage bind for MicroStrategy's debt but not for its equity.

AI.tldr: 比特币储备股创造了一种新情况：公司资产和股权独立交易，股权市值有时显著高于资产市值。我们建立连续时间结构信用模型来解释这种现象，假设公司在"炒作状态"下能以高于公允价值的溢价发行新债务，从而违反莫迪利亚尼-米勒条件。这种违反创造了属于股东的"融资特许权"，其价值足以使股权市值超过资产市值。模型与数据显示MicroStrategy债务存在套利限制但股权没有的现象一致。
AI.research_question: 为什么比特币储备股公司的股权市值有时会显著高于其资产市值？
AI.motivation: 比特币储备股创造了一种资产和股权独立交易的新情况，传统金融理论无法解释股权市值超过资产市值的现象
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构信用模型、莫迪利亚尼-米勒定理、融资特许权价值理论
AI.method: 连续时间结构信用模型构建，假设公司在"炒作状态"下能以溢价发行新债务
AI.findings: 公司能够在炒作状态下以高于公允价值的溢价发行新债务，违反MM条件，创造有价值的融资特许权，使股权市值超过资产市值
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了融资特许权概念，扩展了结构信用模型，解释了违反MM定理条件下的股权估值异常
AI.practical_contributions: 为比特币储备股等新型资产配置公司的估值提供了理论框架，解释了MicroStrategy等公司的市场现象

title: Environmental Penalty and Cost of Debt: Evidence from Chinese Firms
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Moore School of Business, Renmin University of China, School of Business, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - China Center for Internet Economy Research and Renmin University of China - School of Business

detail.title: Environmental Penalty and Cost of Debt: Evidence from Chinese Firms
detail.abstract: We examine the impact of the environmental penalty announced within one month before the date of the bond issue on its interest rate in the Chinese bond market. We find a significant rise in the cost of the bond when the issuer is punished by environmental protection agencies. This effect is particularly pronounced among non-SOEs, lowpolluting firms, and companies attracting greater attention. Additionally, our findings suggest that environmental penalties serve as signals of weak government-enterprise relationship, low accounting quality, and a disregard for long-term investments. Futhermore, we uncover a higher likelihood of firms terminating bond issuance once an environmental penalty is announced during the underwriting process.

title: Biodiversity Loss: New Methods for Evaluating Ecosystems
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Biodiversity Loss: New Methods for Evaluating Ecosystems
detail.abstract: This chapter summarises research undertaken to develop a methodology for a multi-criteria assessment of biodiversity which takes into account a multitude of criteria and stakeholder perspectives. The proposed methodology will be of particular value for developing countries, where confl icts of interest regarding ecosystems and biodiversity are numerous and often involve businesses, government, local residents, and other stakeholders. The chapter reviews the state of the art in the field of multi-criteria methods and assessment of ecosystems and biodiversity. It presents the results of analytical work undertaken on the basis of interviews carried out in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (PACA) region of France, focusing on biodiversity in the Réserve Naturelle Coussouls de Crau. The chapter addresses three main issues: selection of the multi-criteria assessment method, selection of the assessment criteria, and a comparison of stakeholder interests in the context of biodiversity analysis. The identifi cation of potential decision criteria was based on a survey of key stakeholders, namely the Management of the Réserve Naturelle Coussouls de Crau; the Muséum National d'Histoire Naturelle, a national biodiversity research institution; the Laissez-faire Association, protecting the interests of the agricultural community; CDC Biodiversité (a branch of Caisse des Dépôts), a group carrying out long-term investments in the public interest; and the Direction regionale de l'environnement Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (DIREN-PACA). Based on these interviews, 14 ecological, nine economic, and 12 social criteria were identifi ed. Further analysis revealed very few points of overlap among the interests of the stakeholders, which complicates the case for consensus building. Not accepting the idea that the value of ecosystems and biodiversity can be expressed in monetary terms, the author suggests an alternative, more inclusive approach, focusing on multiple social, economic, and ecological dimensions of ecosystem value, and illustrates the existence of divergent interests among stakeholders. This experience would be particularly useful in situations where local communities have to defend their right to a clean environment and preserve important virgin ecosystems for future generations.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种考虑多标准和利益相关者视角的生物多样性多标准评估方法，特别适用于发展中国家。通过法国PACA地区的案例研究，识别了生态、经济和社会三类评估标准，发现利益相关者间共识很少，提出了非货币化的包容性评估方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够综合考虑多标准和利益相关者视角的生物多样性评估方法？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家在生态系统和生物多样性方面存在众多利益冲突，涉及企业、政府、当地居民等多方利益相关者，需要一种包容性的评估方法来解决这些冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多标准决策理论、利益相关者理论、生态系统价值评估理论
AI.method: 文献综述结合实证研究，通过对法国PACA地区Réserve Naturelle Coussouls de Crau保护区的关键利益相关者访谈，识别评估标准并分析利益相关者立场。
AI.findings: 识别出14个生态标准、9个经济标准和12个社会标准；发现利益相关者之间利益重叠很少，共识构建困难；证明生态系统价值不能仅用货币化表达。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了非货币化的生物多样性多标准评估框架，丰富了生态系统价值评估的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家解决生物多样性保护中的利益冲突提供了实用工具；特别适用于当地社区维护清洁环境权利和保护原始生态系统的场景。
