detail.abstract:
The Doctrine of Strategic Parity (DSP) advances a generational reframing of elections as constitutional-class infrastructure and global public goods. It begins from the premise that electoral instability is not merely a domestic irregularity but a contagion vector—capable of catalyzing regional insecurity, distorting trade flows, destabilizing migration patterns, and eroding sovereign credit markets. While many forms of infrastructure underpin sovereignty, elections are sui generis: they alone constitute the “gateway right”—the right upon which all others depend—anchored in Reynolds v. Sims, 377 U.S. 533 (1964), and Article 25 of the ICCPR. From this vantage, electoral legitimacy emerges as both a domestic guarantee of sovereignty and a treaty-anchored asset of international stability.

DSP grounds this elevation in jus cogens norms, the UN Charter (Arts. 1, 2, 55), and
comparative jurisprudence (Bush v. Gore, 531 U.S. 98 (2000); Kenya 2007; Ukraine 2004).
Precedent from Missouri v. Holland, 252 U.S. 416 (1920), reinforced by ICJ interpretations of
treaty supremacy (Nicaragua v. United States, 1986), underscores that treaty-backed
interoperability can elevate electoral proofs into a legally inescapable category of international
obligation. Within this framework, SingularVote™ functions as a sovereignty-proof, blockchainverifiable,
and treaty-compatible system that compresses the Time-to-Disproof (TTD) of
electoral fraud by 80–90%. Doctrinally, this collapses the lag between allegation and disproof,
transforming politically contestable narratives into legally cognizable proofs. Economically, DSP
introduces the Stability-Augmented Solow Model (SASM), integrating electoral stability as a
fourth factor of production alongside capital, labor, and technology. Corridor deployments
validate the model empirically: Georgia’s stabilization yields GDP lifts of $1.3–$2.0B, Mexico’s
TTD compression avoids ≈$3.26B in litigation and enforcement costs, South Africa’s chokepoint
resilience averts ≈$300–450B in global GDP losses during dual maritime crises, and Japan’s
biometric export hub generates ≈$1.8–2.9B in annual GDP gains. These data confirm that
stability functions as a reproducible multiplier of growth, sovereign risk compression, and
corridor security.
At its technological core, DSP operationalizes SingularVote™ as a sovereignty-proof stack
integrating blockchain-anchored ledgers, hardware-agnostic modularity, biometric palm-vein and
touchscreen authentication, and treaty-compliant interoperability protocols. Each VOTE-1
terminal generates immutable, cryptographically anchored audit trails that satisfy evidentiary
thresholds under Fed. R. Evid. 902(13), Mexico’s CNPP, and South Africa’s SAPS protocols.
The stack embeds zero-knowledge proofs for privacy-preserving validation, consensus
algorithms for immutability, and—most critically—the first warrant-gated federal electoral
record system in U.S. history, the Federally Protected Electoral Record Ledger (FPERL). This
system ensures that electoral data is both constitutionally shielded and judicially accessible under
warrant, balancing civil liberties with prosecutorial certainty. By collapsing the divide between
code and law, SingularVote™ produces digital artifacts that are simultaneously technically
unalterable and legally enforceable—an engineering achievement functioning as a constitutional
instrument.

Strategically, DSP integrates electoral legitimacy into U.S. grand strategy and multilateral
diplomacy. Sovereignty is secured through national command of infrastructure, while treaty
recognition enables recursive trust loops across NATO, USMCA, AfCFTA, and Indo-Pacific
frameworks. For the Department of State, DSP supplies a reproducible conflict-prevention
mechanism aligned with UN peacebuilding doctrine and Sustainable Development Goal 16,
reducing instability spillovers that drive migration, trafficking, and hybrid warfare. For allied
cohesion, the doctrine extends from lex mercatoria toward a nascent lex democratia: the
codification of electoral audit trails as enforceable objects within international law.

AI.tldr: 《战略对等学说》将选举重新定义为宪法级基础设施和全球公共产品，提出选举不稳定不仅是国内问题，更是影响区域安全、贸易、移民和主权信用的传染源。该学说基于国际法准则和区块链技术SingularVote™，将选举合法性提升为国际义务，并通过实证数据证明选举稳定对经济增长的重要作用。

title: Understanding Yemen Beyond Simplistic Narratives: A Critical Response to Michael Rubin
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Understanding Yemen Beyond Simplistic Narratives: A Critical Response to Michael Rubin

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or personal data were involved in this study. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: This paper critically engages with Michael Rubin’s analysis of Yemen, challenging its reliance on simplistic frameworks that overlook the country’s historical, tribal, and socio-political complexities. By examining Yemen through the lenses of local agency, regional power struggles, and global security narratives, the study highlights how reductionist interpretations often reinforce external agendas rather than capture realities on the ground. It offers a nuanced account of Yemen’s conflicts, situating them within broader debates on Middle Eastern politics, identity, and international relations.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析Michael Rubin对也门的研究，指出其简化框架忽视了该国的历史、部落和社会政治复杂性，通过本地能动性、区域权力斗争和全球安全叙事的视角，揭示简化解释如何强化外部议程而非反映现实。

title: Package Restructuring and the Pricing of Sovereign Debt
affiliations: HEC Montreal - Department of Finance and HEC Montreal

detail.title: Package Restructuring and the Pricing of Sovereign Debt
detail.abstract: Sovereign debt renegotiation agreements have generalized the practice of package restructuring -a form of debt relief combining rescheduling and write-off. The paper provides a contingent claims model with a closed-form expression for sovereign debt value and a bargaining game that rationalizes package restructurings as optimal renegotiation deals. It further shows how the parameters of the restructuring deal can be inferred from market information. A maximum likelihood inference from EMBI spread series is applied to four countries yielding realistic renegotiation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文通过或有债权模型和讨价还价博弈理论，解释了主权债务重组中打包重组（结合展期和减记）的最优性，并提出了从市场信息推断重组参数的方法，通过EMBI利差序列的最大似然推断在四个国家得到了现实的重组结果。
AI.research_question: 主权债务重组中打包重组（package restructuring）为何是最优的重新谈判协议？如何从市场信息推断重组参数？
AI.motivation: 主权债务重新谈判协议普遍采用打包重组形式（结合债务展期和减记），需要理论模型来解释这种做法的合理性并提供实用的参数推断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 或有债权模型（contingent claims model）和讨价还价博弈理论（bargaining game theory）
AI.method: 1. 建立主权债务价值的闭式表达式模型；2. 构建讨价还价博弈框架；3. 使用最大似然法从EMBI利差序列推断重组参数
AI.findings: 打包重组被证明是最优的重新谈判协议，模型参数可以从市场信息中有效推断，在四个国家的实证应用中得到了现实的重组结果
AI.theory_contributions: 为打包重组提供了理论解释，证明了其最优性，建立了从市场信息推断重组参数的完整理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的重组参数推断方法，可用于实际债务重组谈判，帮助决策者制定更优的重组方案

title: How Do Gambling Laws Influence Cryptocurrency Prices?∗
affiliations: and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: How Do Gambling Laws Influence Cryptocurrency Prices?∗
detail.abstract: This paper documents a triangular trade through cryptocurrencies that enables access to legally restricted gambling markets. We investigate whether cryptocurrencies exhibit a legal premium by studying changes to US gambling laws. A major Supreme Court decision and subsequent state laws expand legal sports betting markets. We use these natural experiments to implement a stacked event study. Our estimates show cryptocurrencies have substantial negative abnormal returns when legal gambling markets expand, consistent with a diminished legal premium. The findings highlight that cryptocurrency valuations depend on how the legal environment shapes access to real economic activity.

title: Xenophobic Violence and Foreigner Integration. A Framework and Evidence from 19th-century France
affiliations: Sciences Po, médialab and London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Government

detail.title: Xenophobic Violence and Foreigner Integration. A Framework and Evidence from 19th-century France
detail.abstract: Any time, anywhere, foreigners face hostility from the native population and politicians. A large literature has attempted to understand the effect of exposure to violence on foreigners' integration efforts in their host society. Most of the existing studies, however, estimate the effect of violence for the population of foreigners present post-treatment. Using a potential outcome framework, we highlight that the identification assumptions required to estimate this quantity without bias are more stringent than implicitly assumed and likely to be violated in most contexts. We propose an alternative approach: estimating the impact of violence on the population of foreigners present pre-treatment. We show that an unbiased estimate of this estimand can be obtained with a difference-indifferences research design under the usual assumptions for identification. We illustrate how to make use of our framework with the case of violence against Italians in 19th-century France. In particular, our theoretical and empirical approaches stress the importance of considering the heterogeneous responses of foreigners to violence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法来估计暴力对外国人整合的影响，强调需要关注暴力前已存在的外国人群体，而非暴力后留下的群体，以避免选择偏差。通过19世纪法国对意大利人的暴力案例，展示了差异中的差异研究方法。

AI.motivation: 现有研究大多估计暴力对暴力后留下的外国人群体的影响，但这种估计可能存在选择偏差，因为暴力可能导致某些外国人离开，从而影响样本代表性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 潜在结果框架，强调识别假设的严格性和可能违反的情况。
AI.method: 差异中的差异研究设计，关注暴力前已存在的外国人群体。
AI.findings: 通过关注暴力前群体，可以获得无偏估计，并强调外国人对外部暴力的异质性反应的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个更严谨的估计框架，强调识别假设的重要性，并提供了处理选择偏差的方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究暴力对外国人整合的影响提供了更可靠的方法论指导，有助于政策制定者更准确地评估暴力事件的社会影响。

title: A Gender Gap in Attitudes Towards Monetary Policy? The Case of Satisfaction with the Bank of England
affiliations: University of Essex - Department of Government

detail.title: A Gender Gap in Attitudes Towards Monetary Policy? The Case of Satisfaction with the Bank of England
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the existence and extent of a gender gap in satisfaction with the Bank of England's performance in controlling inflation. Descriptive data and previous research report gender gaps in attitudes towards monetary institutions and outcomes. Much of this research, however, disregards potential biases arising from women's lower propensity to express an opinion, and to answer "don't know" instead. Using the Bank of England's Inflation Attitudes survey (2001-2025), and modelling selection into substantive answers, I find a statistically significant-yet, substantively small and not persistent-gender gap in satisfaction with the Bank of England. This gender gap remains after controlling for inflation perception and monetary knowledge. I also find that women do not overestimate inflation, and they do not seem to "punish" more harshly the Bank for high inflation or deflation. Therefore, variance in this gender gap can be attributed to a different propensity to report more "extreme" opinions, and to different reactions to high inflation or deflation. These findings highlight gendered dimensions for the understanding of monetary institutions and finance, contributing to the literature on satisfaction with the performance of institutions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现英格兰银行通胀控制满意度存在统计显著但实质较小且不持久的性别差异，这种差异主要源于女性更倾向于表达中性意见而非极端观点，而非通胀认知差异或对高通胀/通缩的不同反应。

AI.method: 使用英格兰银行通胀态度调查数据（2001-2025年），建立实质性回答选择模型，控制通胀感知和货币知识变量。
AI.findings: 1）存在统计显著但实质较小且不持久的性别差异；2）女性不高估通胀；3）女性不对高通胀或通缩更严厉"惩罚"银行；4）差异源于表达极端意见倾向不同和对高通胀/通缩反应不同。

title: The Future of ASEAN Integration: Will ASEAN become the second EU?
affiliations: University of Szeged

detail.title: The Future of ASEAN Integration: Will ASEAN become the second EU?

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Future of ASEAN Economic Integration, Volume 1

detail.abstract: Abstract The EU's achievements are strongly tied to its members' collective dedication to democracy, human rights, a shared historical background, the rule of law, the deepening of economic integration, common values, and the supranationalism system. Conversely, ASEAN encounters a range of diverse scenarios of differences in political systems, historical contexts, values, cultural backgrounds, and demography and faces challenges in achieving uniformity and cooperation. The prioritized principles of ASEAN emphasizenon-interference, quiet diplomacy, non-use of force, and decision-making through consensus. This research examines the future economic integration of the ASEAN regional organization, assessing its historical trajectory and comparing it with the structure of the European Union. It also highlights Cambodia's economic benefits as an ASEAN member state and provides policy recommendations for ASEAN's rapid growth. The methodology of this paper is conducted by a mixed approach of both quantitative and qualitative data analysis. As a result of this paper, there are three main key findings: (1) in the future, ASEAN's potential emergence as a pivotal global center for economic growth, including its GDP and driving factors. (2) The unlikelihood of ASEAN evolving into a second EU, emphasizing its unique principles and approach to integration and (3) the substantial benefits experienced by Cambodia as an ASEAN member state, particularly in open-regionalism relations and economic partnerships.

AI.tldr: 本文比较欧盟与东盟的经济一体化进程，分析东盟未来不太可能成为第二个欧盟，但有望成为全球经济增长中心，并探讨柬埔寨作为东盟成员国的经济收益。
AI.research_question: 东盟区域组织未来经济一体化的前景如何？与欧盟结构相比有何异同？柬埔寨作为东盟成员国获得了哪些经济收益？

AI.theoretical_framework: 区域一体化理论、比较区域主义理论、经济合作与发展理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法，结合定量和定性数据分析
AI.findings: 1) 东盟未来可能成为全球经济增长中心；2) 东盟不太可能演变成第二个欧盟；3) 柬埔寨作为东盟成员国在开放区域主义和经济伙伴关系方面获得实质性收益
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了比较区域一体化理论，特别是对非欧盟模式的一体化路径提供了理论见解
AI.practical_contributions: 为东盟快速成长提供政策建议，为成员国（特别是柬埔寨）参与区域经济合作提供实践指导

title: The Economic Impact of Integrating Mandatory ESG Disclosures into Financial Reports: Evidence from India's BRR Initiative
affiliations: Indian School of Business,  and Naveen Jindal School of Management, UT Dallas

detail.title: The Economic Impact of Integrating Mandatory ESG Disclosures into Financial Reports: Evidence from India's BRR Initiative
detail.abstract: Firms are facing growing scrutiny from institutional investors, regulators, and consumers regarding their Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) practices. However, the lack of standardized and comparable ESG data presents a significant challenge for effectively incorporating these factors into comprehensive firm assessments. Using India's phased implementation of mandatory Business Responsibility Reports (BRRs) in financial filings as a quasi-experimental setting, we demonstrate that required ESG disclosures substantially boost corporate investment in both physical assets and innovation compared to non-mandated firms. The impact is strongest for companies with greater initial information opacity, suggesting that enhanced transparency alleviates informational barriers that traditionally hinder investment decisions. A fundamental challenge in the ESG literature is distinguishing the impact of disclosure mandates from changes in underlying ESG activities. The Indian regulatory structure provides a unique opportunity to examine ESG disclosure effects while addressing this identification challenge. While BRRs are required only for publicly listed companies, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) activities-along with related disclosures-extend to both listed and unlisted entities. This institutional design allows precise identification of the causal role of ESG transparency independent of ESG activity itself. Overall, our results indicate that mandating ESG disclosure embedded within financial statements can stimulate firm investment in capital formation and innovation, potentially contributing to wider economic growth and development.

AI.tldr: 印度强制ESG披露政策显著促进企业投资，特别是对信息不透明的公司效果更明显，研究通过准实验设计解决了ESG披露与活动本身的识别难题
AI.research_question: 强制性ESG披露要求如何影响企业的投资行为？
AI.motivation: 企业面临日益增长的ESG监管压力，但缺乏标准化的ESG数据阻碍了有效评估，需要研究强制披露政策的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、代理理论、ESG披露与投资决策关系理论
AI.method: 利用印度分阶段实施强制性商业责任报告(BRRs)的准实验设计，比较上市与非上市公司在投资行为上的差异
AI.findings: 强制ESG披露显著提高了企业在实物资产和创新方面的投资，对初始信息不透明的公司影响更大
AI.theory_contributions: 解决了ESG文献中区分披露要求与ESG活动本身影响的识别难题，提供了ESG透明度对企业投资影响的因果证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计ESG披露制度提供实证依据，表明将ESG披露嵌入财务报表可以刺激企业投资和经济增长

title: The Impact of Financial Literacy on Business Performance: A Study of Indonesia's Ultra-Micro, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises
affiliations: Bank Indonesia, The Social Monitoring & Early Response Unit Research Institute (SMERU), Bank Indonesia and  Bandung Institute of Technology, Students

detail.title: The Impact of Financial Literacy on Business Performance: A Study of Indonesia's Ultra-Micro, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises
detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of financial literacy in shaping business performance among Ultra Micro, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (UMSMEs). As vital contributors to employment, income generation, and GDP worldwide, these enterprises often struggle to enhance performance due, in part, to limited financial literacy. Using survey data from over 10,000 UMSMEs across 34 provinces in Indonesia, this research employs the fixed effects method to establish causal relationships. The findings demonstrate that improved financial literacy significantly enhances UMSME performance, leading to increased sales, profit margins, and per-employee revenue and profit. While a rise in cost per worker is observed, this is attributed to more accurate and comprehensive accounting practices among financially literate UMSMEs. We identify innovation and the adoption of advanced Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and digital technologies as the key mechanisms through which financial literacy drives these improvements. Furthermore, the study reveals several heterogeneous effects: financial literacy's impact is stronger for ultra-micro firms, women entrepreneurs, informal businesses, adult owners, and those located outside the Java-Bali region. These findings underscore the critical importance of financial literacy for UMSME growth and highlight the need for targeted financial education initiatives to unlock the full potential of diverse enterprise segments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过印度尼西亚10,000多家UMSMEs的调查数据，使用固定效应方法证实金融素养显著提升企业绩效，主要通过创新和数字技术采用实现，且对超微型企业、女性创业者等群体效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 金融素养如何影响超微型、微型、小型和中型企业(UMSMEs)的商业绩效？
AI.motivation: UMSMEs作为就业、收入创造和GDP的重要贡献者，由于金融素养有限而难以提升绩效，需要研究金融素养对其绩效的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融素养理论、企业绩效理论和创新扩散理论，探讨金融素养通过创新和技术采用影响企业绩效的机制。
AI.method: 使用印度尼西亚34个省10,000多家UMSMEs的调查数据，采用固定效应方法建立因果关系。
AI.findings: 提高金融素养显著提升UMSMEs绩效，包括销售额、利润率、人均收入和利润增长；创新和先进ICT及数字技术采用是关键机制；对超微型企业、女性创业者、非正规企业等群体影响更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融素养通过创新和技术采用影响企业绩效的作用机制，丰富了金融素养理论在企业层面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了金融素养对UMSMEs增长的重要性，为针对不同企业群体制定差异化金融教育计划提供了实证依据。

title: Bitcoin is Not Money: Why Fixed Supply Fails in a Modern Economy
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Bitcoin is Not Money: Why Fixed Supply Fails in a Modern Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest. This paper was prepared independently and reflects the sole views of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or clinical interventions requiring ethical approval. All data used in the analysis is publicly available.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no financial support from any funding agency, commercial entity, or institution.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that Bitcoin cannot function as a viable replacement for fiat currency because of its fixed supply. Although Bitcoin offers scarcity and resistance to manipulation, it lacks the monetary elasticity required to support a growing economy. A currency that cannot expand alongside output induces deflation, discourages credit formation, and undermines macroeconomic coordination. The paper reframes the Bitcoin debate in macroeconomic terms, emphasizing that modest, policy-driven inflation is essential for stability. It also distinguishes between monetary expansion and actual devaluation. Bitcoin may serve as a long-term store of value, but its structural rigidity disqualifies it from functioning as money in an economy that depends on flexibility.

AI.tldr: 比特币由于供应量固定，无法替代法定货币，因为缺乏货币弹性来支持经济增长，会导致通货紧缩并破坏宏观经济协调。
AI.research_question: 比特币能否作为法定货币的可行替代品？

title: Unpacking the Distributional Implications of the Energy Crisis: Lessons from the Iberian Electricity Market
affiliations: CEMFI,  and University of Mannheim - Department of Economics

detail.title: Unpacking the Distributional Implications of the Energy Crisis: Lessons from the Iberian Electricity Market

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The 2021-2023 European energy crisis, triggered by the war in Ukraine, led to broad policy interventions in energy markets. In contrast to the retail-side measures and public transfers implemented elsewhere, Spain and Portugal targeted the wholesale electricity market through the so-called Iberian solution. We quantify the distributional implications of the crisis and this market intervention on Spanish electricity firms and across consumer groups. We find that the crisis shifted substantial wealth from consumers to generators, with regressive impacts among consumers. Conversely, the policy’s relief was progressive, delivering larger gains to lower-income groups.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了乌克兰战争引发的欧洲能源危机中西班牙和葡萄牙的电力市场干预政策（伊比利亚解决方案）的分配效应，发现危机导致财富从消费者向发电企业转移且具有累退性，而政策干预则具有累进性，为低收入群体提供了更大收益。
AI.research_question: 西班牙和葡萄牙针对批发电力市场的伊比利亚解决方案政策干预在能源危机期间对电力企业和不同消费者群体的分配影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 2021-2023年欧洲能源危机导致各国采取不同政策干预，西班牙和葡萄牙选择针对批发电力市场的独特解决方案，需要评估这种市场干预的分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源经济学和分配效应理论，分析电力市场干预对生产者和消费者群体的财富转移效应，以及政策干预的累进性或累退性特征。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，通过对比危机前后和政策干预前后的数据，量化评估财富在电力企业和不同收入消费者群体之间的转移效应。
AI.findings: 1）能源危机导致大量财富从消费者向发电企业转移；2）危机影响在消费者群体中呈现累退性（对低收入群体更不利）；3）政策干预具有累进性，为低收入群体提供了更大程度的救济。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了电力市场干预政策的分配效应理论，提供了针对批发市场干预（而非零售端措施）的实证证据，深化了对能源危机中政策选择分配后果的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了伊比利亚解决方案有效性的实证依据，表明针对批发市场的干预可以产生累进性的分配效果，为未来能源危机应对政策设计提供了参考。

title: Remedying Copyright Infringement in Generative AI. What Role for Algorithmic Destruction, Machine Unlearning and Damages?
affiliations: Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) - Department of Law and Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) - Department of Law

detail.title: Remedying Copyright Infringement in Generative AI. What Role for Algorithmic Destruction, Machine Unlearning and Damages?

publicationDetails.detailsText: In: Enrico Bonadio, Péter Mezei and Eduardo Alonso (eds.): The Cambridge Handbook of Generative AI and IP in Europe, Cambridge University Press, 2026 (forthcoming).

detail.abstract: This chapter examines the enforcement of remedies for copyright infringement within the generative AI (GenAI) lifecycle. It focuses on three potential remedial toolsalgorithmic destruction, machine unlearning, and damages-and considers how these measures might be grounded in existing legal frameworks, particularly the one established under Directive 2004/48/EC on the Enforcement of Intellectual Property Rights. The analysis reveals that applying these remedies in GenAI contexts presents a range of legal and technical challenges, especially concerning technical feasibility, effectiveness, and proportionality. Moreover, the implementation of such remedies often intersects with broader policy considerations, including the promotion of innovation and the need to balance the rights of creators with public interests. The chapter argues that no one-size-fitsall solution exists: different types of copyright infringement may require tailored remedial approaches. In some cases, combining remedies-such as pairing damages with targeted machine unlearning-may be most effective for redressing harm and deterring future violations. In other instances, alternative strategies such as input or output filtering may offer more appropriate solutions. Algorithmic destruction should be confined to a very narrow set of cases of massive copyright infringement.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式AI版权侵权救济措施的适用性，分析算法销毁、机器遗忘和损害赔偿三种工具的法律与技术挑战，认为需要根据侵权类型采取定制化救济方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在生成式AI生命周期中有效执行版权侵权救济措施？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI技术的快速发展带来了新的版权侵权问题，现有法律框架下的救济措施在AI语境下面临法律和技术挑战，需要探索适用的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟2004/48/EC指令的知识产权执法框架，结合生成式AI技术特性，构建版权侵权救济的理论分析框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析和理论推演方法，对三种救济工具（算法销毁、机器遗忘、损害赔偿）进行法律和技术可行性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 不同救济措施在技术可行性、有效性和相称性方面存在差异；2) 需要根据侵权类型采取定制化救济方案；3) 组合救济措施（如损害赔偿+定向机器遗忘）可能更有效；4) 算法销毁仅适用于大规模侵权极端情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了知识产权执法理论在AI语境下的应用，提出了生成式AI版权侵权救济的差异化框架，丰富了技术治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和司法实践提供具体指导：1) 建议采用分层救济策略；2) 推荐组合使用不同救济工具；3) 提供技术可行性评估标准；4) 为政策制定平衡创新保护与公共利益提供参考。

title: Composite Credit Risk & Uncertainty Ratings Techno-Managerial AI Expertocracy (V.AI)
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE)

detail.title: Composite Credit Risk & Uncertainty Ratings Techno-Managerial AI Expertocracy (V.AI)
detail.abstract: Widespread, precarious credit risk management and technoscientific, algorithmic expertise precipitating and exacerbating repeated crises remain taken-for-granted and virtually unaccountable. Conspicuous in the ratings space, this paper analyses how geometric-based (sovereign) 'debt sustainability analysis' (DSA) increasingly informs algorithmic/automated decision-making (ADM) fixed-income futurity financialization. An in-depth study of primary-source documentation and semi-structured interviews helps problematize the (neoliberal) political economy of creditworthiness (PEC). Deconstruction/reconstruction of credit rating agency (CRA) and investor hybrid 'default risk/uncertainty' DSA techno-managerial modalities reveals synergistic sociotechnical rating methods/modeling digitalization promotes 'business-as-usual'. Advancing business management scholarship through economic sociology, we document suspect geometrics-dominant ADM/AI 'expertocracy'-knowledge-based expert rule-(re)validation of the organizational conditions and broader market affinities embedding data and ESG imbalances: crisis-prone PEC. Technoscientific ratings constitute and reproduce an (artificial) 'inertia' and mutual (CRA/investor) mitigation effects buffering against serious contestation and reform. Unpacking S&P, Moody's, and Vanguard platforms, we study scores Passive/Active management facilitation in their operational contexts to better explain their analytical, organizational, and normative CRA correspondence. Financial AI machine learning (ML) reinforces (quant) ratings (reflexive) portfolio performance. Entrenching a tenuous (disinflationary) PEC referential/data infrastructure status quo, consequently, AI-ML amplifies global (corporate) expertocracy and national democracy asymmetries. Necessary for rebalanced alternatives, our scrutiny aids disturb seemingly 'self-systemic', 'self-regulating', digital-driven (neoliberal) capitalist agencement PEC dominance. Otherwise, increasingly, market instability, authoritarian populist backlash, and climate crises jeopardize ratings programmatic.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析了信用评级机构和企业债务可持续性分析（DSA）算法如何通过技术科学专家统治强化新自由主义政治经济，揭示了算法决策如何加剧市场不稳定和民主不对称。
AI.research_question: 几何基础的债务可持续性分析（DSA）算法如何通过自动化决策影响固定收益金融化，并强化新自由主义信用worthiness政治经济？
AI.motivation: 广泛存在的 precarious 信用风险管理和技术科学算法专业知识在反复危机中仍被视为理所当然且几乎无法问责，特别是在评级领域需要被问题化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济社会学视角，结合新自由主义政治经济学、技术科学专家统治理论、算法决策理论，以及信用评级机构的 sociotechnical 评级方法。
AI.method: 深度研究原始文献资料和半结构化访谈，解构和重建信用评级机构和投资者的混合'违约风险/不确定性'DSA技术管理模态。
AI.findings: 几何主导的算法决策通过专家统治重新验证了嵌入数据和ESG不平衡的组织条件，创造了人为的'inertia'和相互缓解效应，缓冲了严肃质疑和改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过经济社会学推进商业管理学术，揭示了技术科学评级如何构成和再生产危机倾向的政治经济，以及AI-ML如何放大全球专家统治与民主不对称。
AI.practical_contributions: 解构标普、穆迪和Vanguard平台，研究其被动/主动管理促进机制，为重新平衡替代方案提供必要审视，扰乱看似'自我系统化'的数字驱动资本主义主导。

title: Are Groups More Rational than Individuals? Evidence from Revealed Preference Tests
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Economics (ESE) and University of Vienna - Faculty of Business, Economics, and Statistics

detail.title: Are Groups More Rational than Individuals? Evidence from Revealed Preference Tests

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: University of Vienna

detail.abstract:
Economic analysis assumes that decision makers, whether individuals, households, or committees, behave as if they maximize a utility function when making
choices under risk. We test this assumption by comparing the consistency of group and individual choices in laboratory experiments. We also examine how individual preferences are aggregated when groups form and how group choices influence individual behavior when groups dissolve. Using nonparametric revealed preference tests and related efficiency measures, we find that groups are more consistent with utility maximization and exhibit stronger normative properties under risk, more often respecting first-order stochastic dominance and adhering to expected utility theory. These improvements arise from a “teacher–pupil” dynamic, in which the more rational group member disproportionately influences decisions. Group deliberation thus acts as a corrective mechanism, aligning behavior more closely with consumer theory.

AI.tldr: 通过实验室实验比较群体和个体在风险决策中的一致性，发现群体比个体更符合效用最大化假设，表现出更强的规范性特征，这种改善源于"教师-学生"动态机制。
AI.research_question: 群体决策是否比个体决策更符合效用最大化假设？群体如何形成和解散时个体偏好如何聚合？
AI.motivation: 经济学分析假设决策者（无论是个人、家庭还是委员会）在风险选择中表现得好像最大化效用函数，需要验证这一假设并比较群体与个体决策的一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效用最大化理论、显示偏好理论、期望效用理论、一阶随机占优原则
AI.method: 实验室实验，使用非参数显示偏好检验和相关效率测量方法
AI.findings: 群体比个体更一致地符合效用最大化，表现出更强的规范性特征，更经常尊重一阶随机占优并遵循期望效用理论
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了群体决策作为纠正机制的作用，提出了"教师-学生"动态解释群体理性改善的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为委员会决策、家庭消费选择等集体决策场景提供了实证支持，表明群体讨论能够改善决策质量

title: Neural Operators in Finance: Mathematical Framework and Applications
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute and IES Francisco Ayala

detail.title: Neural Operators in Finance: Mathematical Framework and Applications
detail.abstract: Neural operators are a generalization of neural networks that allows them to learn operators between infinite-dimensional spaces. Neural operators exhibit the property of universal approximators, in the sense that they can approximate any continuous and nonlinear operator. Furthermore, they are discretization-invariant, which allows them to be applied to inputs with different discretizations without the need for retraining. In this paper we provide a detailed overview of the mathematical foundations of neural operators, as well as the different parameterizations that have appeared in the literature. We also introduce a new type of neural operator, based on the application of Mercer's Theorem, which we will call Mercer Neural Operator. Finally, we apply neural operators to three important problems in Finance: American option pricing, dynamic portfolio optimization, and discount curve estimation. In all three applications, neural operators demonstrate significant computational advantages over traditional numerical methods, achieving speed-ups of 4-800x while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy. The Mercer Neural Operator, in particular, shows consistent computational efficiency improvements of 22-41% over existing neural operator architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统介绍了神经算子理论及其在金融领域的应用，提出基于Mercer定理的新型Mercer神经算子，在美式期权定价、动态投资组合优化和贴现曲线估计三个金融问题上实现了4-800倍的计算加速。
AI.research_question: 如何构建更高效的神经算子架构，并将其应用于金融计算问题以提升计算效率？
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法在金融计算中计算成本高昂，神经算子作为无限维空间之间的算子学习方法，具有离散化不变性和通用逼近特性，有望显著提升金融计算的效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经算子理论、通用逼近定理、Mercer定理、算子学习理论
AI.method: 提出基于Mercer定理的新型Mercer神经算子架构，并在三个金融应用场景（美式期权定价、动态投资组合优化、贴现曲线估计）进行实证验证
AI.findings: 神经算子在三个金融应用中实现4-800倍计算加速，Mercer神经算子相比现有架构进一步提升22-41%的计算效率，同时保持相当或更优的精度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于Mercer定理的新型神经算子架构，扩展了神经算子的理论框架和参数化方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融计算提供了高效的计算工具，显著降低了美式期权定价、投资组合优化等复杂金融问题的计算成本

title: Divine Catalysts: Religion and Portfolio Choices
affiliations: London Business School - Department of Finance, Indian Institute of Management (IIMB), Bangalore, London Business School and London Business School

detail.title: Divine Catalysts: Religion and Portfolio Choices
detail.abstract: Does religion shape individual portfolio choices? To answer this question, we examine whether the same individual adjusts their equity portfolio on specific religious days, allowing us to isolate religion-driven investments. Using trading sessions held during a major festival promoting long-term prosperity which act as a cue, we find that individuals who associate with beliefs about the festival invest substantially more on these event days. They buy new stocks, hold them longer, and experience persistent increases in equity account size and diversification post-event. Event-driven purchases represent a larger financial commitment for lower-income individuals and smaller accounts, who subsequently benefit from increased equity exposure. Our findings suggest that religious cues can shape individual long-term investments and wealth accumulation.

AI.tldr: 宗教节日作为提示线索会影响个体投资行为，信徒在宗教节日期间会增加股票投资并长期持有，这种效应在低收入人群中更明显，有助于财富积累
AI.research_question: 宗教是否影响个体投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 探讨宗教因素如何影响个人投资决策，特别是通过宗教节日这一特定线索来观察投资行为变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、宗教经济学、心理账户理论
AI.method: 利用宗教节日期间的交易数据，分析同一投资者在宗教节日和非宗教节日的投资行为差异
AI.findings: 宗教信徒在宗教节日期间显著增加股票投资，购买新股并长期持有，投资组合规模和分散化程度在节后持续增加，低收入人群和小账户投资者受益更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 为宗教对经济行为的影响提供了实证证据，拓展了行为金融学中非理性因素对投资决策影响的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解宗教因素在个人财富积累中的作用，为金融机构提供投资者行为洞察，有助于设计更适合不同信仰群体的投资产品

title: Information Processing Efficiency, Analyst Behavior, and Predictable Returns
affiliations: University of Miami - Miami Herbert Business School and University of Oxford - Said Business School

detail.title: Information Processing Efficiency, Analyst Behavior, and Predictable Returns
detail.abstract: This paper shows that inefficiency in the information processing activities of sell-side equity analysts generate predictable patterns in stock returns. We propose a new measure of information processing efficiency (IPE) that captures how effectively analysts reuse information about one firm on others. To quantify firm-level information reusability, we consider multiple economic linkages across firms and construct a bidirectional network of informational connections across firm pairs. Analysts with high IPE reuse information and utilize informational connectivity more efficiently. Consequently, they issue more timely and more innovative forecasts, resulting in higher portfolio-level accuracy. Higher IPE is also associated with more profitable stock recommendations and better career outcomes for analysts. At the aggregate-level, firms covered by analysts with lower average IPE exhibit greater information asymmetry and more predictable stock returns. A trading strategy that exploits aggregate-level information processing inefficiency generates an annualized alpha of over 10%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了信息处理效率(IPE)新指标，衡量卖方股票分析师在不同公司间信息重用的效率。研究发现高效信息处理的分析师能发布更及时创新的预测，产生更高投资组合准确性，带来更盈利的股票推荐和更好的职业发展。基于信息处理低效构建的交易策略年化alpha超过10%。
AI.research_question: 卖方股票分析师的信息处理效率如何影响股票收益的可预测模式？
AI.motivation: 分析师在信息处理活动中的低效率可能产生股票收益的可预测模式，但目前缺乏衡量分析师信息重用效率的有效方法
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息处理理论、网络分析理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 构建双向信息连接网络，量化公司间信息可重用性，开发信息处理效率(IPE)指标，进行实证分析和交易策略回测
AI.findings: 高IPE分析师能更有效重用信息，发布更及时创新的预测，获得更高投资组合准确性；低平均IPE覆盖的公司信息不对称更严重，股票收益更具可预测性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了信息处理效率的新概念和衡量方法，扩展了分析师行为和信息处理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了基于信息处理效率的交易策略，年化alpha超过10%；为分析师职业发展和公司覆盖选择提供实践指导

title: Does Your Neighbor's Debt Crowd Out Yours?
affiliations: Nova School of Business and Economics, Bocconi University - Department of Finance and

detail.title: Does Your Neighbor's Debt Crowd Out Yours?
detail.abstract: There is ample evidence in the literature for government debt crowding out of corporate debt, yet we know little about crowding out among public sector debt of different countries, international crowding out. Based on a panel of 52 countries from five different regions over the period between 1995 and 2020, we document a positive association between individual sovereign yields and regional debt supply. This result is robust to different types of debt, different proxies for sovereign yields and holds in alternative subsamples. In further analysis, we find that the international crowding out effect is more prominent for long-term debt and foreign-currency debt. The sovereign yields of countries that depend on capital markets, foreign investors, and countries with more budget deficits and long-term debt due are more sensitive to changes in regional debt. Our results cannot be explained by regional risk or flight to quality motive. To alleviate endogeneity concerns, we provide two event study analyses, one around the introduction of the Euro and another around the announcement of the inclusion of Chinese government bonds in a major sovereign bond index. In addition, we use country-level damages resulting from natural disasters to instrument for regional debt in a two-stage least squares framework. Finally, we extend our analysis to mutual fund holdings of sovereign debt and find supporting evidence to our proposed international crowding out channel. Overall, our results indicate that governments can crowd out each other's debt, increasing the cost of sovereign issues.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现国际间存在政府债务挤出效应，即一个国家的政府债务增加会推高其他国家的国债收益率，这种国际挤出效应在长期债务和外币债务中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 不同国家公共部门债务之间是否存在国际挤出效应？即一个国家的政府债务是否会影响其他国家的国债收益率？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有充分证据表明政府债务会对企业债务产生挤出效应，但关于不同国家公共部门债务之间的国际挤出效应知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政府债务挤出理论，扩展到国际层面，探讨国家间债务市场的相互影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1995-2020年52个国家的面板数据，采用事件研究法（欧元引入和中国国债纳入主要指数）、两阶段最小二乘法（以自然灾害损失作为工具变量）以及共同基金持有数据分析。
AI.findings: 发现单个国家国债收益率与区域债务供给呈正相关，国际挤出效应在长期债务和外币债务中更明显，依赖资本市场、外国投资者、预算赤字较大和长期债务到期的国家对此更敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统证明国际间政府债务存在挤出效应，拓展了债务挤出理论的应用范围，为国际债务市场相互影响提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政府制定债务管理政策提供重要参考，帮助理解国际债务市场的传导机制，对主权债务发行成本和风险管理具有实践指导意义。

title: From Models to Decisions: A Software Tool for Evaluating Action-and Result-Based Conservation Payments
affiliations: Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg, Dresden University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Dresden University of Technology, Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg, University Bonn, Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg, Dresden University of Technology and Brandenburg University of Technology (BTU)

detail.title: From Models to Decisions: A Software Tool for Evaluating Action-and Result-Based Conservation Payments
detail.abstract: Agri-environment schemes for biodiversity conservation should be designed in a cost-effective way. Action-based payment schemes (ABP), which compensate farmers for implementing predefined biodiversity-friendly practices, have been criticized for low cost-effectiveness. In contrast, resultbased payment schemes (RBP), which reward farmers for achieving conservation outcomes, offer a promising alternative by directly incentivizing biodiversity gains. Despite growing interest in RBP in research and policy, evidence comparing the cost-effectiveness of ABP and RBP remains anecdotal. Here, we aim to facilitate future research and policy decision-making by providing the tool ABPvsRBPtool which facilitates the cost-effectiveness comparison of ABP vs. RBP in case studies on biodiversity conservation. We first develop a generic ecological-economic model. Our model accounts for key real-world factors, including farmers' heterogeneous risk preferences, diverse conservation activities under RBP, and hybrid schemes where only part of the payment depends on species occurrence. We then demonstrate the application of the tool through a case study on whinchat conservation in Germany, where we find that RBP outperform ABP in cost-effectiveness. We hope that this tool provides a valuable instrument for future research and decision-making in conservation in agricultural landscapes.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个名为ABPvsRBPtool的工具，用于比较基于行动和基于结果的农业环境支付方案的成本效益，通过生态经济模型和案例研究发现基于结果的支付方案更具成本效益。
AI.research_question: 如何比较基于行动的支付方案（ABP）和基于结果的支付方案（RBP）在生物多样性保护中的成本效益？
AI.motivation: 农业环境方案需要成本效益设计，基于结果的支付方案被认为是比基于行动支付方案更有前景的替代方案，但缺乏系统的成本效益比较证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态经济学框架，考虑农民异质性风险偏好、多样化保护活动和混合支付方案等现实因素。
AI.method: 开发通用生态经济模型，创建ABPvsRBPtool工具，并通过德国whinchat保护案例研究进行应用验证。
AI.findings: 在案例研究中发现基于结果的支付方案（RBP）在成本效益方面优于基于行动的支付方案（ABP）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了系统比较ABP和RBP成本效益的理论框架和建模方法，填补了现有研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的ABPvsRBPtool工具，为未来研究和政策决策提供有价值的工具，促进农业景观保护决策的科学化。

title: Designing Calibration Committees: Size, Standards, and Rater Bias
affiliations: Keio University - Graduate School of Business Administration and Meiji University

detail.title: Designing Calibration Committees: Size, Standards, and Rater Bias
detail.abstract: We develop a design-based theory of calibration committees. Although committees are widely used to mitigate rater bias in subjective performance evaluation, guidance on how to choose their size and standard has been lacking. We model a firm that operates under a uniform (pooling) policy and chooses committee size and a firm-wide standard to manage evaluator favoritism. The model yields four results. First, the effect of committee size on the probability that high effort receives an adverse decision obeys simple shape restrictions: it moves monotonically or displays a single interior peak, but does not switch direction repeatedly. Second, the marginal benefit of adding members is larger under pooling than under type-specific contracts (separation), helping explain why committees are especially valuable where HR policies are uniform. Third, optimal size is finite and characterized by a transparent stopping rule that balances the marginal reduction in expected conflict cost per unit of incentive provision against per-member administrative cost. Fourth, disparities between employee types ultimately decline as committees expand, although they can temporarily widen at intermediate sizes. Taken together, these results add a design-based lens to the calibration literature and outline testable implications for future empirical work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于设计的校准委员会理论，研究如何选择委员会规模和标准来管理评估者偏袒，发现委员会规模对高努力获得不利决策概率的影响具有简单形状限制，在统一政策下边际效益更大，最优规模有限且由透明停止规则决定，委员会扩张最终会减少员工类型差异。
AI.research_question: 如何选择校准委员会的规模和标准来有效管理评估者偏袒，以及在统一人力资源政策下委员会的最优设计是什么？
AI.motivation: 委员会被广泛用于减轻主观绩效评估中的评估者偏见，但缺乏关于如何选择委员会规模和标准的指导，特别是在统一人力资源政策环境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计基础理论、委托代理理论、委员会决策理论、成本效益分析框架

title: Racial Integration and Price Efficiency
affiliations: University of Manitoba, , Michigan State University - Eli Broad College of Business, University of Manitoba - Asper School of Business and University of Manitoba

detail.title: Racial Integration and Price Efficiency
detail.abstract: This paper studies how racial residential integration (RRI) influences stock price efficiency. We find that communities with higher RRI exhibit more upward intergenerational mobility and a smaller White-Black income gap. Consistent with the idea that more integrated communities facilitate better information diffusion, firms headquartered in these regions demonstrate higher stock price informativeness and lower information asymmetry. Using staggered adoptions of source-of-income laws as exogenous shocks to RRI, we establish a causal relationship. Finally, we show that the superior local stock-picking ability of actively managed mutual funds is weakened for firms located in high RRI communities.

AI.tldr: 种族居住融合度高的社区通过促进信息传播，提升股票价格效率，降低信息不对称，并削弱主动管理基金在当地选股优势

title: The Final Collapse of 2026: Systemic Risk, Institutional Signals, and Market Fragility
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Final Collapse of 2026: Systemic Risk, Institutional Signals, and Market Fragility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: no one

detail.abstract: This paper examines the emerging systemic vulnerabilities in global financial markets as of 2025–26. Drawing historical parallels with the 1929 Great Depression, the 2008 Global Financial Crisis, and the COVID-19 liquidity shock, it identifies repeating hallmarks of collapse: extreme asset valuations, unprecedented retail participation, debt saturation, and institutional hedging into gold and Bitcoin. Using a comparative framework of historical cycles, institutional flows, and public psychology, the paper argues that the current environment represents a “predictable collapse” scenario, where fragility is embedded rather than random. While not a forecast of exact timing, the analysis highlights early-warning indicators—including bond auction stress, commercial real estate rollover, reserve reallocation, and geopolitical flashpoints—that may accelerate a systemic repricing. The goal is not alarmism, but to equip policymakers, firms, and researchers with a framework for understanding systemic fragility in a highly interconnected, over-leveraged global system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过历史比较分析（1929年大萧条、2008年金融危机、COVID-19流动性冲击），识别出2025-26年全球金融市场系统性脆弱性的重复特征：极端资产估值、前所未有的散户参与、债务饱和以及机构向黄金和比特币的避险对冲，认为当前环境代表一种"可预测的崩溃"情景。
AI.research_question: 2025-26年全球金融市场存在哪些系统性脆弱性？这些脆弱性是否具有历史重复性特征？
AI.motivation: 理解高度互联、过度杠杆化的全球金融体系中系统性脆弱性的形成机制，为政策制定者、企业和研究人员提供预警框架，而非制造恐慌。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史周期比较框架、制度流动分析、公众心理学理论，基于历史金融危机模式的重复性特征识别。
AI.method: 采用历史比较分析方法，对比1929年大萧条、2008年全球金融危机和COVID-19流动性冲击三个历史时期的金融市场特征。
AI.findings: 识别出系统性崩溃的重复特征标志：极端资产估值、前所未有的零售参与度、债务饱和状态、机构向黄金和比特币的避险对冲行为。当前环境呈现"可预测的崩溃"情景，脆弱性是内嵌的而非随机的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"可预测的崩溃"理论框架，建立了系统性脆弱性的历史重复性识别模式，丰富了金融危机预警理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和研究人员提供了早期预警指标框架（债券拍卖压力、商业地产展期、储备重新配置、地缘政治爆发点），有助于识别和应对系统性风险。

title: The U.S. Forced Labor Import Ban: A Tool for Raising Labor Standards in Supply Chains?

detail.title: The U.S. Forced Labor Import Ban: A Tool for Raising Labor Standards in Supply Chains?

publicationDetails.detailsText: UC Law Journal, Volume 76, Issue 4, pp. 1025-1096 (May 2025)

detail.abstract: Forced labor is rampant across global supply chains. Addressing it at individual sites of production results in a game of whack-a-mole. An effective response must target the structural drivers of the problem: the large firms at the top and middle of supply chains that pressure suppliers at the bottom to cut labor costs in order to remain competitive. In the absence of other U.S. laws that address the structural causes of forced labor, this Article argues that the forced labor import ban in section 307 of the United States Tariff Act may have the potential to be utilized by civil society organizations and the State in top-down ways to hold lead firms at the top and middle of supply chains accountable for facilitating forced labor. Additionally, it may offer a resource to bottom-up efforts by workers in supply chains and the unions that represent them to demand that both brands and suppliers take responsibility for improving working conditions.

detail.title: Social Enterprise as an Instrument of Social Policy in Spain and Italy within the Development Framework of the 2030 Agenda
detail.abstract: Purpose-This study aims to evaluate the function of social enterprises as a tool for social policy in the context of the 2030 Agenda's development.. Design/methodology/approach-A qualitative research approach is employed, utilizing an analytical method to compare initiatives that support social enterprises in Spain and Italy. Findings-The primary outcome indicates the significant role of social enterprises in executing social policies in both Spain and Italy. The conclusion emphasizes the necessity to emerging economies are leading the way in attaining the highest levels of economic performance, aiming to provide their citizens with the well-deserved well-being economy outlined in the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the 2030 Agenda. It is important to highlight that social enterprises serve as an effective tool for addressing poverty and social inequalities. Originality/value-The results offer valuable insights to the current body of literature regarding social enterprises in relation to the sustainable goals of the 2030 Agenda.

title: Economic Models and the Environment: Input-Output Analysis
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Economic Models and the Environment: Input-Output Analysis
detail.abstract: This chapter explores the potential of combining two useful ecologicaleconomic methods: input-output analysis and multi-criteria decision aid. By doing so, it assesses the sustainability of investment in various economic sectors, with the aim of minimising resource use and generation of emissions. The UK case is taken for the purpose of illustration, and (given the availability of the necessary data) this methodology might be applied in countries with various economic structures and specialisations. An environmentally extended static 123-sector UK input-output model is used, linking a range of physical fl ows (domestic extraction, use of water, and emissions of CO 2 , CH 4 , NO x) with the economic structure of the UK. A range of environmentally adjusted forward and backward linkage coeffi cients has been developed, adjusted according to fi nal demand, domestic extraction, publicly supplied and directly abstracted water, and emissions of CO 2 and NO x. The data on the fi nal demand adjusted and environmentally adjusted forward and backward linkage coeffi cients were used in a multi-criteria decision-aid assessment, employing a NAIADE method in three different sustainability settings. The assessment was constructed in such a way that each sector of the UK economy was assessed by means of a panel of sustainability criteria, maximising economic effects and minimising environmental effects. This type of multi-criteria analysis, could prove to be a valuable basis for similar studies, especially in the developing world, where trade-offs between economic development and environmental protection have been the subject of considerable debate. title: A Mathematical Theory of Evolutionary Economics
affiliations: Yunnan Province Library

detail.title: A Mathematical Theory of Evolutionary Economics
detail.abstract: The economy is an integral part of the social system. Society is a group-level structure. Group selection is trapped in the altruistic dilemma. This paper defines the existence of an evolutionary subject as a non-homogeneous Markov process. Fitness is the logarithm of the probability of death of the subject. Pure altruism and kin altruism are essentially the same, i.e., dependency. The reward for an individual's payment of fitness is not material, but rather an increase in their own fitness through an increase in the fitness of the other. Based on dependency theory, the conditions of primitive communism are proven. This paper constructs the basic principles of evolutionary market economics: when the value produced by society is insufficient, the price of the commodity is determined by value, and the supply-demand ratio causes the price to deviate from value. When there is excess production in society, the price of the commodity is determined by utility and value, and the supply-demand ratio causes the price to deviate.

title: Macroeconomic shocks and long-term nutritional outcomes: Insights from the Asian financial crisis
affiliations: University of Bonn - Center for Development Research (ZEF) and University of Bonn

detail.title: Macroeconomic shocks and long-term nutritional outcomes: Insights from the Asian financial crisis
detail.abstract: Climate change, conflicts, pandemics, and other disruptive events can lead to shocks in people’s incomes, prices, and access to food, with profound implications for nutrition and health. The short- and long-term effects of different types of shocks are not yet sufficiently understood. Here, we use data from Indonesia to analyze effects of the Asian financial crisis, which happened in the late-1990s, on nutritional outcomes. The crisis contributed to large temporary increases in rice prices with regional variation, which we exploit to estimate effects on child height-for-age z-scores (HAZ) and other anthropometric indicators. Panel data regression models with individual fixed effects suggest that the rice price inflation led to an average decrease in HAZ of 0.16 and an increase in child stunting by 4 percentage points, after controlling for confounding factors. These effects are more pronounced in urban than rural areas. Children with mothers that only have little education suffer over-proportionally. Beyond the immediate impacts, we examine long-term effects and find that individuals severely hit by the crisis during childhood remain shorter also during adulthood and are more likely to be obese. Our findings highlight the need for nutrition-sensitive interventions in national and global crisis response policies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度尼西亚数据分析亚洲金融危机期间大米价格上涨对儿童营养状况的影响，发现价格上涨导致儿童身高减少和踚小症增加，并在成年期保持长期负面影响。

title: Severe Weather and Collateral Practices
affiliations: Sveriges Riksbank and

detail.title: Severe Weather and Collateral Practices
detail.abstract: Physical climate risks significantly influence banks' collateral practices. Drawing on comprehensive loan-level data from Sweden, we find that adverse weather events increase both the likelihood and the amount of collateral required for new loans. In the case of existing loans, banks are less inclined to reappraise collateral following weather shocks; when reappraisals do occur, collateral values tend to be revised downward. Our analysis also underscores the mitigating effect of proximity between borrowers and lenders in this context. Furthermore, we find that extreme weather events do not directly affect banks' one-year default probability assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文基于瑞典贷款数据研究发现，不利天气事件会增加银行对新贷款要求抵押品的可能性和金额，但对现有贷款较少重新评估抵押品价值。借款人与贷款人之间的地理邻近性具有缓解作用，极端天气事件不直接影响银行的一年期违约概率评估。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险管理理论和气候金融理论，探讨银行在面对气候风险时的抵押品决策行为。
AI.method: 使用瑞典的贷款级别数据进行实证分析，研究天气事件与银行抵押品要求之间的关系。

AI.practical_contributions: 为银行风险管理提供实践指导，帮助金融机构更好地应对气候变化带来的物理风险。

title: Evaluation of High Rate MBBR to Predict Optimal Design Parameters for Higher Carbon and Subsequent Ammoniacal Nitrogen Removal
affiliations: and Thermax Limited

detail.title: Evaluation of High Rate MBBR to Predict Optimal Design Parameters for Higher Carbon and Subsequent Ammoniacal Nitrogen Removal
detail.abstract: The high rate moving bed biofilm reactor (MBBR) processes were designed for wastewater treatment to meet the past effluent discharge norms of biological oxygen demand (BOD) <50 mg/l. However, they are incapable of meeting current effluent discharge norms which consist of BOD <10 mg/l and total nitrogen <10 mg/l. This study analyses the effect and variation of organic loading rate from 1.21 kg to 4.59 kg chemical oxygen demand (COD)/(m3.day) and surface loading rate from 4.9 g to 24 g COD/(m2. day) on a high rate MBBR performance. The results of COD reduction (CODred) and subsequent ammoniacal nitrogen reduction (NH3–Nred) were in the range of 65.4% to 87.8% and 11.8% to 47.2% respectively. The projected graphical optimization defines the design parameters for MBBR and also predicts CODred and subsequent NH3–Nred. By understanding this subsequent NH3–Nred in the MBBR system, future designs for engineering technologies will be aided.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了高负荷移动床生物膜反应器(MBBR)在不同有机负荷率下的性能表现，通过图形优化方法确定了设计参数，为满足更严格的废水排放标准(BOD<10mg/l, 总氮<10mg/l)提供了工程指导。
AI.research_question: 有机负荷率和表面负荷率如何影响高负荷移动床生物膜反应器(MBBR)的COD去除率和氨氮去除率性能？
AI.motivation: 传统高负荷MBBR工艺无法满足当前更严格的废水排放标准(BOD<10mg/l, 总氮<10mg/l)，需要优化设计参数以提高处理效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物膜反应器理论和有机负荷对生物处理系统性能影响的理论框架
AI.method: 实验研究法，通过改变有机负荷率(1.21-4.59 kg COD/(m³·day))和表面负荷率(4.9-24 g COD/(m²·day))，分析MBBR系统的COD和氨氮去除效率
AI.findings: COD去除率在65.4%-87.8%之间，氨氮去除率在11.8%-47.2%之间，通过图形优化确定了MBBR设计参数并能够预测去除效率
