AI.theoretical_framework: 税收法律分析框架，重点关注税法条款修订对纳税人权利义务的影响
AI.method: 法律条文分析，对比修订前后的165(d)条款，分析结构性和会计问题的变化
AI.findings: 修订加剧了结构性强迫纳税人报告虚拟收入的问题，但可能以纳税人友好的方式解决了赌博输赢净额计算问题
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对税法修订影响的理解，特别是结构性问题和会计处理问题的相互作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务从业者提供代表赌博纳税人应对IRS和法庭的最佳实践建议

title: Exogenous Social Norms Drive Fisheries Compliance in the Absence of Adequate Enforcement: Insights from a Novel Experimental Game
affiliations: James Cook University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Sydney, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Exogenous Social Norms Drive Fisheries Compliance in the Absence of Adequate Enforcement: Insights from a Novel Experimental Game
detail.abstract: Compliance with rules and laws is critical to societal function and may be driven more by social pressures than enforcement penalties. In conservation, many protected areas closed to hunting and fishing have been rendered ineffective due to inadequate compliance. Here, we explore the role of social norms in compliance decisions by using a novel experimental game to study real anglers’ decisions to fish ‘illegally’ in a simulated marine protected area (MPA) or ‘legally’ in an open access fishing ground. We demonstrate that a descriptive social norm, exogenously created by computer confederates posing as other players, can increase or decrease compliance over time, as participants conformed to confederate decisions even though these were irrelevant to their final payouts. Results build on past common pool resource games studying cooperation as a viable long-term strategy in fisheries, showing how cooperative (or non-cooperative) behaviors can be driven by conformity to group norms. Additionally, we developed a model to predict participants’ compliance decisions, which revealed that normative influence accumulated, such that each rulebreaker observed over time makes individuals more likely to eventually break the rules themselves. Noncompliance was also more likely after losses due to poor catch, but being caught and fined had a weaker influence on rulebreakers than catch or norms, suggesting a ‘resetting effect’ where apprehended rulebreakers believed future fines were now less likely.

AI.tldr: 通过实验游戏研究真实钓鱼者在模拟海洋保护区的遵纪决策，发现社会规范比执法罚款对个体遵纪行为有更强影响。规范影响逐渐累积，每个违规者都会增加他人违规概率，而被罚款反而产生"重置效应"。
AI.research_question: 社会规范如何影响个体在自然资源保护区的遵纪决策？
AI.motivation: 许多禁止猎捕的保护区因为遵纪率低而失效，但传统视角过于关注执法罚款，而忽视了社会压力的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会规范理论、从众影响、公共资源游戏理论
AI.method: 使用新颖实验游戏，让真实钓鱼者在模拟海洋保护区和开放渔场中做出遵纪决策，通过电脑搭档创造外生的社会规范
AI.findings: 1）描述性社会规范能够增加或减少遵纪行为；2）规范影响累积效应，每个违规者都会提高他人违规概率；3）捕获损失比罚款更容易导致违规；4）被罚款后产生"重置效应"，认为未来再次被罚概率低
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了公共资源游戏理论，证明合作行为可能由从众规范驱动，而非经济理性计算
AI.practical_contributions: 为保护区管理提供新思路：应更多关注社会规范建设，而非仅依靠执法罚款，通过形成积极的社会规范来提高遵纪效果

title: Ecological Debt Swaps for a Twin Debt Justice
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, University of Tuscia and Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Ecological Debt Swaps for a Twin Debt Justice

declarations.ethicsApproval: The paper does not use own empirical data

detail.abstract: We explore the intersection of foreign debt in poor and emerging countries and global climate challenges, proposing a novel debt of "ecological debt swap" to promote both financial and ecological debt sustainability. We sketch the main characteristics of a comprehensive ecological debt swap scheme involving multiple stakeholders, including international development banks, private sector actors pursuing net-zero targets, and local communities. Under this scheme, debt relief would be conditional upon investments in renewable energy projects and sustainability initiatives in debtor countries. A main advantage of the swap over the alternative of unconditional debt relief accompanied by lender subsidized green finance is that the former has features that are mutually beneficial for the counterparts easing the participation constraint of the lender, preventing green moral hazard of the borrower and increasing efficiency in emission reduction. We as well show that related climate investments could reduce global carbon emissions, promote local economic resilience, and address energy poverty.

AI.tldr: 提出"生态债务置换"新机制，将贫困和新兴国家的外债减免与可再生能源投资挂钩，实现金融和生态双重可持续性
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种生态债务置换方案，既能缓解贫困国家债务压力，又能促进气候投资和减排目标实现
AI.motivation: 全球气候挑战与贫困国家外债问题交织，需要创新机制同时解决金融可持续性和生态可持续性问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债务置换理论、气候融资理论和可持续发展理论，构建多方利益相关者参与的生态债务置换框架
AI.method: 理论框架构建和方案设计，分析生态债务置换相对于无条件债务减免的优势特征
AI.findings: 生态债务置换具有互惠特征，能缓解贷款人参与约束，防止借款人绿色道德风险，提高减排效率，同时减少全球碳排放、促进地方经济韧性和解决能源贫困
AI.theory_contributions: 提出生态债务置换新概念，丰富了债务可持续性和气候融资理论，为多利益相关方合作提供理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际开发银行、私营部门和当地社区提供了可操作的债务-气候协同解决方案，促进可再生能源项目投资和可持续发展倡议

title: Multidimensional Sustainability Assessment for Megacities
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Multidimensional Sustainability Assessment for Megacities
detail.abstract: Urban sustainability assessment is required for the purposes of establishing strategic directions for ‘greening’ our cities to reduce the environmental impact of their performance, improve employment and economic viability and enhance the quality of life. This chapter considers large world cities: London, New York, Hong Kong, Los Angeles, Sao Paolo, Rio de Janeiro, Paris, Berlin, Singapore, Shanghai, Sydney and Tokyo. To assess urban sustainability performance, we applied multicriteria decision aid tools to compare the cities on the range of dimensions. The tools chosen for this assessment are ELECTRE III, NAIADE and APIS. The results have shown that Singapore dominates the sustainability rankings in most multicriteria applications, showing particular strength in economic and environmental dimensions and a slightly less strong performance in the social dimension according to the APIS results. The chapter explores innovative sustainability strategy and new governance structures in Singapore and discusses the reasons for such success.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用ELECTRE III、NAIADE和APIS等多准则决策工具对全球12个主要城市进行可持续性评估，发现新加坡在大多数评估中表现最优，特别是在经济和环境维度，社会维度表现稍弱。
AI.research_question: 如何评估全球主要城市的可持续性表现？哪些城市在可持续性方面表现最佳？
AI.motivation: 为城市制定绿色发展战略方向，减少环境影响，改善就业和经济活力，提高生活质量
AI.theoretical_framework: 多准则决策理论，城市可持续性评估框架
AI.method: 采用ELECTRE III、NAIADE和APIS三种多准则决策辅助工具对12个世界大城市进行比较分析
AI.findings: 新加坡在大多数多准则应用中的可持续性排名占据主导地位，在经济和环境维度表现特别强劲，社会维度表现稍弱
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于多准则决策方法的城市可持续性评估理论框架和实践验证
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市管理者提供了可持续性战略制定的参考依据，特别是新加坡的成功经验可为其他城市提供借鉴

title: Optimal Taxation under Imperfect Trust
affiliations: , Independent and National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) - International College of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Optimal Taxation under Imperfect Trust
detail.abstract: We study optimal taxation when the conversion of tax revenue into public goods is uncertain. In a static Ramsey framework with a representative household, a competitive firm, and two broad instruments (a labor-income tax and a commodity/output tax), a simple measure of trust-the perceived likelihood that revenue is actually delivered as public consumption-scales the marginal value of public funds. We show: (i) a trust threshold below which any distortionary taxation reduces welfare; (ii) above that threshold, policy uniquely pins down the scale of taxation but leaves a continuum of tax mixes (an equivalence frontier) that implement the same allocation and welfare; and (iii) tiny administrative or salience wedges select a unique instrument, typically favoring a broad base collected at source. We derive a trust-adjusted Ramsey rule in sufficient-statistics form, establish robustness to mild preference non-separabilities and concave public-good utility, and provide an isoelastic specialization with transparent comparative statics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了税收收入转化为公共品存在不确定性时的最优税收政策，提出了信任阈值概念，发现在阈值之上存在税收组合等价前沿，微小行政成本会倾向于选择源头征收的宽税基方案。
AI.research_question: 在税收收入转化为公共品存在不确定性的情况下，如何设计最优税收政策？
AI.motivation: 传统最优税收理论假设税收收入能够确定性地转化为公共品，但现实中政府执行效率和腐败等因素使得这种转化存在不确定性，需要研究信任因素对税收政策设计的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ramsey最优税收框架，代表性家庭模型，竞争性企业，包含劳动所得税和商品/产出税两种主要工具。
AI.method: 静态理论模型分析，建立包含信任参数的最优税收模型，推导信任调整的Ramsey规则，进行充分统计量形式的分析。
AI.findings: 1) 存在信任阈值，低于该阈值时任何扭曲性税收都会降低福利；2) 高于阈值时，政策唯一确定税收规模但存在税收组合的等价前沿；3) 微小行政或显著性楔子会选择单一工具，通常偏好源头征收的宽税基。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信任因素引入最优税收理论，提出了信任调整的Ramsey规则，建立了税收组合等价前沿的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了考虑政府执行效率时的税收设计指导，强调了宽税基、源头征收的重要性，特别是在低信任环境中。

title: Crossroads of Peace: Advancing Regional Integration and Global Trade Through Post-Conflict Cooperation
affiliations: Armenian State University of Economics, Yerevan and

detail.title: Crossroads of Peace: Advancing Regional Integration and Global Trade Through Post-Conflict Cooperation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they are employed by the Ministry of Economy of the Republic of Armenia, which supports the Crossroads of Peace initiative, the subject of this article. The authors affirm that their affiliation did not influence the design, conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study. The views expressed in this article are solely those of the authors and do not necessarily represent the official position of the Ministry of Economy or the Government of the Republic of Armenia.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not contain any studies with human participants performed by any of the authors. This article does not contain any studies with animals performed by any authors
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded through an honorarium provided by the Armenian State University of Economics.

detail.abstract: This article examines the potential economic benefits of the Crossroads of Peace (CoP) initiative proposed by the Government of Armenia. To assess regional trade dynamics, three indicators were applied: the Export Similarity Index (ESI), the Trade Complementarity Index (TCI), and the Revealed Comparative Advantage (RCA). The findings reveal that the ESI between Armenia and its regional partners, Türkiye and Azerbaijan, is 0.25, indicating minimal competition in export markets. In contrast, the TCI score of 0.5 from the region to Armenia suggests a relatively higher degree of complementarity, highlighting stronger opportunities for regional exports to Armenia than vice versa. Furthermore, Armenia's projected trade volume with Türkiye in 2024 is estimated at USD 787 million, underscoring the initiative's potential to foster significant economic exchange.

AI.tldr: 本文通过贸易指数分析评估亚美尼亚"和平十字路口"倡议的经济潜力，发现与土耳其和阿塞拜疆出口竞争度低但互补性较高，预计2024年亚土贸易额达7.87亿美元
AI.research_question: 亚美尼亚"和平十字路口"倡议可能带来哪些经济收益？
AI.motivation: 评估亚美尼亚政府提出的区域合作倡议的经济可行性，为区域经济一体化提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论，特别是出口相似性指数、贸易互补性指数和显性比较优势理论
AI.method: 应用三种贸易指标进行定量分析：出口相似性指数(ESI)、贸易互补性指数(TCI)和显性比较优势(RCA)
AI.findings: ESI为0.25显示出口竞争度低；TCI为0.5表明区域对亚美尼亚出口互补性较高；预计2024年亚美尼亚与土耳其贸易额达7.87亿美元
AI.theory_contributions: 为小国区域经济合作倡议的经济效益评估提供了实证分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚美尼亚政府推进"和平十字路口"倡议提供数据支持，指明与土耳其等重点国家的贸易合作潜力

title: Natural Capital and Economic Growth
affiliations: , Amundi Asset Management and Amundi Asset Management

detail.title: Natural Capital and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: This paper examines the complex relationship between natural capital and longterm economic growth. Specifically, we review resource-based growth theories and various modeling approaches. In most frameworks, natural capital is considered an additional production factor that supplements traditional inputs. However, we highlight a common conceptual confusion between economic wealth (a stock) and economic growth (a flow). This distinction is often overlooked in discussions about the role of natural assets in development. Using World Bank data from 1995 to 2020, we empirically estimate a Cobb-Douglas production function that incorporates produced (physical) capital, labor (human capital), renewable resources, and non-renewable resources. We then classify countries according to their resource endowment and assess the elasticity of natural capital with respect to GDP. To address uncertainty and downside risk, we propose a stress-testing framework that integrates historical worst-case analysis, parametric methods, and extreme value theory. Our results reveal significant heterogeneity in the impact of natural capital on growth. Over the past 25 years, non-renewable resources appear to have had little influence on economic growth. Conversely, growth has been more responsive to renewable resources. Notably, countries such as Iran, Australia, South Korea, and Nicaragua experienced a negative contribution of natural capital to growth, while Vietnam, Indonesia, Mozambique, and Egypt experienced a positive contribution. The stress-testing analysis further underscores wide crosscountry variation. Over a 25-year horizon, the countries that are potentially most affected by adverse natural capital scenarios include Ethiopia, Chile, New Zealand, Brazil, Iran, and Poland. An additional insight comes from decomposing the stress test results into the sum of the worst-performing years. This reveals that, in some countries, stress outcomes are driven by one or two severe events. In contrast, in other countries, a prolonged decline in natural capital leads to multiple moderately bad years without any single catastrophic event.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨自然资本与长期经济增长的复杂关系，通过实证分析发现可再生资源对经济增长影响显著，而非可再生资源影响有限，并开发了压力测试框架揭示国家间的异质性影响。
AI.research_question: 自然资本如何影响长期经济增长？不同类型自然资本（可再生vs非可再生）对经济增长的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究中存在经济财富（存量）与经济增长（流量）的概念混淆，需要澄清自然资本在经济发展中的真实作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础型增长理论，科布-道格拉斯生产函数框架，将自然资本作为额外生产要素纳入传统生产函数。
AI.method: 使用世界银行1995-2020年数据，实证估计包含物质资本、人力资本、可再生资源和非可再生资源的科布-道格拉斯生产函数，并进行国家分类和弹性分析。
AI.findings: 非可再生资源对经济增长影响有限，可再生资源影响更显著；不同国家自然资本贡献存在显著异质性（伊朗等负贡献，越南等正贡献）。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了自然资本存量与经济增长流量的概念区别，完善了资源与增长的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了集成历史最差情况分析、参数方法和极值理论的压力测试框架，为政策制定者提供风险评估工具，识别易受自然资本不利影响的国家。

title: Peer Effects in Old-Age Employment Among Women
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - CERGE-EI, a joint workplace of Charles University and the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Peer Effects in Old-Age Employment Among Women

declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by Charles University, GAUK project No. 333221.

detail.abstract: This paper exploits a unique norm-shifting setting-a German pension reform that equalized retirement ages across genders-to examine how old-age employment propagates through workplace networks. The reform raised women's earliest claiming age from 60 to 63 for cohorts born in 1952 onward. Using the universe of workgroups from social security records, I compare women whose peers were just above or below the reform cutoff. I find that women are more likely to remain employed at older ages when their peers do, with stronger effects in the regions of former West Germany, with its traditional gender norms. Gender-neutral pension reforms thus amplify their impact through peer influence, fostering regional convergence in late-career employment patterns.

AI.tldr: 德国养老金改革统一男女退休年龄，研究发现同事网络对老年就业有显著影响，特别是在传统性别观念较强的西德地区，同龄人就业行为会相互影响。
AI.research_question: 养老金改革如何通过工作场所网络影响老年就业行为？
AI.motivation: 利用德国养老金改革这一自然实验，研究同龄人网络对老年就业决策的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络理论、同伴效应理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 利用德国社会保障记录的完整工作群体数据，采用断点回归设计，比较改革临界点前后同龄人群体的就业行为差异。
AI.findings: 女性更可能在同龄人继续就业时保持就业，这种效应在传统性别观念较强的西德地区更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了养老金改革通过同伴网络传播的机制，证明了制度变迁的社会网络扩散效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于养老金改革实施效果的深入理解，表明性别中立的改革可以通过同伴影响放大效果，促进地区间晚年就业模式的趋同。

title: Comparative Sustainability Analysis of Two Asian Cities: A Multidimensional Assessment of Taipei and Almaty
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation, Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, Al-Farabi Kazakh National University, Sarsen Amanzholov East Kazakhstan State University and ITMO University

detail.title: Comparative Sustainability Analysis of Two Asian Cities: A Multidimensional Assessment of Taipei and Almaty
detail.abstract: The article compares economic and environmental performance of Taipei and Almaty from the point of view of "green" economy, which is able to act as a key tool to ensure sustainable development of the region. As the comparison of the parameters of ecological and economic development of the Taipei and Almaty cities shows, they are similar in population size, but demonstrate completely different trends of sustainable development. Economic performance of the Taipei city is achieved with a decrease in the consumption of natural resources and the production of pollution, while the situation in Almaty is the opposite. Almaty maintains a high level of air pollution due to the use of coal in electricity production, as well as increased traffic and density of construction, including the southern part of the city, which is a zone for the transit of mountain air flows. The article discusses the activities jointly conducted by the Government of Taiwan and non-governmental organizations on environmental issues, as well as environmental NGOs, which resulted in significant improvements in the environmental field. Measures to stimulate the development and implementation of environmental innovations applied in the field of sustainable development in the city of Taipei can be adapted for the city of Almaty, where the environmental situation deteriorates year by year.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过对比台北和阿拉木图的经济与环境表现，探讨了"绿色"经济在促进地区可持续发展中的关键作用。研究发现台北在经济增长的同时减少了资源消耗和污染，而阿拉木图则面临环境状况恶化的挑战。
AI.research_question: 台北和阿拉木图在经济与环境表现上存在哪些差异；如何将台北成功的环保措施和管理经验转化为阿拉木图可适用的解决方案？
AI.motivation: 绿色经济作为促进地区可持续发展的关键工具，台北和阿拉木图人口规模相似但可持续发展趋势完全不同，通过对比研究可为环境状况恶化的城市提供可借鉴的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色经济理论、可持续发展理论、环境经济学，重点关注经济增长与环境保护的协调关系。
AI.method: 定性对比分析法，通过比较台北和阿拉木图在人口规模、经济表现、资源消耗、污染物排放等方面的数据和现状，分析两地可持续发展的差异和原因。
AI.findings: 台北在经济表现优异的同时实现了资源消耗和污染排放的减少；阿拉木图则面临严重的空气污染问题，主要来自煤炭电力生产、交通压力和建筑密度增加。台湾政府与非政府组织的合作为环境改善做出了重要贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了绿色经济和可持续发展理论在不同发展模式城市中的应用实践，提供了城市间环保经验转移的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿拉木图等环境挑战严峻的城市提供了可借鉴的环保措施和政策建议，包括政府与NGO合作模式、环保创新推广等，促进地方环境状况改善。

title: Long-Term Effects of Economic Growth and Unemployment on Caloric Intake: An Empirical Analysis With ARDL Modeling in the United States (1961–2018)
affiliations: Baku State University, Baku State University, Baku State University and Baku State University

detail.title: Long-Term Effects of Economic Growth and Unemployment on Caloric Intake: An Empirical Analysis With ARDL Modeling in the United States (1961–2018)
detail.abstract: This study investigates the long-term effects of economic growth and unemployment on per capita caloric intake in the United States from 1961 to 2018. Using data obtained from the U.S. Bureau of Statistics, we employ an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model to analyze the relationship between caloric consumption, GDP per capita, and unemployment rates. The study first conducts unit root tests to determine the stationarity of the time series data, followed by the application of the ARDL model to identify long-term equilibrium relationships among the variables. The results indicate a significant positive relationship between GDP per capita and caloric intake, while unemployment shows a negative impact on caloric consumption. The findings underscore the importance of economic stability and growth in improving dietary habits and overall public health. Policy implications suggest that efforts to reduce unemployment and promote economic growth can have beneficial effects on population health and nutrition.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用ARDL模型分析1961-2018年美国人均热量摄入与经济增长和失业率的关系，发现GDP增长与热量摄入正相关，失业率与热量摄入负相关。
AI.research_question: 经济增长和失业率对美国人均热量摄入的长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨经济因素如何影响人口营养状况和公共健康，为制定改善营养的政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济发展与营养健康关系的理论框架，认为经济状况直接影响食物获取和消费能力。
AI.method: 使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析时间序列数据，首先进行单位根检验确定数据平稳性。
AI.findings: GDP人均与热量摄入呈显著正相关关系，失业率对热量消费有负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济因素与营养健康关系提供了长期实证证据，丰富了相关理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示表明，减少失业和促进经济增长可以对人口健康和营养产生积极影响。

reference: Revista Direito e Práxis, Rio de Janeiro, volume 13, issue 4, 2022, p. 2648-2686.
title: Digital Constitutionalism: Contradictions of a Loose Concept
affiliations: Rio de Janeiro State University and WZB Berlin Social Science Center

detail.title: Digital Constitutionalism: Contradictions of a Loose Concept

publicationDetails.detailsText: Revista Direito e Práxis, Rio de Janeiro, volume 13, issue 4, 2022, p. 2648-2686.

detail.abstract: This paper maps the uses of the expression digital constitutionalism, as employed in recent debates about digital technologies regulation (in particular, digital platforms). Our goal is to highlight discrepancies and risks implied in the dilatation of the term "constitutionalism" to encompass the normative phenomena that run under this label. In light of the understanding of traditional constitutionalism as a political and institutional phenomenon, we identify the theories that precede digital constitutionalism as contemporary formulations aimed at explaining changes in the functioning of powers and normative systems that transcend or overlap the nation-state and its territorial boundaries (i.e., constitutional pluralism, societal constitutionalism, and global constitutionalism). Based on the literature's criticism of this theoretical matrix, digital constitutionalism is problematized as a term epistemically impaired by the diversity of applications and the potential to legitimize concentrations of private powers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了数字宪政主义这一术语在数字技术监管辩论中的使用情况，指出该术语扩展使用带来的概念模糊和风险，并基于传统宪政理论对其进行批判性审视。
AI.research_question: 数字宪政主义这一术语在数字技术监管辩论中是如何被使用的？其概念扩展存在哪些问题和风险？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术特别是数字平台监管辩论的兴起，"数字宪政主义"这一术语被广泛使用但缺乏清晰界定，存在概念模糊和潜在风险，需要进行系统梳理和批判性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统宪政主义理论（作为政治和制度现象），借鉴宪政多元主义、社会宪政主义和全球宪政主义等理论框架。
AI.method: 文献分析和概念映射方法，系统梳理数字宪政主义相关文献的使用方式和理论表述。
AI.findings: 数字宪政主义术语使用存在显著差异和概念扩展问题，可能因应用多样性而导致认识论缺陷，并存在合法化私人权力集中的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 对数字宪政主义概念进行系统批判性分析，揭示其理论基础的模糊性和潜在问题，为数字治理理论发展提供概念澄清。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供概念工具，避免在数字平台监管中盲目使用宪政主义框架而可能产生的负面影响。

title: On Empirical Validation of Marginal Build Emissions Rates
affiliations: WattTime, WattTime and WattTime

detail.title: On Empirical Validation of Marginal Build Emissions Rates
detail.abstract: The Greenhouse Gas Protocol Protocol (GHGP) proposes that the long-run marginal emissions rate (LRMER) of the power grid can be captured by a combination of the Marginal Operating Emissions Rate (MOER) and the Marginal Build Emissions Rate (MBER) with a build margin weight (w). This approach has largely been untested against realworld conditions. In this study, we demonstrate a two-step method to empirically validate this methodology. In the first step, we leveraged the fact that all known MBER modeling approaches rely on making predictions of future capacity growth. By measuring the accuracy of this prediction using actual historical capacity growth, we are able to perform a validation test for MBER models that is empirical, and does not rely on any unobservable counterfactual. In the second step, we use the actual historical changes in emissions associated with past natural variations in load to evaluate the ability of an MBER model with a given value of w to produce accurate LRMER values. As a proof-of-concept, we examine two implementations of MBER and the methodology described in the current Greenhouse Gas Protocol (GHGP) using their default generic build weight of w = 1/2. We compared this model's performance in producing accurate MBERs and LRMERs in grid regions across the continental United States, and found that it has significant ability to successfully predict power plant build by fuel type and estimate LRMER values. We also found that a weight parameter of w = 1/2 to be more consistent with the empirical LRMER than models that are purely MOER or purely MBER.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个两步实证方法来验证温室气体协议中提出的长期边际排放率计算方法，通过历史容量增长数据和负荷变化来评估MBER模型和权重参数的准确性，发现w=1/2的权重比纯MOER或纯MBER模型更符合实证结果。
AI.research_question: 如何实证验证温室气体协议中提出的长期边际排放率计算方法？该方法在现实条件下的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 温室气体协议提出的长期边际排放率计算方法缺乏实证验证，需要开发可靠的验证方法来评估其在真实世界条件下的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于温室气体协议的LRMER计算框架，结合边际运营排放率和边际建设排放率，使用建设边际权重w进行组合。
AI.method: 两步实证验证方法：第一步利用历史容量增长数据验证MBER模型的预测准确性；第二步利用历史负荷变化相关的排放变化来评估不同w值下模型的LRMER准确性。
AI.findings: 研究发现温室气体协议的默认权重w=1/2在预测发电厂建设燃料类型和估算LRMER值方面表现良好，比纯MOER或纯MBER模型更符合实证数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个实证验证GHGP LRMER计算方法的研究框架，为电力系统排放核算提供了方法论验证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了经过实证验证的排放核算方法，有助于更准确地评估电力消费的碳足迹和制定减排策略。

title: An Analysis of Legal Realism's Influence on Modern Dispute Resolution Practices
affiliations: University of the Punjab , Jhelum Campus

detail.title: An Analysis of Legal Realism's Influence on Modern Dispute Resolution Practices
detail.abstract: Legal realism as a jurisprudence movement has substantially transformed the modern jurisprudence of dispute resolution by discrediting the formalistic foundations of law and advocating the practical and contextual solutions. This research explores the influence of legal realism on progress and application of ADR methods (negotiation, mediation and arbitration). Bypassing the rigidity of the traditional adjudication, legal realism has shifted towards interest-based negotiation as compared to the rights-based negotiation which is more cooperative and result-oriented. Realism has changed the mediator role as problem solving and empathetic as opposed to advocacy in an adversary process and systemic reforms that are increasingly promoting the use of mediation over formal litigation. Procedural flexibility in arbitration can consider legal requirements and fair considerations to balance. The study uses empirical research and comparative legal research and evaluates the success of the realist-inspired ADR practices that are quantifiable and their cross-cultural adaptability. Legal realism makes dispute resolution more efficient, fairer, and a more whole-person, multi-dimensional attitude to resolve conflicts. However, some challenges exist in regards to standardizing the practices in different jurisdictions with different traditions of law. Current study reiterates on the ever-present implications of legal realism on the modern day dispute resolution and highlight the aspects of potential future reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨法律现实主义对ADR方法（谈判、调解和仲裁）发展的影响，通过实证和比较法研究评估现实主义启发的ADR实践的成功率和跨文化适应性。
AI.research_question: 法律现实主义如何影响替代性纠纷解决（ADR）方法的进步和应用？
AI.motivation: 法律现实主义运动通过破除法律的形式主义基础，倡导实用和情境化的解决方案，已经实质性改变了现代纠纷解决法理学。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律现实主义理论，强调法律的实用性和情境性，反对形式主义法学。
AI.method: 实证研究和比较法律研究
AI.findings: 法律现实主义促进了从权利本位谈判向利益本位谈判的转变，使调解者角色从对抗性程序中的辩护转变为问题解决和共情，仲裁程序更具灵活性以平衡法律要求和公平考虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了法律现实主义在纠纷解决领域的理论应用，证明了其对现代ADR方法发展的实质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同法域标准化ADR实践提供参考，展示了现实主义启发的ADR方法在提高效率、公平性和多维冲突解决方面的实际价值。

title: Copyright and the Dynamics of Innovation in Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne)

detail.title: Copyright and the Dynamics of Innovation in Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Copyright can determine access to data, which may, in turn, affect innovation in Artificial Intelligence (AI). In this paper, we conduct an empirical analysis to investigate the relationship between copyright and the dynamics of AI innovation. Some countries provide exceptions in copyright law that are relevant for AI, particularly concerning text and data mining and the doctrine of fair use. The study takes a global perspective, comparing different countries based on the breadth of exceptions in copyright law. We find that countries with broader copyright exceptions tend to exhibit higher levels of AI innovation, as measured in a larger number of AI research publications, more active participation in open-source AI projects, increased AI patent filings, and a higher rate of AI venture formation. These findings suggest that statutory provisions enabling data access can be pivotal in fostering AI innovation. However, while broad copyright exceptions may support current AI innovation by allowing the use of existing works, they might also inadvertently discourage the creation of new works, leading to negative long-term consequences for the availability and quality of training data. We discuss how mandatory licensing may provide a setting that aligns the dynamic incentives of rightsholders and AI developers.

AI.tldr: 版权例外范围对AI创新有显著影响，更宽松的版权例外政策与更高的AI创新水平相关，但可能对内容创作产生长期负面影响，建议采用强制许可机制平衡各方利益。
AI.research_question: 版权例外范围如何影响人工智能创新的动态发展？
AI.motivation: 版权制度决定了数据获取途径，而数据获取对人工智能创新至关重要，不同国家在版权例外政策上的差异为研究提供了自然实验条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于版权经济学理论、创新激励理论和数据驱动创新理论，分析版权例外对AI创新的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用跨国比较的实证分析方法，比较不同国家版权例外范围的宽窄与AI创新指标（研究出版物、开源项目、专利申请、风险投资）的关系。
AI.findings: 版权例外范围更广的国家在AI创新各方面表现更好，包括更多研究出版物、更活跃的开源参与、更多专利申请和更高风险投资形成率。

title: The Self-Financing State: An Institutional Analysis of Government Expenditure, Revenue Collection and Debt Issuance Operations in the United Kingdom
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, UCL Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University College London - Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose and The Gower Initiative for Modern Money Studies

detail.title: The Self-Financing State: An Institutional Analysis of Government Expenditure, Revenue Collection and Debt Issuance Operations in the United Kingdom
detail.abstract: This article provides the first detailed institutional analysis of the UK government's expenditure, revenue collection, and debt issuance processes. We show that public expenditure is always financed through money creation rather than taxation or debt issuance. Spending involves the government drawing on a sovereign line of credit from a core legal and accounting structure known as the Consolidated Fund (CF). The Bank of England then debits the CF's account at the Bank and credits other government accounts held at the Bank. This creates new public deposits, which are used to settle spending by government departments via the commercial banking sector. Only the UK parliament can mandate expenditures from the CF. Revenue collection, including taxation, involves the reverse process, crediting the CF's account at the Bank, offsetting past injections. Similarly, gilts have been issued to temporarily withdraw money to assist monetary policy objectives. Under the current conditions of excess reserve liquidity, however, debt issuance is best understood as a way of providing safe assets and secure collateral to the non-bank private sector. The findings support neo-Chartalist accounts of the workings of sovereign currency-issuing nations and provide additional institutional detail regarding the apex of the monetary hierarchy in the UK.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对英国政府的支出、税收和债务发行流程进行了详细的制度分析，揭示了公共支出始终通过货币创造而非税收或债务发行来融资的机制。
AI.research_question: 英国政府的支出、税收和债务发行过程是如何在制度层面运作的？公共支出是否真的通过税收或债务来融资？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为政府支出需要通过税收或借款来融资，但缺乏对现代货币体系实际运作机制的详细制度分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新宪章主义（neo-Chartalism）货币理论，强调主权货币发行国的货币创造机制。
AI.method: 制度分析法，详细分析英国政府财政运作的法律和会计结构，特别是统一基金（Consolidated Fund）和英格兰银行的运作机制。
AI.findings: 1) 公共支出通过货币创造而非税收或债务融资；2) 支出过程涉及从统一基金的信贷提取；3) 税收是反向过程，抵消之前的货币注入；4) 债务发行在现代条件下主要是为私人部门提供安全资产和抵押品。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新宪章主义理论提供了详细的制度证据，揭示了主权货币国家货币层级的顶端运作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解现代货币体系运作提供了实证基础，挑战了传统财政融资观念。

title: A Corrected Measure of Orthogonalized Monetary Policy Surprises
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: A Corrected Measure of Orthogonalized Monetary Policy Surprises
detail.abstract: This note reassesses the orthogonalized monetary policy surprises series proposed by Bauer and Swanson (2023a). Their approach aggregates daily FOMC surprises to the monthly level and only afterwards orthogonalizes them with respect to a subset of contemporaneous news variables. Instead, I purge each FOMC-day surprise from all available news releases before aggregation. The fully orthogonalized series loses instrumental strength and yields no significant responses in any of the macroeconomic variables under analysis, casting doubt either on the usefulness of the measure or, if taken seriously, on monetary non-neutrality. A simple model featuring explicit timing of the orthogonalization rationalizes the stark empirical differences.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了Bauer和Swanson(2023a)提出的正交化货币政策意外序列，通过在每个FOMC会议日先对新闻发布进行正交化处理再聚合的方法，发现完全正交化的序列失去了工具变量强度，对宏观经济变量无显著影响，对货币政策非中性提出质疑。
AI.research_question: 如何正确构建正交化的货币政策意外序列？不同正交化时序对结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: Bauer和Swanson(2023a)的方法在月度层面进行正交化处理可能存在时序问题，需要重新评估其方法的有效性
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制、工具变量方法、正交化处理理论
AI.method: 比较分析：在FOMC会议日层面先进行完全正交化处理再聚合，与Bauer和Swanson的月度聚合后正交化方法对比
AI.findings: 完全正交化的货币政策意外序列失去工具变量强度，对宏观经济变量无显著响应，与原始方法结果截然不同
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了正交化处理时序的重要性，为货币政策意外测量方法提供理论修正
AI.practical_contributions: 质疑现有货币政策意外测量的有效性，对货币政策非中性理论提出实证挑战

title: Multidimensional Assessment of Sustainability: Harmony vs. the Turning Point
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Multidimensional Assessment of Sustainability: Harmony vs. the Turning Point
detail.abstract: Multidimensional assessment of sustainability is a way to reconcile the need for simultaneous consideration of various indicators of progress beyond GDP growth with a policy focused visualization of multi-dimensional trends in a clear and transparent manner. The various composite measures used for sustainability assessment often hide the trade-offs between economic, social and environmental dimensions of sustainability. This chapter discusses indicators used for sustainability analysis at the macro scale and offers a multi-criteria sustainability assessment framework. It discusses results that were obtained in sustainability assessments for the USA, Brazil, China, France, Germany, Britain and Russia. The Multicriteria Decision Aid tool, Aggregated Preference Index System (APIS) is used for the assessment with the following three headline indicators: GDP per capita; CO 2 emissions and Life Expectancy at birth. The indicators represent economic, environmental and social dimensions respectively. The multidimensional assessment is designed with two different policy priorities: priority of economic over environmental and social dimension versus priority of environmental and social dimensions over economic. Results help to identify countries, where economic development happened at the expense of environmental and social dimension and lead to policy conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多维度可持续发展评估框架，使用APIS多准则决策工具，通过GDP、CO2排放和预期寿命三个指标分别代表经济、环境和社会维度，在不同政策优先级下对多个国家进行可持续性评估。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个多维度可持续发展评估框架，以平衡经济、环境和社会三个维度的权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 传统的复合指标往往掩盖了可持续发展各维度之间的权衡关系，需要一种清晰透明的多维度评估方法来支持政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多准则决策理论、可持续发展理论、多维度评估框架
AI.method: 使用Aggregated Preference Index System (APIS)多准则决策工具，选取GDP per capita（经济）、CO2 emissions（环境）、Life Expectancy at birth（社会）三个核心指标，设置两种不同政策优先级进行评估。
AI.findings: 评估了美国、巴西、中国、法国、德国、英国和俄罗斯的可持续性表现，识别出哪些国家的经济发展是以牺牲环境和社会维度为代价的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个能够明确展示可持续发展各维度权衡关系的多维度评估框架，丰富了可持续发展评估的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了清晰的决策支持工具，帮助识别不同政策优先级下的可持续性表现，为制定平衡发展的政策提供依据。

title: Should We Use Central Bank Asset Purchase Announcements and Sign Restrictions to Quantify Quantitative Easing?
affiliations: University of the German Federal Armed Forces - Helmut Schmidt Universität

detail.title: Should We Use Central Bank Asset Purchase Announcements and Sign Restrictions to Quantify Quantitative Easing?
detail.abstract: The empirical literature lacks a consensus on how to model quantitative easing (QE) within the structural vector autoregression (SVAR) framework. As agents may anticipate central-bank balance sheet variables, the use of asset purchase announcements has become a common practice. I show that results derived from such SVAR models, identified with sign restrictions, should be cautiously interpreted. Structural shocks deemed to identify QE rather recover a different mechanism possibly related to monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文指出使用资产购买公告识别SVAR模型中的量化宽松政策存在识别问题，所得结构冲击可能反映的是货币政策机制而非真正的QE效应。
AI.research_question: 如何正确地在结构向量自回归(SVAR)框架中建模量化宽松政策？
AI.motivation: 实证文献在SVAR框架中建模量化宽松政策缺乏共识，且代理人可能预期央行资产负债表变量，导致识别问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构向量自回归(SVAR)理论，符号限制识别方法，预期理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和SVAR模型识别方法评估。
AI.findings: 使用资产购买公告和符号限制识别的SVAR模型结果需要谨慎解释，所得结构冲击可能识别的是货币政策机制而非量化宽松效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了SVAR框架中量化宽松政策识别的理论问题，对预期因素在货币政策建模中的重要性提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和政策制定者提供了关于量化宽松政策效应评估的方法论警示，建议在政策分析中谨慎使用基于公告的SVAR识别方法。

title: Information Technology, the State and the Voter in the Kenyan Election of2013
affiliations: University of New Mexico School of Law and Independent

detail.title: Information Technology, the State and the Voter in the Kenyan Election of2013
detail.abstract:
The importance of information and communication technologies in Kenya reached new heights during the March 2013 elections. Information and communication technologies (ICTs) were used in the general elections to encourage voting, provide information about candidates, promote "peace speech," and, on the negative side, intimidate voters, such as instructing them not to vote. In addition, new ICTs were introduced by the Government of Kenya (GoK) to improve

the accuracy of the election, as well as to control how people communicated about the election.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2013年肯尼亚大选中信息通信技术(ICTs)的双重作用：既被用于鼓励投票、提供候选人信息、促进和平言论，也被用于选民恐吓和选举控制。
AI.research_question: 信息通信技术在2013年肯尼亚大选中发挥了什么样的作用？这些技术如何影响选举过程和结果？
AI.motivation: 随着ICTs在选举中的广泛应用，需要深入理解这些技术如何影响民主进程，特别是在发展中国家如肯尼亚的选举环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传播学理论、政治传播理论和数字民主理论，分析ICTs在选举中的双重作用机制。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，可能包括内容分析、深度访谈和案例研究，分析2013年肯尼亚大选中ICTs的使用情况。
AI.findings: ICTs在选举中具有双重作用：正面用于选民教育、和平促进，负面用于选民恐吓；政府引入新技术既提高选举准确性也控制选举言论。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字民主理论，提出了ICTs在选举环境中的双重作用模型，为理解技术对民主进程的复杂影响提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为选举管理机构提供ICTs使用的最佳实践指南，帮助平衡技术使用的正面效益与潜在风险，提高选举的公正性和透明度。

title: Circular Supply Chain Practices in Kochi: A Sustainable Transformation of the E-Commerce Logistics Sector
affiliations: Jain Deemed to be University and Christ University

detail.title: Circular Supply Chain Practices in Kochi: A Sustainable Transformation of the E-Commerce Logistics Sector
detail.abstract: E-commerce Industry has the strongest contributors to India's Economy, giving the strong support to the retail supply chain through fast logistics, warehouses automation, and technology focused last-mile delivery. Now this transformation is more visible in Kochi, Kerala's commercial capital, where rising incomes, deep digital focused setup, and the rapid growth of tech professionals into tech hubs like Infopark and Smart City have fuelled online retail growth. However, this massive expansion comes at an environmental cost. Now Kochi is facing an unprecedented surge in waste corrugated boxes, single-use plastic packaging, bubble wraps, multi-layer films, and non-recyclable laminates from huge deliveries. In the era of "take-make-dispose" linear model, these packing materials majorly end up in landfills, illegal dumps, or unsafe land reclamation sites, releasing toxins for decades. Due to Kochi's limited land availability, ecologically sensitive backwaters, and increased population create this challenge more acute. Circular Supply Chain (CSC) models focused on reuse, repair, refurbishment, and recycling-offer a way to play win-win situation both economic growth and environmental responsibility. Global players like Amazon, UPS and Geodis have successfully adopted CSC strategies such as closed-loop logistics and reusable packaging. In India, Flipkart's reverse logistics shows how circular supply chain can recover materials, cut waste, and create green jobs. Flipkart's Kochi Reverse Logistics Centre has started operational feasibility: barcode/QR code tracking for recovered goods, automated refurbishment triage, partnerships with certified recyclers, reduced transport emissions, and recovered packaging reuse. Emerging opportunities like climate-specific biodegradable packaging, AI waste sorting, blockchain product tracking, and neighbourhood take-back networks can position Kochi as a model circular city. The way forward lies in strong policy support, local innovation, and consumer participation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度科钦市电子商务快速发展带来的包装废弃物环境问题，探讨循环供应链模型如何通过再利用、修复、翻新和回收实现经济增长与环境责任的平衡。
AI.research_question: 循环供应链模型如何在科钦市电子商务快速发展的背景下解决包装废弃物环境问题？
AI.motivation: 科钦市作为喀拉拉邦商业中心，电子商务快速发展导致瓦楞纸箱、一次性塑料包装等废弃物激增，由于土地有限和生态敏感的后水道环境，传统线性处理模式面临严峻挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环供应链理论，强调闭环物流、可重复使用包装、逆向物流等策略，突破传统的"获取-制造-处置"线性模式。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，分析Flipkart科钦逆向物流中心的运营实践，包括条码追踪、自动化翻新分类、认证回收商合作等可行性措施。
AI.findings: 循环供应链模型在科钦市具有操作可行性，能够实现材料回收、减少废弃物、创造绿色就业，并降低运输排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了循环供应链理论在发展中国家电子商务环境中的应用，提供了新兴经济体城市环境挑战的解决方案框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科钦市提供了具体的循环供应链实施路径，包括气候适应性生物降解包装、AI废物分类、区块链产品追踪等技术创新，以及政策支持和消费者参与的建议。

title: Policy Frameworks for Sustainable Public Procurement: Global Trends and Local Adaptations
affiliations: University of Abuja, Abuja Nigeria, University of Abuja, Abuja Nigeria and University of Abuja

detail.title: Policy Frameworks for Sustainable Public Procurement: Global Trends and Local Adaptations
detail.abstract: Public procurement represents a significant portion of public expenditure worldwide, accounting for approximately 15-20 percent of total global GDP. This article will examine the evolving policy frameworks of sustainable public procurement (SPP) practices and the localisation of global trends across diverse jurisdictions. This research study used a qualitative methodology to assess the efficacy of current SPP frameworks, the problems associated with their implementation, and their potential to enhance the sustainability of procurement processes. The research indicates that while international norms are essential, tailored techniques must be established prior to successful implementation, contingent upon local economic, social, and environmental factors. Critical observations indicate that the adoption of SPP is prevalent in nations that have established comprehensive legal frameworks supported by efficient implementation guidelines and capacity building initiatives. However, challenges persist in the domain, including economic considerations, supplier competencies, and the assessment of sustainability outcomes. The study elucidates the methods by which policy frameworks can be developed to promote sustainable procurement practices that address local desires and constraints. Proposed recommendations include developing integrated policy solutions, augmenting institutional capacity, and creating conducive circumstances for the success of sustainable suppliers. This study provides valuable insights for policymakers, procurement professionals, and researchers to facilitate a more sustainable approach to government purchasing globally.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性研究方法分析了可持续公共采购(SPP)政策框架的演变，发现虽然国际规范很重要，但成功的实施需要根据当地经济、社会和环境因素制定定制化方法。研究指出拥有完善法律框架、实施指南和能力建设计划的国家SPP采用率较高，但仍面临经济考量、供应商能力和可持续性结果评估等挑战。

title: Economic Impact, Fiscal Loss, and Redistribution of Wealth in Sport Events
affiliations: and University of Windsor

detail.title: Economic Impact, Fiscal Loss, and Redistribution of Wealth in Sport Events

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Sport Management, volume 39, issue 5, 2025[10.1123/jsm.2024-0371]

detail.abstract: This conceptual paper identifies erroneous economic impact reports as the first link in a chain reaction that can lead local governments to provide public subsidies to sport events. Using public finance, we illustrate that fiscal revenue will always be a small portion of economic impact thus, local revenues rarely exceed actual government expenses, and fiscal loss occurs. Furthermore, the extensive literature on sport events confirms they are regularly subject to high costs, overruns, and losses, nearly all of which must be borne by the public due to contractual obligations. Thus, government losses result in negative redistributive effects that harm local residents and benefit private industry. We propose dispensing with economic impact and using fiscal analysis as a tool to determine how sport subsidies can be provided at a level that offers the benefit of the public good but does not harm local residents through excessive spending, and thus, regressive redistribution.

AI.tldr: 本文指出错误的经济影响报告导致地方政府为体育赛事提供公共补贴，造成财政损失和负面再分配效应，建议用财政分析替代经济影响分析来制定合理的补贴水平。
AI.research_question: 体育赛事经济影响报告如何导致地方政府财政损失和负面再分配效应？
AI.motivation: 地方政府经常基于错误的经济影响报告为体育赛事提供公共补贴，但实际财政收益往往无法覆盖政府支出，导致财政损失和损害当地居民利益的再分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政理论、经济影响分析理论、再分配效应理论
AI.method: 概念性分析，基于公共财政理论和现有文献综述
AI.findings: 1) 财政收入始终只是经济影响的一小部分；2) 地方收入很少超过实际政府支出；3) 体育赛事经常出现高成本、超支和亏损；4) 政府损失导致负面再分配效应，损害居民利益而惠及私营产业
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了用财政分析替代经济影响分析的理论框架，为评估体育赛事补贴提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府提供了实用的财政分析工具，帮助制定既能提供公共产品效益又不会过度损害居民利益的体育赛事补贴政策

title: Sanctions, and Subordinate Financialization: The Internal Spatial Fix in Iran
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - Stony Brook, Students

detail.title: Sanctions, and Subordinate Financialization: The Internal Spatial Fix in Iran
detail.abstract: This article examines how sanctions and subordinate financialization have transformed Iran's economy over the past decade through the lens of the internal spatial fix. Constrained by global economic isolation, Iran has redirected financial capital from industrial manufacturing to speculative and extractive sectors, resulting in deindustrialization, heightened resource dependency, and a bifurcated labor regime marked by precarity and inequality. Adapting David Harvey's concept of the spatial fix to internal dynamics, this article situates Iran's trajectory within broader debates on financialization in peripheral economies, offering a novel lens to examine the interplay between sanctions, resource dependency, and economic precarity. Grounded in dissertation research, this article draws on two case studies-the decline of HEPCO and the rise of CMIC-to illustrate the mechanisms and consequences of this internal reallocation of capital. These findings reveal how sanctions and financialization intersect to prioritize short-term accumulation over long-term development, deepening economic instability and labor commodification. By integrating the overlapping effects of sanctions and financialization, this article offers a novel theoretical framework for understanding resource dependency and developmental stagnation in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文通过内部空间修复理论分析伊朗经济转型，发现制裁和金融化导致资本从工业转向投机性部门，造成去工业化、资源依赖加剧和劳动力分化。
AI.research_question: 制裁和从属金融化如何通过内部空间修复机制重塑伊朗经济结构？
AI.motivation: 探讨全球制裁背景下伊朗经济内部资本重新配置的机制和后果，为理解边缘经济体金融化提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: David Harvey的空间修复理论，特别是内部空间修复概念，结合从属金融化理论。
AI.method: 基于论文研究的两个案例研究：HEPCO的衰落和CMIC的崛起。
AI.findings: 制裁和金融化导致资本从工业制造转向投机和采掘部门，造成去工业化、资源依赖加剧、劳动力制度分化为不稳定和不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空间修复理论应用于内部经济动态，提出理解全球南方资源依赖和发展停滞的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了制裁与金融化如何相互作用，优先考虑短期积累而非长期发展，加深经济不稳定和劳动力商品化。

title: Demand for Basketball: A Comparison of the WNBA and NBA
affiliations: and Southern Utah University

detail.title: Demand for Basketball: A Comparison of the WNBA and NBA
detail.abstract: There is considerable discussion regarding interest in women's basketball, with critics often comparing the WNBA and NBA. This comparison is problematic because the WNBA is in an early growth phase while the NBA organizational life cycle position is far more mature. We investigate whether the demand features of early growth leagues are similar by comparing attendance data from the 8th-21st seasons of the WNBA with attendance from the same point in NBA history and the current NBA. We find the factors that affect demand in the WNBA are uniquely different than the NBA in both size and significance in either period, thus, it is inappropriate to compare the two leagues.

AI.tldr: WNBA与NBA的比较是不恰当的，因为WNBA处于早期成长阶段而NBA已成熟。研究发现两个联盟的需求影响因素在规模和显著性上都存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: WNBA早期成长阶段的需求特征是否与NBA历史同期和当前NBA相似？
AI.motivation: 解决关于女子篮球兴趣的讨论，批评者经常将WNBA与NBA进行比较，但这种比较存在问题，因为两个联盟处于不同的组织生命周期阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织生命周期理论，体育经济学中的需求分析理论
AI.method: 比较WNBA第8-21赛季的上座率数据与NBA历史同期和当前NBA的上座率数据
AI.findings: 影响WNBA需求的因素在规模和显著性上都与NBA（无论是历史同期还是当前）存在显著差异
AI.theory_contributions: 为体育联盟组织生命周期理论提供实证支持，强调不同发展阶段联盟的比较需要谨慎
AI.practical_contributions: 为WNBA管理层提供决策参考，避免不恰当的NBA比较基准，制定符合自身发展阶段的市场策略

title: Digital Money and Payment Flow Competition
affiliations: University of Liverpool Management School, , Loyola Marymount University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Digital Money and Payment Flow Competition
detail.abstract: Traditional banks rely on informational synergy between payment and credit services: information from checking accounts helps them assess borrowers and thus issue credit. Non-bank digital money like Venmo disrupts this link by reducing banks' access to such information and unbundling payments from credit. We develop a New-Monetarist model with endogenous portfolio and banking choices under private information. When policy rates are high, buyers are less likely to use deposits to conceal information and extract rents; when rates are low, they are more likely to use deposits and reveal information. We show that non-bank digital money weakens informational synergy and intensifies bank disintermediation; however, credit allocation may improve, potentially raising welfare.

AI.tldr: 非银行数字支付（如Venmo）削弱了银行支付与信贷服务之间的信息协同效应，导致银行脱媒，但可能改善信贷配置并提高福利水平。
AI.research_question: 非银行数字支付如何影响传统银行支付与信贷服务之间的信息协同效应及其对银行脱媒和信贷配置的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统银行依赖支付和信贷服务之间的信息协同：支票账户信息帮助银行评估借款人并发放信贷。非银行数字支付（如Venmo）通过减少银行获取此类信息的机会，破坏了这种联系，并将支付与信贷解绑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新货币主义理论，构建了包含内生投资组合选择和银行选择的理论模型，考虑了私人信息的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，开发了一个包含内生投资组合和银行选择的新货币主义模型，在私人信息条件下分析政策利率变化对存款使用行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1）政策利率高时，买家较少使用存款来隐藏信息和获取租金；2）政策利率低时，买家更可能使用存款并披露信息；3）非银行数字支付削弱信息协同效应并加剧银行脱媒；4）但信贷配置可能改善，潜在提高福利水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了分析数字支付对银行信息协同影响的理论框架；2）揭示了政策利率变化对信息披露行为的影响机制；3）提供了数字支付环境下银行脱媒的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为监管机构理解数字支付对银行体系的影响提供理论依据；2）帮助银行应对数字支付带来的信息获取挑战；3）为政策制定者平衡金融创新与金融稳定提供参考。

title: Advanced Machine Learning Methods for Churn Prediction and Classification in the Telecom Sector
affiliations: The Huntington National Bank

detail.title: Advanced Machine Learning Methods for Churn Prediction and Classification in the Telecom Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The telecom industry's vast client base causes it to create massive amounts of data daily. The cost of obtaining new clients is higher than the cost of keeping existing ones, according to business experts and decision-makers. Customer churn remains a critical challenge in the telecom sector, where retaining existing customers is significantly more cost-effective than acquiring new ones. This study focuses on applying advanced machine learning techniques to accurately predict and classify customer churn using the Telco Customer Churn dataset. The methodology includes comprehensive data preprocessing such as handling missing values, converting data types, encoding categorical features, scaling, and addressing class imbalance using SMOTE. The dataset is split into training and testing sets, and models including XGBoost, Extra Trees, and a Voting Classifier are developed and fine-tuned using Randomized SearchCV. Evaluation is conducted using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, confusion matrices, and classification reports. Among the models tested, the Extra Trees classifier achieved the highest performance with 86.05% accuracy, recall, and F1-score, outperforming both the Voting Classifier and XGBoost. Additionally, it surpassed baseline models like KNN, Logistic Regression, SGD, and Random Forest, and demonstrated more balanced performance compared to the stacking model, which, despite delivering competitive results, exhibited lower recall and less consistency across evaluation metrics. The results confirm that the Extra Trees model provides a robust and balanced solution for churn prediction, offering valuable insights for telecom providers in developing proactive customer retention strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用机器学习技术预测电信客户流失，通过数据预处理和多种分类器比较，发现Extra Trees模型在准确率、召回率和F1分数上表现最佳（86.05%），为电信公司提供了有效的客户保留策略工具。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习技术准确预测电信行业的客户流失？
AI.motivation: 电信行业拥有庞大的客户基础，获取新客户的成本远高于保留现有客户，客户流失是该行业面临的关键挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习分类理论，特别是集成学习方法如XGBoost、Extra Trees和投票分类器。
AI.method: 采用Telco客户流失数据集，进行数据预处理（处理缺失值、数据类型转换、分类特征编码、缩放）、使用SMOTE处理类别不平衡，将数据集分为训练集和测试集，开发并微调XGBoost、Extra Trees和投票分类器模型，使用Randomized SearchCV进行超参数优化。
AI.findings: Extra Trees分类器表现最佳，达到86.05%的准确率、召回率和F1分数，优于投票分类器和XGBoost，也超越了KNN、逻辑回归、SGD和随机森林等基线模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了Extra Trees算法在客户流失预测中的优越性能，为机器学习在电信客户关系管理中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信提供商提供了强大的客户流失预测工具，有助于制定主动的客户保留策略，降低客户获取成本，提高企业盈利能力。

title: The Kedarnath Tragedy of 2013: Intersections of Natural Fury and Human Negligence in the Himalayan Region
affiliations: Kurukshetra University

detail.title: The Kedarnath Tragedy of 2013: Intersections of Natural Fury and Human Negligence in the Himalayan Region
detail.abstract: The Kedarnath disaster was one of India's most catastrophic natural events, intensified by a dangerous confluence of climate change, unregulated development, and institutional failures. Triggered by glacial lake outburst and record-breaking rainfall in the Garhwal Himalayas, the tragedy resulted in over 10000 deaths and extensive destruction of lives and infrastructure. This paper critically examines the socio-environmental and policy dimensions that magnified the disaster's impact. Drawing on secondary data, the study highlights how the convergence of fragile ecosystems, religious tourism, and governance failures led to a compounded disaster. A comparative analysis with the Chamoli, Leh, and Joshimath disasters further underscores systemic gaps in risk-sensitive planning. The Kedarnath tragedy serves as a stark reminder of the urgent need to strike a balance between development and environmental integrity in the Himalayan terrains. The question is 'Could the massive loss of life, property and environment have been avoided and, if so, to what extent? ' To answer these questions, this paper aims to carry out an objective Hazard, Vulnerability and Response Assessment of the State of Uttarakhand.

AI.tldr: 对印度Kedarnath灾难的深入分析，探讨气候变化、无管制发展和制度失效如何加剧灾害影响，通过脆弱性评估揭示喜马拉雅地区发展与环境平衡的紧迫性
AI.research_question: 大规模的生命、财产和环境损失是否可以避免？如果可以，在多大程度上可以避免？
AI.motivation: Kedarnath灾难是印度最严重的自然灾害之一，由冰川湖溃决和破纪录降雨引发，造成超过1万人死亡，需要深入分析其社会环境和政策层面的放大因素
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害脆弱性理论、风险敏感规划理论、社会生态系统理论
AI.method: 基于二手数据的客观灾害、脆弱性和响应评估，采用比较分析方法（与Chamoli、Leh和Joshimath灾害对比）
AI.findings: 脆弱生态系统、宗教旅游和治理失效的汇聚导致了复合型灾害，系统性风险敏感规划存在重大缺口
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对复合灾害形成机制的理解，发展了喜马拉雅地区灾害脆弱性评估的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为喜马拉雅地区制定平衡发展与环境保护的政策提供了实践指导，提出了改善风险敏感规划的具体建议

title: Skill-biased Technological Changes, Non-separable Utility, and Dynamic Optimal Capital Tax
affiliations: Zhejiang University and Zhejiang University - College of Economics

detail.title: Skill-biased Technological Changes, Non-separable Utility, and Dynamic Optimal Capital Tax
detail.abstract: This paper examines the optimal dynamic taxation of capital in the context of skill-biased technological changes. The study reveals that the widening wage gap, coupled with the complementarity between consumption and leisure, provides a novel rationale for capital taxation. It demonstrates that taxing capital is beneficial in economies experiencing persistent skillbiased technological advancements, even if the capital is skill-neutral and the complementarity between consumption and leisure is time invariant. Converse results appear when leisure substitutes consumption. Statistics-based optimal tax formulas are provided to show how the government can dynamically mitigate the impacts of various technological changes through the utilization of labor and capital income taxes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了技能偏向型技术进步背景下的最优动态资本税收问题，发现工资差距扩大和消费与闲暇的互补性为资本税提供了新的理论依据。
AI.research_question: 在技能偏向型技术进步的经济中，如何设计最优的动态资本税收政策？
AI.motivation: 技能偏向型技术进步导致工资差距扩大，同时消费与闲暇的互补性关系对资本税收政策设计提出了新的理论需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态税收理论，结合技能偏向型技术进步和消费-闲暇互补性/替代性的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论建模与统计分析，推导最优税收公式。
AI.findings: 在技能偏向型技术进步的经济中，即使资本是技能中性的且消费-闲暇互补性不变，征收资本税也是有益的；但当闲暇替代消费时，结果相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资本税收提供了新的理论依据，揭示了消费-闲暇关系在税收政策设计中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于统计的最优税收公式，指导政府如何利用劳动和资本所得税动态缓解各种技术变革的影响。

title: Just Transition Pathways for a Net-Zero Telangana: Case Studies from Coal-Dependent Districts of Mancherial and Peddapalli
affiliations: Independent, Swaniti Initiative, Independent, Swaniti Initiative and Swaniti Initiative

detail.title: Just Transition Pathways for a Net-Zero Telangana: Case Studies from Coal-Dependent Districts of Mancherial and Peddapalli
detail.abstract: As the world moves towards a net zero future—a prerequisite for limiting the rise in average global temperatures to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels—coal phase down has become inevitable. India’s net zero target year is 2070. However, some coal-rich states like Telangana are setting an even more ambitious target of going net zero by 2047, that is, 23 years before the national target. As Telangana, which produces 7% of the total coal in India, actively plans its net-zero future, it seeks to ensure that workers and communities are protected from the aftereffects of coal phase down. To contribute to the understanding of Telangana’s net zero future and just transition prospects, we conducted a study to examine its current levels of coal dependence and economic diversification potential. For this, we focused on two key coal-dependent districts in Telangana: Mancherial and Peddapalli. Currently, these districts collectively produce 45% of the state's coal. Furthermore, these districts are home to several coal-based thermal power plants, fly ash units, and coal-dependent MSMEs. Notably, Ramagundam, located in Peddapalli district, stands out as a significant hub for thermal power generation in India. We conducted a mixed-methods study that included household and enterprise surveys in both districts to quantify coal dependence and unpack aspirations for understanding economic diversification. Additionally, we conducted multiple focus group discussions and semi-structured interviews to capture the nuanced realities, opportunities, and challenges related to diversification in these areas. Finally, we aligned our findings from field work with the existing policy landscape to identify potential support for new sectors.

AI.tldr: 印度特伦甘纳邦作为产煤大州设定了比国家目标更早的2047年碳中和目标，研究通过混合方法分析了两个关键产煤区的煤炭依赖度和经济多元化潜力，为公正转型提供政策建议。
AI.research_question: 特伦甘纳邦主要产煤地区当前的煤炭依赖程度如何？这些地区经济多元化的潜力和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着全球向净零未来迈进，煤炭逐步淘汰不可避免。特伦甘纳邦设定了比国家目标更早的2047年碳中和目标，需要确保工人和社区在煤炭转型过程中得到保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公正转型理论、区域经济多元化理论、能源转型政策分析框架
AI.method: 混合研究方法：包括家庭和企业调查以量化煤炭依赖度，焦点小组讨论和半结构化访谈以深入了解多元化机遇和挑战，田野调查结果与现有政策对接分析
AI.findings: Mancherial和Peddapalli两个地区生产特伦甘纳邦45%的煤炭，是重要的热电发电中心，拥有大量煤炭相关企业和飞灰处理单位，煤炭依赖度较高但存在多元化潜力
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家煤炭地区的公正转型提供了实证研究案例，丰富了能源转型中区域经济多元化的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为特伦甘纳邦制定煤炭转型政策提供了数据支持，识别了潜在的新产业支持领域，为保护工人和社区的转型方案提供了实践建议

title: Genetic Parentage Acknowledgments: The Need for Congressional Action
affiliations: Northern Illinois University - College of Law

detail.title: Genetic Parentage Acknowledgments: The Need for Congressional Action

publicationDetails.detailsText: 52 Notre Dame Journal of Legislation ___ (forthcoming Spring 2026)

detail.abstract:
Genetic Parentage Acknowledgments: 

The Need for Congressional Action

52 Notre Dame Journal of Legislation ___ (forthcoming Spring 2026)

In the 1990s Congress, through the Social Security Act, required states receiving Title IV-D financial support to implement paternity acknowledgment processes. These processes are now generally utilized by states to designate (male genetic) paternity for children born of consensual sex regardless of any state financial assistance.

For states participating in the IV-D reimbursement program, Congress requires “fraud, duress, or material mistake of fact” as necessary for judicial overrides of paternity acknowledgments through signatory challenges brought more than sixty days after signing. Congress has not defined these terms, resulting in widespread variations in state laws. Congress also has not spoken on nonsignatory acknowledgment challenges.

Unfortunately, some state laws, again prompted by the 2017 UPA, have carried the fraud, duress and mistake challenge requirements over to parentage acknowledgments that are not based on actual or possible genetic ties. Signatory female spouses of gestating parents who acknowledge need not have provided eggs to prompt pregnancies and births. Signatory intended parents (male or female) who acknowledge need not be genetically tied to children born of nonsurrogacy assisted reproduction.  

The federal fraud, duress, and mistake norms on acknowledgment challenges do not necessarily apply to, and need not govern, challenges to acknowledgments that do not involve paternity or maternity based on possible genetic ties. Overrides of spousal parent acknowledgments, in the absence of actual or alleged genetic ties, should have separate challenge guidelines. Overrides of intended assisted reproduction parentage acknowledgments by those without actual or genetic ties should have separate challenge guidelines.  The 2017 UPA drafters could have recognized such differences in acknowledgment challenges, but did not.

One vehicle for prompting different acknowledgment challenge norms for the varied circumstances underlying acknowledgments is through Congressional amendments to the Social Security Act. Upon reviewing the current federal statutes and state laws on establishing and overriding all forms of parentage acknowledgments, the paper suggests Congressional actions that will better protect acknowledged children, acknowledging parents, nonsignatory genetic parents, and nonsignatory genetic and nongenetic family members who are related to acknowledged children.  

The paper urges Congress to recognize expressly the broad discretion held by state lawmakers regarding parentage acknowledgments beyond the scope of IV-D child support reimbursements from genetic parents. Within the IV-D realm, the paper urges Congress to revise its genetic acknowledgment requirements by promoting more uniform approaches to fraud, duress, and mistake. Express limits by Congress of IV-D acknowledgment norms to actual and alleged genetic parents would operate where social policies overwhelmingly support initial child support duties for genetic parents.

New federal norms guiding challenges to paternity acknowledgments for children born of consensual sex will need to differ from the norms guiding challenges to paternity/maternity acknowledgments for children born of assisted reproduction. Further, Congress should differentiate between nonsurrogacy, gestational surrogacy, and genetic surrogacy assisted reproduction births. Prebirth and/or postbirth parental childcare intentions should generally operate for children born of sex while preconception parental childcare intentions should usually operate for assisted reproduction birth children.

The paper also suggests that Congress consider expanding its IV-D parentage establishment mandates, aimed at increasing reimbursements to governments for welfare payments, to include nongenetic (both custodial and noncustodial) parents who are recognized under state laws as childcare (i.e., custody and support) parents. Where state laws place on equal footing, for example, genetic parents and nongenetic de facto parents for child custody purposes, all such parents should be comparably treated for child support reimbursement purposes.

AI.tldr: 本文主张国会需要修订《社会保障法》，为不同类型的亲子关系确认制定差异化的挑战标准，特别是区分基因亲子关系和非基因亲子关系确认的撤销规则，以更好地保护儿童和各方当事人的权益。
AI.research_question: 国会应如何修订《社会保障法》中的亲子关系确认条款，为不同类型的亲子关系确认制定适当的挑战和撤销标准？
AI.motivation: 现行联邦法律对亲子关系确认的挑战标准（欺诈、胁迫或重大事实错误）主要针对基因亲子关系，但各州法律将这些标准不适当地扩展到了非基因亲子关系确认，导致法律适用混乱和权益保护不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于亲子关系法律理论，区分基因亲子关系和非基因亲子关系的法律确认标准，强调不同亲子关系类型应有差异化的法律规制框架。
AI.method: 通过分析现行联邦《社会保障法》IV-D条款、各州亲子关系确认法律以及2017年《统一亲子关系法》的相关规定，进行法律文本分析和比较研究。
AI.findings: 现行法律将基因亲子关系的挑战标准不适当地适用于非基因亲子关系确认，导致法律适用混乱；需要为配偶确认、辅助生殖确认等非基因亲子关系制定独立的挑战标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分基因与非基因亲子关系确认法律规制的理论框架，为亲子关系法律制度的精细化发展提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国会修订《社会保障法》提供了具体建议，包括制定差异化的挑战标准、扩大IV-D计划的适用范围至非基因父母，以及区分不同类型辅助生殖的确认规则等。

title: Institutional Design of Asymmetric Decentralization for Conflict Mitigation: Learning from the ARMM-BARMM Transition
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy

detail.title: Institutional Design of Asymmetric Decentralization for Conflict Mitigation: Learning from the ARMM-BARMM Transition
detail.abstract: Territorial autonomy is frequently promoted as a solution to ethnic conflict, yet its outcomes vary widely across cases. This paper argues that asymmetric decentralization succeeds in mitigating ethnic conflict only when its institutional design demonstrates coherence, context-sensitivity, and alignment with the underlying structure of conflict grievances. Drawing on recent research showing that institutional design quality determines the effectiveness of asymmetric arrangements, the study develops a threepillar framework emphasizing: (1) fiscal-legal integration that ensures both autonomy and accountability through automatic transfers and constitutional entrenchment; (2) inclusive governance architecture that accommodates competing elites while maintaining democratic representativeness; and (3) adaptive coordination systems that manage intergovernmental relations while preserving flexibility for institutional evolution. The framework is illustrated through a comparative analysis of the Philippines' transition from the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (ARMM) to the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM)-a rare case of comprehensive asymmetric redesign within constant territorial and constitutional conditions. The study finds that ARMM failed due to fiscal dependency, exclusionary politics, weak legal entrenchment, and absence of coordination mechanisms. In contrast, BARMM introduced automatic block grants, parliamentary governance, formal elite integration, enhanced cultural autonomy, and systematic intergovernmental relations bodies-each mapped to address the multi-dimensional grievances of the Moro conflict. The analysis reveals that asymmetric arrangements' effectiveness depends not on formal power allocation but on institutional design coherence and conflict-structure alignment. While acknowledging BARMM's recent establishment limits definitive outcome assessment, early evidence suggests promising institutional developments including improved public satisfaction, increased service delivery, and enhanced fiscal autonomy. The paper contributes to federal design theory by providing the first systematic framework linking ethnic conflict typologies to asymmetric institutional design, and demonstrates that failed arrangements can be successfully redesigned through institutional learning and stakeholder inclusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三支柱框架来分析非对称分权制度设计对缓解民族冲突的有效性，通过菲律宾ARMM到BARMM的案例比较，发现制度设计的连贯性、情境敏感性和冲突结构匹配度是成功的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 非对称分权制度设计如何影响其缓解民族冲突的有效性？
AI.motivation: 尽管领土自治经常被提倡作为民族冲突的解决方案，但其效果在不同案例中差异很大，需要系统分析制度设计质量对自治安排有效性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三支柱框架：1）财政-法律整合（自动转移支付和宪法保障）；2）包容性治理架构（精英整合与民主代表性）；3）适应性协调系统（政府间关系管理与制度演化灵活性）
AI.method: 比较案例分析，以菲律宾从ARMM到BARMM的转型为研究对象，分析制度设计的差异及其效果。
AI.findings: ARMM失败的原因是财政依赖、排他性政治、法律保障薄弱和协调机制缺失；BARMM通过自动拨款、议会治理、精英整合、文化自治和系统化政府间关系机构等设计，有效解决了摩洛冲突的多维度不满。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个系统框架将民族冲突类型学与非对称制度设计联系起来，为联邦设计理论做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明失败的制度安排可以通过制度学习和利益相关者包容成功重新设计，为其他地区的民族冲突治理提供实践参考。

title: Speed, Style Status: Cultural and Economic Impact of Ferrari and Fiat on Italian Consumer Identity (1945 -1985)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Speed, Style Status: Cultural and Economic Impact of Ferrari and Fiat on Italian Consumer Identity (1945 -1985)
detail.abstract: Post World War 2 Italy had faced economic collapse, widespread poverty, high unemployment rates and a fractured national identity. This paper examines how two contrasting automotive manufacturers, Fiat and Ferrari, played complementary roles in rebuilding Italy's economy and identity between 1945 and 1985. Fiat, under Vittorio Valletta, contributed to Italy's postwar economic recovery through large-scale production and labor absorption and Ferrari contributed with technological innovation, motorsport and export visibility while under Enzo Ferrari. Even though they differed in audiences and production ideologies both brands were monumental in redefining Italian modernity. Using economic data, Marshall plan recovery reports, labor and gender documents, and advertising campaigns, this paper will explore how both automotive giants not only responded to Italy's postwar crisis but also actively shaped consumer psychology, industrial growth and class identity. By integrating cultural, economic, and legal analysis, this study demonstrates that Italy's recovery was driven as much by symbolism and consumer aspiration as by fiscal policy or infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究菲亚特和法拉利两家汽车制造商在1945-1985年间如何通过互补的方式推动意大利战后经济重建和民族身份重塑，菲亚特通过大规模生产和就业吸收促进经济复苏，法拉利则通过技术创新和赛车运动提升国际形象。
AI.research_question: 菲亚特和法拉利这两家理念不同的汽车制造商如何在战后意大利的经济重建和民族身份重塑中发挥互补作用？
AI.motivation: 二战后意大利面临经济崩溃、普遍贫困、高失业率和分裂的民族认同，需要研究不同企业如何共同推动国家复兴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合文化研究、经济史和消费心理学理论，探讨象征意义和消费渴望在战后重建中的作用。
AI.method: 使用经济数据、马歇尔计划恢复报告、劳工和性别文件以及广告活动等多源资料进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 两家汽车巨头不仅应对了战后危机，还积极塑造了消费者心理、工业增长和阶级认同，意大利的恢复既受财政政策和基础设施影响，也深受象征意义和消费渴望驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业象征性角色在经济重建中的理论框架，丰富了关于战后复兴中文化因素作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当代企业如何通过差异化战略共同推动国家经济发展和文化建设提供了实践启示。

title: The Effect of National Origin and Skin Color on Playing Time in the WNBA
affiliations: , Southern Utah University and Ursinus College

detail.title: The Effect of National Origin and Skin Color on Playing Time in the WNBA

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Sports Economics, volume 25, issue 6, 2024[10.1177/15270025241260030]

detail.abstract: This article uses data from the 1997-2022 seasons to investigate the role of bias in the distribution of playing time in the WNBA. We evaluate national origin, a fixed and objective measure, and improve upon past uses of subjective, perception-based measures of race by using a more objective measure of skin tone. More specifically, via a fixed-effect estimation of 2,949 WNBA player-year combinations we find no evidence that the national origin of either players or coaches is related to the provision of playing time. Similarly, skin tone of players or coaches (n=893), either alone or in combination with national origin, shows no robust significance. Evidence of national origin bias has previously been reported in professional men's basketball leagues in the U.S., Spain, and China. The WNBA may be demographically similar to the NBA, but it is culturally different and we find no evidence of employer discrimination.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用1997-2022赛季WNBA数据，通过更客观的肤色测量方法分析比赛时间分配中的偏见问题，发现球员和教练的国籍、肤色等因素与上场时间无显著关联，表明WNBA不存在雇主歧视。
AI.research_question: WNBA中是否存在基于国籍和肤色的比赛时间分配偏见？
AI.motivation: 先前研究在NBA、西班牙和中国男子职业篮球联赛中发现了国籍偏见证据，但WNBA作为女性职业联赛可能具有不同的文化特征，需要独立验证是否存在类似歧视现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场歧视理论和体育经济学中的偏见研究框架，使用客观可测量的国籍和肤色变量替代主观感知的种族测量方法。
AI.method: 使用固定效应模型分析2,949个球员-年份组合数据，对893名球员和教练的肤色进行客观测量，检验国籍和肤色对比赛时间的影响。
AI.findings: 未发现球员或教练的国籍与比赛时间分配存在关联；肤色因素（单独或与国籍结合）也未显示稳健的显著性；WNBA不存在雇主歧视证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了女性职业体育中歧视问题的新证据，挑战了职业篮球普遍存在国籍偏见的假设，强调了性别和联赛文化背景在歧视研究中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为WNBA联盟的管理实践提供了实证支持，表明其比赛时间分配相对公平，有助于提升联盟形象和促进性别平等在职业体育中的发展。

title: Ethereum's Role in the US Government's New Stablecoin Architecture: A detailed analysis of Regulatory, Technical, and Economic Implications
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Ethereum's Role in the US Government's New Stablecoin Architecture: A detailed analysis of Regulatory, Technical, and Economic Implications
detail.abstract: The United States has established the world's first comprehensive federal regulatory framework for stablecoins through the GENIUS Act, signed into law on July 18, 2025. This landmark legislation creates a structured environment for digital dollar infrastructure, with Ethereum blockchain hosting approximately 70% of the global stablecoin supply exceeding $200 billion. This research examines Ethereum's multifaceted role within this new regulatory architecture, analyzing technical capabilities, economic impacts, compliance considerations, and competitive positioning. The study reveals that while Ethereum maintains dominance through network effects and institutional trust, scalability challenges and emerging competition from alternative blockchains create strategic pressures. The research demonstrates that Ethereum-based stablecoins offer significant economic benefits including reduced transaction costs and enhanced financial inclusion, while also presenting systemic risks requiring careful regulatory oversight. The analysis concludes that a multi-platform ecosystem is emerging, with Ethereum likely maintaining leadership through continued dominance in decentralized finance infrastructure and institutional adoption.

AI.tldr: 美国通过《GENIUS法案》建立了首个全面的稳定币联邦监管框架，本研究分析了以太坊在这一新监管架构中的多重角色，包括技术能力、经济影响、合规考量和竞争定位。研究发现以太坊虽保持主导地位，但面临可扩展性挑战和竞争压力，同时带来显著经济收益和系统性风险。

AI.motivation: 美国通过《GENIUS法案》建立了全球首个全面的稳定币联邦监管框架，以太坊承载着全球70%的稳定币供应，价值超过2000亿美元，需要深入分析其在这一新监管环境中的作用和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术理论、网络效应理论、监管合规理论和竞争战略理论，构建分析框架来评估以太坊在稳定币生态系统中的多维角色。
AI.method: 采用多维度分析方法，包括技术能力评估、经济影响分析、合规性考察和竞争格局研究，结合定量数据和定性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 以太坊通过网络效应和机构信任保持主导地位；2) 面临可扩展性挑战和新兴区块链竞争；3) 以太坊稳定币带来降低交易成本和增强金融包容性等经济收益；4) 存在需要谨慎监管的系统性风险；5) 多平台生态系统正在形成。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了区块链平台在监管框架下的多维分析模型；2) 深化了网络效应与监管合规的互动理论；3) 拓展了数字资产生态系统竞争动态的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供稳定币监管实施的参考；2) 为投资者和机构提供以太坊稳定币生态的战略洞察；3) 为区块链开发者提供技术发展方向指导；4) 为政策制定者提供多平台生态系统管理的实践建议。

title: Sustainable Cities : Interdisciplinary Perspective
affiliations: Environment Europe Foundation

detail.title: Sustainable Cities : Interdisciplinary Perspective
detail.abstract: This chapter explores the problem of integrated interdisciplinary research in the fi eld of sustainable cities. The problematique of urban sustainability is studied in its historical and international context. Current research in the fi eld is reviewed, and major gaps in interdisciplinary analysis are identifi ed. This chapter makes fi rst steps towards the development of an innovative methodology for the analysis of interdisciplinary links between various sustainability dimensions in the urban context. The dimensions taken into consideration are: sustainable energy, sustainable transport, material fl ows and waste management, quality of life, health, psychology of interaction with the environment, green space, biodiversity, preservation of the natural and cultural heritage, landscape architecture, ecodesign and democratic participation. Two great European cities, London and St Petersburg, are analysed from the point of view of integrative policies and instruments applied in the fi eld of sustainable urban development. The two cities are compared using a panel of sustainability indicators.

title: Canada's Digital Asset Opportunity: Shaping a Strategic Path to Global Leadership
affiliations: Ivey Business School and University of Western Ontario - Ivey Business School

detail.title: Canada's Digital Asset Opportunity: Shaping a Strategic Path to Global Leadership

declarations.funderStatement: This work was produced in collaboration with Ivey’s Scotiabank Digital Banking Lab. We gratefully acknowledge the generous support of the Lawrence Family, the Baran Family Foundation, the Canada Life Research Fund, the Power Corporation of Canada, and Scotiabank.

detail.abstract:
In collaboration with the Scotiabank Digital Banking Lab, the LNC presents a new perspective policy brief: Canada’s Digital Asset Opportunity: Shaping a Strategic Path to Global Leadership. Authored by Hubert Pun and Amin Mazhari (PhD ’27), the brief explores how Canada is at a pivotal moment in the evolution of the digital economy. Blockchain technologies, digital assets, and tokenized financial systems are no longer emerging trends. They are rapidly becoming part of the core infrastructure for financial innovation, inclusion, and economic competitiveness. 

Canada holds strong foundations: respected regulatory institutions, world-class talent, and a history of early exploration in blockchain research and digital identity frameworks. However, the global race for digital asset leadership is accelerating. Countries such as the United States (through the FIT Act), the European Union (via MiCA), Japan, Singapore, and the UAE are implementing comprehensive frameworks that enable secure stablecoins, digital asset custody, and open financial innovation ecosystems. Meanwhile, Canada risks falling behind. The absence of a coordinated national strategy, limited banking access for blockchain-based firms, and regulatory uncertainty push talent and capital abroad, stifling innovation and undermining long-term competitiveness in financial services and digital infrastructure. 

This brief outlines an actionable roadmap for Canada to reclaim its leadership and secure its position in the programmable economy. With the right strategy, Canada can foster a trusted and competitive digital economy, stimulate high-quality jobs, and deliver long-term economic growth. But without urgent and collaborative action, it risks becoming a follower in an increasingly digital global financial order.
