title: A neural network approach for predicting corruption in public procurement
affiliations: International University of La Rioja (UNIR), Universidad de Valladolid - Department of Finance and Accounting and University of Burgos - Department of Economics

detail.title: A neural network approach for predicting corruption in public procurement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to report
declarations.funderStatement: Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation (PID2020-114797GB-I00)

detail.abstract: We apply topic modelling and neural network algorithms to a sample of more than 70,000 public procurement tenders from 33 European countries between 2016 and 2018. Rather than identifying a binary indicator of possible corruption, we establish a more precise red-flag indicator with four different levels. We initially identify some selection criteria that are more present in tenders with a low number of received offers, a common proxy of corruption. Our model then detects different corruption risk profiles depending on the selection criteria reported in the procurement announcement. Tenders awarded based mainly on price criteria present a higher risk of low competition. Consequently, non-price evaluation criteria (technical quality, environmental issues, etc.) are useful indicators for preventing corruption.

AI.tldr: 通过主题模型和神经网络算法分析欧洲33国70,000份公共采购标书，建立四级腐赏风险指标，发现价格评分标准与低竞争性强相关，非价格标准有助于预防腐赏
AI.research_question: 如何通过采购公告中的选择标准识别不同级别的腐赏风险模式
AI.motivation: 需要比二元指标更精确的腐赏风险评估方法，以提高公共采购的透明度和敏感性
AI.theoretical_framework: 腐赏风险评估理论、采购竞争性理论、机器学习预测模型
AI.method: 使用主题模型和神经网络算法分析33个欧洲国家2016-2018年70,000份公共采购标书，通过招标数量作为腐赏代理指标
AI.findings: 价格评分标准主导的招标存在更高的低竞争风险，而技术质量、环境问题等非价格标准能够有效预防腐赏
AI.theory_contributions: 提出四级腐赏风险评估框架，丰富了腐赏风险识别的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府采购监管提供可操作的风险预警工具，推动采用多元化评标标准以减少腐赏风险

title: The Theorist Of The Over-Indebted State: Jacques Rueff, False Rights, And The Legal Illusions Of Fiscal Overreach Bruno Meyerhof Salama Lecturer At Uc Berkeley Law School Professor Of Law At Fgv Law School In São Paulo, Brazil
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law and Liberty Fund, Inc.

detail.title: The Theorist Of The Over-Indebted State: Jacques Rueff, False Rights, And The Legal Illusions Of Fiscal Overreach Bruno Meyerhof Salama Lecturer At Uc Berkeley Law School Professor Of Law At Fgv Law School In São Paulo, Brazil
detail.abstract: This article argues that Jacques Rueff should be recognized as the central theorist of the modern, overindebted fiscal state. Far from a mere monetary technician, Rueff developed a legal-economic framework that reveals how governments maintain the appearance of legality while hollowing out the substance of rights. His concept of “false rights” — legally valid entitlements that exceed real economic capacity — provides a powerful analytical lens for understanding how inflation, debt monetization, and legal continuity can mask institutional decay. As democracies around the world face rising public debt and expansive welfare obligations, Rueff’s theory explains how the rule of law degrades not through rupture but through fiscal illusion. This paper reconstructs Rueff’s framework and shows why, in the age of systemic fiscal overreach, his work must be read not for historical context, but for conceptual clarity about the present crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文认为雅克·吕夫是现代过度负债财政国家的核心理论家，他提出的'虚假权利'概念揭示了政府如何在维持法律表象的同时掏空权利实质，为理解通胀、债务货币化和制度衰败提供了分析框架。
AI.research_question: 雅克·吕夫的理论如何解释现代财政国家在维持法律连续性的同时出现的制度衰败现象？
AI.motivation: 全球民主国家面临日益增长的公共债务和福利义务，需要理解法治如何通过财政幻觉而非断裂而退化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吕夫的法律-经济框架，特别是'虚假权利'概念（法律上有效但超出实际经济能力的权利主张）
AI.method: 理论重构和分析吕夫的框架
AI.findings: 吕夫的理论揭示了政府如何通过通胀、债务货币化和法律连续性来掩盖制度衰败，财政幻觉导致法治实质退化
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了吕夫作为现代过度负债财政国家核心理论家的地位，提供了分析财政国家制度衰败的新理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前系统性财政过度扩张时代的危机提供了概念清晰度，帮助理解法治退化的机制

title: Does Educational Attainment Impact Geographic and Social Mobility? A Novel Examination of Migration and Residential Attainment
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis, Washington University in St. Louis, Washington University in St. Louis and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: Does Educational Attainment Impact Geographic and Social Mobility? A Novel Examination of Migration and Residential Attainment
detail.abstract: Research on spatial mobility following postsecondary education often focuses narrowly on a single region, institution, or degree type. To address this gap, we use comprehensive educational attainment data from the National Student Clearinghouse linked with administrative earnings, employment, and demographic records from a national credit bureau. We examine whether and how diIerent types of credentials and degrees relate to spatial mobility (intra-and inter-regional), how employment outcomes mediate these relationships, and whether mobility results in residential attainment and neighborhood change. We find that advanced degrees are associated with increased interregional mobility in the short term and more gradual intra-regional moves. Mediation analyses confirm that inter-regional mobility is often triggered by new employment, while intra-regional mobility is more closely tied to earnings gains, reflecting slower processes of residential upgrading. We also find that geographic mobility can produce social mobility, though through distinct mechanisms by race. White individuals tend to relocate across regions into more diverse but less educated neighborhoods, whereas BIPOC individuals more often achieve residential attainment and upward mobility through intra-regional moves to whiter, more educated suburban areas. These findings reveal how racialized opportunity structures shape divergent pathways of gentrification and suburbanization following postsecondary credential attainment.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用全国学生信息中心的教育数据与信用局行政记录，发现高等学历促进跨区域流动（由就业驱动）和区域内流动（由收入增长驱动），但不同种族通过不同机制实现社会流动：白人跨区域迁入更多元化社区，BIPOC群体通过区域内迁移到更白、教育程度更高的郊区实现向上流动。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的高等教育学历如何影响空间流动性（区域内和跨区域）？就业结果如何中介这些关系？流动性是否导致居住获得和社区变化？
AI.motivation: 现有关于高等教育后空间流动的研究往往局限于单一地区、机构或学位类型，需要更全面的分析来理解学历、流动性和社会流动之间的关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间流动性理论、居住获得理论、种族化机会结构理论、社会流动理论
AI.method: 使用国家学生信息中心的教育成就数据与信用局行政收入、就业和人口统计记录的关联数据，进行中介分析和比较研究
AI.findings: 高等学历与短期跨区域流动和渐进区域内流动相关；跨区域流动由新就业触发，区域内流动与收入增长更相关；地理流动可产生社会流动，但种族机制不同：白人跨区域迁入更多元但教育程度较低社区，BIPOC通过区域内迁移到更白、教育程度更高的郊区实现向上流动
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高等教育后种族化机会结构如何塑造绅士化和郊区化的不同路径，拓展了空间流动与社会流动关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者、城市规划者和社区发展提供实证依据，帮助理解不同群体通过高等教育实现社会流动的差异化路径和机制

title: Breaking the Dimensional Barrier: A Pontryagin-Guided Direct Policy Optimization for Continuous-Time Multi-Asset Portfolio Choice
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University, Chonnam National University, Ajou University - Department of Business Administration and Department of Fintech, SKK Business School, Sungkyunkwan University

detail.title: Breaking the Dimensional Barrier: A Pontryagin-Guided Direct Policy Optimization for Continuous-Time Multi-Asset Portfolio Choice
detail.abstract: We introduce the Pontryagin-Guided Direct Policy Optimization (PG-DPO) framework for high-dimensional continuous-time portfolio choice. Our approach combines Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP) with backpropagation through time (BPTT) to directly inform neural network-based policy learning, enabling accurate recovery of both myopic and intertemporal hedging demands-an aspect often missed by existing methods. Building on this, we develop the Projected PG-DPO (P-PGDPO) variant, which achieves nearoptimal policies with substantially improved efficiency. P-PGDPO leverages rapidly stabilizing costate estimates from BPTT and analytically projects them onto PMP's first-order conditions, reducing training overhead while improving precision. Numerical experiments show that PG-DPO matches or exceeds the accuracy of Deep BSDE, while P-PGDPO delivers significantly higher precision and scalability. By explicitly incorporating time-to-maturity, our framework naturally applies to finite-horizon problems and captures horizon-dependent effects, with the long-horizon case emerging as a stationary special case.

AI.tldr: 提出了Pontryagin引导的直接策略优化框架，结合最大值原理和反向传播算法，有效解决高维连续时间投资组合选择问题，能够准确恢复短视和跨期对冲需求。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维连续时间投资组合选择问题中，准确恢复短视和跨期对冲需求，并提高计算效率？
AI.motivation: 现有方法往往无法准确捕捉跨期对冲需求，且在计算效率和精度方面存在不足，需要开发新的优化框架来解决这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Pontryagin最大值原理和反向传播算法，构建神经网络策略学习框架。
AI.method: 结合Pontryagin最大值原理和反向传播算法，开发了PG-DPO和P-PGDPO两种变体，通过解析投影和快速稳定化技术提高效率。
AI.findings: PG-DPO在精度上匹配或超越Deep BSDE方法，P-PGDPO在精度和可扩展性方面表现显著更优，能够有效处理有限和无限时间范围问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将最优控制理论与深度学习相结合的新框架，为连续时间随机控制问题提供了新的理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了高效的投资组合优化算法，能够处理高维问题，为实际金融决策提供了实用的计算工具。

title: When Does Top Management Team Diversity Matter in Large Organizations?
affiliations: University of Memphis, Loyola Marymount University - College of Business Administration and Loyola Marymount University

detail.title: When Does Top Management Team Diversity Matter in Large Organizations?
detail.abstract: Top management teams (TMTs) drive strategic leadership, but there is little clarity on when the composition of these upper echelons most impact organization performance. Drawing from the Categorization-Elaboration Model, we study an eighteen-year sample of approximately 4,500 organizations and over 32,000 executives and find a positive relationship between top management team functional diversity and organization performance, but only for the smaller organizations. We tested how organization size (and correlates of age/complexity) negatively interact with functional diversity. Testing for TMT integration proxies, top management tenure counteracted the negative impact of size making functional diversity beneficial in large organizations as well. Additionally, CEO tenure modestly strengthens the impact of TMT functional diversity, while, surprisingly, CEO generalism may serve as a substitute for it. Our large-sample study provides novel methodological guidance for performing substantial constructive replication, with competitive tests for both diversity and performance measures suggesting the best measures and time leads in testing the functional diversity-financial performance relationship. Our findings support the importance of tailoring TMT management strategies to contingencies for the organizational context, and informing CEO leadership strategies to characteristics across the CEO-TMT interface. Most importantly, these implications are pressing in the face of rapidly growing organizations in the world economy.

AI.tldr: 高层管理团队功能多样性与组织绩效呈正相关，但仅适用于小型组织。组织规模会负向调节这种关系，而TMT任期可以抵消规模的负面影响。CEO任期增强功能多样性效果，CEO通才性可替代功能多样性。
AI.research_question: 高层管理团队功能多样性在什么条件下对组织绩效产生积极影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然高层管理团队驱动战略领导，但对其组成何时最影响组织绩效缺乏清晰认识，特别是在面对快速增长的组织时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分类-精细化模型（Categorization-Elaboration Model）
AI.method: 18年样本研究，涵盖约4,500个组织和32,000多名高管，使用竞争性测试检验多样性和绩效测量。
AI.findings: 功能多样性与绩效正相关但仅限于小组织；组织规模负向调节；TMT任期抵消规模负面影响；CEO任期增强效果；CEO通才性可替代功能多样性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为功能多样性-财务绩效关系提供最佳测量和时间领先指导，支持根据组织情境定制TMT管理策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CEO领导策略提供指导，特别是在CEO-TMT界面特征方面，对快速成长的组织具有重要实践意义。

title: Recombination And New Knowledge Origins as Measures of Ex-Ante Novelty: New Methodology Applied to the Study of Patent Quality in Pharmaceuticals and Computer Technology
affiliations: University of East Anglia and University of East Anglia

detail.title: Recombination And New Knowledge Origins as Measures of Ex-Ante Novelty: New Methodology Applied to the Study of Patent Quality in Pharmaceuticals and Computer Technology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We make a methodological contribution by proposing two new network-based indices to measure ex-ante technological novelty. The Inverse Recombination Intensity Index captures the extent to which an invention is the outcome of a novel combination of pre-existing technological components. The New Technology Ratio measures the share of new knowledge elements in the invention. Through an in-depth empirical study of widely available patent data from the Pharmaceuticals and Computer Technology sectors for nearly 40 years, we show that our proposed indices are weakly correlated with patent indicators previously used in the literature, and hence add further information. Moreover, these indices have the power to detect novel sector-specific characteristics of the invention process. We demonstrate that our indices are important predictors of a patent's potential impact on future inventions, too, through the use of regression analysis where we also control for applicants' residence, and sector-country-specific R&D input variables weighted at the individual patent level. Our results open new avenues for research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两个新的网络指标来测量技术新颖性：逆重组强度指数和新知识比率，通过专利数据分析发现这些指标与传统指标相关性较弱，能够检测发明过程的特定特征，并能预测专利对未来发明的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何有效测量技术发明的事前新颖性？新提出的网络指标是否能为技术新颖性测量提供额外信息？
AI.motivation: 现有技术新颖性测量指标存在局限性，需要开发新的网络分析方法来更准确地评估发明的创新程度和潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术组合理论和知识网络理论，认为技术发明是通过重新组合现有技术组件或引入新知识元素来实现创新。
AI.method: 提出两个新指标：逆重组强度指数（测量技术组件的新颖组合程度）和新知识比率（测量新知识元素占比）；使用制药和计算机技术领域近40年的专利数据进行实证分析；采用回归分析控制申请人国籍和研发投入变量。
AI.findings: 新指标与传统专利指标相关性较弱，提供了额外信息；能够检测发明过程的行业特定特征；是预测专利未来影响力的重要指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于网络分析的技术新颖性测量新框架，丰富了技术创新理论的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专利评估和技术创新管理提供了新的分析工具，有助于识别具有高潜在影响力的发明，指导研发投资决策。

title: Nigeria's Tax Reform Acts 2025 : Strategic Implications for Business Operations and Recommended Adaptive Strategies
affiliations: ACTAG

detail.title: Nigeria's Tax Reform Acts 2025 : Strategic Implications for Business Operations and Recommended Adaptive Strategies
detail.abstract: Nigeria's comprehensive tax reform initiative, which led to the enactment of four important tax laws in June 2025, represents the most significant overhaul of the nation's fiscal framework in decades. This paper examines the strategic implications of the Nigeria Tax Act (NTA), Nigeria Tax Administration Act (NTAA), Nigeria Revenue Service Act (NRSA), and Joint Revenue Board Act (JRBA) for business operations within Africa's largest economy. Through analysis of the legislative provisions and their alignment with international best practices, this study identifies critical areas of business impact and provides evidence-based recommendations for organizational adaptation. The research reveals that while the reforms promise enhanced revenue generation and improved ease of doing business, they simultaneously introduce complexity requiring strategic recalibration across multiple business functions. The findings suggest that early preparation and proactive compliance strategies will be essential for maintaining competitive advantage in the new tax environment.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚2025年税收改革通过四项重要法案，代表数十年来最重大的财政框架改革，对非洲最大经济体的商业运营产生深远影响，既带来收入增长和营商环境改善，也增加了业务复杂性。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚税收改革法案对商业运营的战略影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚2025年实施的全面税收改革是该国数十年来最重要的财政框架改革，需要研究这些改革对非洲最大经济体商业运营的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收政策理论、财政改革理论、国际最佳实践框架
AI.method: 通过对立法条款的分析及其与国际最佳实践的对比研究
AI.findings: 改革在增强收入生成和改善营商环境的同时，也给多个业务职能带来了复杂性，需要进行战略重新调整
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家税收改革对商业影响的理论研究提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了基于证据的组织适应建议，强调早期准备和主动合规策略对保持竞争优势的重要性

title: The Extent to which the Physical Principles of Light Propagation in Optical Fibers Influence the Perceived Reliability and Infrastructural Integration of High-Speed Internet Services in Semi-Urban Regions of India
affiliations: The Shri Ram School Delhi, Students

detail.title: The Extent to which the Physical Principles of Light Propagation in Optical Fibers Influence the Perceived Reliability and Infrastructural Integration of High-Speed Internet Services in Semi-Urban Regions of India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author Contact: aryannkhokha@gmail.com or khokhhaaryann@gmail.com Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aryannkhokha/ Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=z9iZYyYAAAAJ&hl=en The author declares no conflicts of interest and acknowledges that the research was conducted without external funding that could have influenced the study design or interpretation of results
declarations.ethicsApproval: Data collection utilized a structured questionnaire administered through survey forms. This research adhered to rigorous ethical standards throughout the data collection process. All participants were comprehensively informed about the study's objectives, methodology, and intended use of the collected data. A detailed confidentiality and data-handling policy was provided to ensure transparency regarding data protection measures. Participants were notified of this research’s prohibition on data sharing with third parties for commercial, non-commercial and non-academic purposes. Prior to participation, participants were required to review comprehensive terms of participation that outlined their rights, responsibilities, and the permanent nature of the data submission. Informed consent was obtained through an embedded clause in the data collection instrument requiring explicit acknowledgment: "By continuing with this survey, you affirm that you have read and understood the terms set forth in this document, and you consent to participate under these conditions. If you do not accept these terms in full, you are advised to discontinue your participation immediately and exit the form." All identifying information, including names, email addresses, were excluded from the analysis and publication to ensure participant anonymity. Data was immediately aggregated and anonymized upon analysis to prevent individual identification. The research protocol emphasized voluntary participation while requiring complete responses to maintain data integrity. Participants were informed that digital transmission inherently carries minimal security risks, which they accepted as part of their consent to participate
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no conflicts of interest and acknowledges that the research was conducted without external funding that could have influenced the study design or interpretation of results

detail.abstract: Background: The rapid global proliferation of high-speed internet services hinges on the deployment of optical fiber cabels, especially in regions with higher digital demands. Optical fibers, utilizing fundamental physical principles such as total internal reflection, controlled modal dispersion, and minimal signal attenuation, have overtaken outdated technologies, such as copper wires, due to their unrivaled capacity, bandwidth, and immunity to electromagnetic interference. Despite quick adoption in urban regions; developing nations like India exhibit a distinct digital divide, with semi-urban populations often underserved. Prevailing technical literature broadly documents the advantages and operational physics of fiber optic systems, yet direct empirical connections between these physics-based strengths and user-perceived reliability (especially in semi-urban contexts) remain scarce, with present gaps. Further, the influence of demographic variables on reliability perceptions within such settings is inadequately explored, hence hindering whether infrastructural development translates into user trust and satisfaction. Methods: This quantitative study systematically investigated the extent to which the optical physics of fiber affect the perceived reliability and infrastructural integration of high-speed internet services across semi-urban regions of India. Convenience sampling yielded 3,701 valid respondents (from 3,852 initial participants; a 96.08% retention) who possessed direct experience with optical fiber internet and met rigorous exclusion criteria ensuring adequate exposure, technical awareness, and demographic relevance. The research incorporated four validated psychometric instruments: Davis's Perceived Usefulness Scale, Khan's Network Quality Perception Scale, the SERVQUAL Reliability dimension, and the E-S-QUAL System Availability instrument. Each instrument demonstrated high reliability (α > 0.80). The study employed independent samples t-tests and correlation analyses to evaluate differences and relationships across gender-and age-based cohorts, controlling for demographic and technical variables. Data distributions were confirmed normal via Quantile-Quantile (Q-Q) plots, validating the use of parametric statistical tests. Results: The empirical findings revealed highly consistent perception patterns across all demographic subgroups. Gender and age-based differences in perceived usefulness, network quality perception, and system availability were statistically non-significant, each demonstrating negligible effect sizes (Cohen's d < 0.10, p > 0.20). Only perceived reliability showed a statistically significant but practically negligible gender difference (p = 0.005, d = 0.09), with male respondents scoring minimally higher. Correlational analyses indicated a near-total independence among perceived usefulness, system availability, and technical quality assessments. The most striking result was a strong, negative correlation between network quality perception and perceived reliability (r =-0.66, p < 0.001), suggesting that heightened awareness of technical excellence may foster more critical attitudes toward reliability, accounting for 44% of the variance observed. No significant correlations were observed between either system availability or perceived usefulness and reliability, contradicting expectations from physics-based performance theory. Conclusions: The study presents robust evidence that the core physical principles of optical fiber operation provide uniformly positive user experiences in semi-urban India, independent of demographic variations. The practical implication is that optical fiber's inherent qualities create stable, high-quality internet experiences universally. Paradoxically, increased user awareness of these technical strengths can heighten reliability expectations, often leading to stricter scrutiny of service dependability. For infrastructure stakeholders, these insights recommend prioritizing physics-centric deployment and performance consistency over demographic tailoring. The research advances understanding in the intersection between physical infrastructure and human perception, while highlighting a need for continued study on expectation management and physics-specific user awareness in diverse markets. The study's cross-sectional design and convenience sampling limit wider generalizability, yet its methodological rigor offers a strong foundation for future longitudinal and cross-context investigations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量分析发现光纤物理特性在印度半城市地区创造了统一的优质用户体验，不受人口统计差异影响。但用户对技术优势的认知会提高可靠性期望，导致更严格的服务可靠性审视。
AI.research_question: 光纤物理特性如何影响印度半城市地区高速互联网服务的感知可靠性和基础设施整合？
AI.motivation: 尽管光纤技术优势已被广泛记录，但其物理特性与用户感知可靠性之间的直接实证联系，特别是在半城市环境中的影响，以及人口统计变量对此感知的影响，仍存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于光纤物理原理（全内反射、模态色散控制、最小信号衰减）与用户感知理论，结合Davis感知有用性量表、Khan网络质量感知量表、SERVQUAL可靠性维度和E-S-QUAL系统可用性工具。
AI.method: 定量研究，便利抽样获得3,701名有效受访者，使用四个验证过的心理测量工具，采用独立样本t检验和相关分析，控制人口统计和技术变量。
AI.findings: 所有人口统计亚组的感知模式高度一致，性别和年龄差异统计不显著。网络质量感知与感知可靠性呈强负相关（r=-0.66），技术优势认知可能引发更严格的可靠性审视。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了对物理基础设施与人类感知交叉领域的理解，揭示了技术认知与可靠性期望之间的悖论关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基础设施利益相关者提供见解：应优先考虑以物理为中心的部署和性能一致性，而非人口统计定制，强调期望管理和物理特定用户认知的重要性。

title: Time Horizons of Equity Types
affiliations: Mercer

detail.title: Time Horizons of Equity Types
detail.abstract:
Equity compensation has long been analyzed through tax rules, accounting treatment, and capital structure effects, yet one critical dimension has been underexamined: the role of time horizon. This paper develops a temporal framework for understanding equity instruments as behavioral and governance devices that transmit incentives across distinct time intervals. Stock options catalyze short-term alignment but often distort capital allocation and increase volatility. Restricted Stock Units extend incentives into the medium term, supporting retention and project continuity, yet lack durable ownership features. Employee Stock Ownership Plans uniquely embed long-term participatory ownership, linking wealth accumulation to fiduciary trust structures that span an employee’s career. Synthetic equity and event-driven vehicles, increasingly common in private equity, resemble deferred bonuses rather than enduring ownership, binding workers to liquidity cycles without governance rights.

Drawing on empirical data and case studies, the paper argues that equity design must be treated as a temporal contract between labor and capital. When layered intentionally, short-, medium-, and long-term instruments can create a coherent ownership architecture, balancing retention, performance alignment, and durable wealth-building. The analysis highlights how ESOPs generate measurable gains in productivity, retention, and household wealth, while acknowledging their scalability constraints in large firms. The central claim is that time is not incidental to equity design but a constitutive variable that determines whether compensation functions as transactional reward or as enduring institutional ownership. This framework offers compensation and governance professionals a new lens for designing equity systems that align incentives with both enterprise sustainability and employee capital inclusion

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个时间框架来分析股权激励工具，认为股权设计应被视为劳动与资本之间的时间契约，通过分层使用短期、中期和长期工具来平衡保留、绩效对齐和持久财富积累。
AI.research_question: 股权激励工具如何作为行为和管理机制在不同时间区间传递激励？时间维度如何影响股权补偿作为交易性奖励或持久制度性所有权的作用？
AI.motivation: 传统股权补偿分析主要关注税收规则、会计处理和资本结构效应，但时间维度这一关键因素被低估了。需要理解股权工具如何在不同时间区间内传递激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间框架理论，将股权工具视为行为和管理机制，分析其在不同时间区间（短期、中期、长期）的激励传递功能。
AI.method: 实证数据和案例研究分析
AI.findings: 股票期权促进短期对齐但增加波动性；限制性股票单位支持中期保留但缺乏持久所有权；员工持股计划独特地嵌入长期参与性所有权；合成股权类似延期奖金而非持久所有权。分层使用不同期限工具可创建连贯的所有权架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了时间作为股权设计的构成性变量而非偶然因素的理论框架，将股权设计重新概念化为劳动与资本之间的时间契约。
AI.practical_contributions: 为薪酬和管理专业人士提供了设计股权系统的新视角，使激励措施与企业可持续性和员工资本包容性相一致，特别强调了ESOPs在生产力、保留率和家庭财富方面的可衡量收益。

title: Enhancing Cross-Functional Collaboration in Hybrid Projects: The Role of Business Analysis Standards in Bridging Predictive and Agile Practices
affiliations: University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF), University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF) and University of Niagara Falls Canada (UNF)

detail.title: Enhancing Cross-Functional Collaboration in Hybrid Projects: The Role of Business Analysis Standards in Bridging Predictive and Agile Practices
detail.abstract: Hybrid project approaches that integrate both predictive and agile methods demand successful cross-functional teamwork to deliver successful project outcomes. The research explores how business analysis standards such as the BABOK Guide and the PMI Guide to Business Analysis help improve team collaboration in hybrid project environments. The systematic literature review in the study examines the role BA standards play in supporting stakeholder alignment and shared understanding while bridging communication gaps between technical and non-technical team members. The research indicates that BABOK enhances stakeholders' ability to collaborate while the PMI Guide offers a strategic approach to integrate business analysis with overall project objectives. Business Analysis standards improve project results and teamwork effectiveness even though challenges like resistance to change and tool adaptability remain in agile environments. The study delivers practical recommendations for organizations aiming to boost team coordination and communication in hybrid project environments by utilizing structured business analysis methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了BABOK指南和PMI业务分析指南等业务分析标准如何改善混合项目环境中的团队协作，发现这些标准能提升利益相关者协作能力、促进战略整合，从而提高项目成果和团队效率。
AI.research_question: 业务分析标准（如BABOK指南和PMI业务分析指南）如何帮助改善混合项目环境中的团队协作？
AI.motivation: 混合项目方法需要整合预测性和敏捷方法，成功的跨职能团队协作对于项目成果至关重要，但缺乏对业务分析标准在此环境中作用的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于混合项目管理理论、业务分析标准和团队协作理论，探讨标准在促进利益相关者对齐和共享理解方面的作用。
AI.method: 系统文献综述方法，系统性地分析相关文献资料。
AI.findings: BABOK指南增强利益相关者协作能力，PMI指南提供将业务分析与整体项目目标整合的战略方法；业务分析标准能改善项目结果和团队效率，但在敏捷环境中仍面临变革阻力和工具适应性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了混合项目管理理论，明确了业务分析标准在促进跨职能团队协作和沟通中的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了在混合项目环境中利用结构化业务分析方法来提升团队协调和沟通的实践建议。

title: From Narratives to Action: Leveraging AI to Decode and Advance Sustainability Commitments
affiliations: ESCP Business School, Madrid campus

detail.title: From Narratives to Action: Leveraging AI to Decode and Advance Sustainability Commitments

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite widespread pledges to tackle climate change, the credibility and comparability of country and corporate commitments remain limited. This impact paper draws on two recent AI-based studies: one analysing over 300 climate pledges (Nationally Determined Contributions, or NDCs) submitted under the Paris Agreement, and another examining almost 1,500 Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports of STOXX Europe 600 companies. Using methods from natural language processing (NLP), the studies reveal which themes are emphasised, how they vary across countries and firms, and how they relate to actual emissions reductions and environmental performance. This paper discusses how AI can highlight gaps between discourse and action, and proposes ways in which NLP techniques, including topic modelling and large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, can improve transparency and comparability in sustainability reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过AI技术分析气候承诺和ESG报告，揭示话语与行动之间的差距，并提出NLP方法提高可持续发展报告的透明度和可比性
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI技术评估气候承诺和ESG报告的可信度与可比性，并识别话语与实际行动之间的差距
AI.motivation: 尽管各国和企业广泛承诺应对气候变化，但其承诺的可信度和可比性仍然有限，需要新的方法来提高透明度和问责制
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然语言处理（NLP）理论，包括主题建模和大型语言模型（如ChatGPT），用于文本分析和模式识别
AI.method: 使用NLP方法分析300多个国家自主贡献（NDCs）和近1,500份STOXX Europe 600公司的ESG报告，识别主题重点、国家/公司间差异及其与实际减排和环境绩效的关系
AI.findings: 研究揭示了气候承诺和ESG报告中强调的主题存在显著差异，这些差异与实际减排效果和环境绩效存在关联，显示出话语与行动之间的差距
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了NLP在环境政策和企业可持续发展研究中的应用，建立了文本分析与实际环境绩效之间的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了改进气候承诺和ESG报告透明度的具体方法，有助于提高承诺的可比性和问责制，推动更有效的气候行动

title: Integration of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) into Economic Strategy: Long-Term Effects on Organizational Financial Performance, Financial Implications, and Constraints
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Integration of ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) into Economic Strategy: Long-Term Effects on Organizational Financial Performance, Financial Implications, and Constraints
detail.abstract: This study is focused on investigating the application of Environmental, Social, and Corporate Governance (ESG) criteria to the business strategies of the London Stock Exchange-listed firms and the subsequent long-term changes in the financial performances of these organizations. In the period ranging from 2018 to 2023, data for 200 companies are used to test the influence of individual ESG elements such as the environment, social involvement, and governance on the economic aspects. The research was done using data from 200 companies over the period 2018-2023, where the effect of ESG components on the companies' financial performance was observed. Techniques like descriptive statistics, correlation matrices, and regression models were used in the analysis, and the determining factors were operational constraints on the financial side and the corporate size factor for the non-financial features. The findings point towards the ESG components' overall impact on corporate strategies, hereby the positive financial performance emphasizing the advantages. Nevertheless, the strength of the relationship concerning ESG components may differ. Financial constraints take their toll as the main limitation, resulting in poor implementation and hence a lesser financial benefit. These results have thrown more light on the financial problems of the UK environmental policies pointing to both the good and bad sides of the strategies adopted by companies and corporate executives.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨伦敦证券交易所上市公司应用ESG标准对财务绩效的长期影响，发现ESG整体对财务表现有正面作用，但各成分影响程度不同，财务约束是主要限制因素。
AI.research_question: ESG标准在伦敦证券交易所上市公司业务战略中的应用如何影响这些组织的长期财务绩效？
AI.motivation: 研究ESG标准在企业战略中的应用及其对财务绩效的影响，为英国环境政策提供财务层面的见解，揭示企业策略的优缺点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境、社会和公司治理（ESG）理论框架，分析各成分对企业财务绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用200家公司在2018-2023年期间的数据，采用描述性统计、相关矩阵和回归模型进行分析，考虑财务约束和公司规模等因素。
AI.findings: ESG成分整体对企业战略有积极影响，能带来正面财务绩效，但各成分的影响强度存在差异；财务约束是主要限制因素，导致实施效果不佳和财务收益减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了ESG理论在财务绩效影响机制方面的理解，揭示了不同ESG成分的差异化影响效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国上市公司提供ESG战略实施的实践指导，帮助企业管理层认识财务约束对ESG实施的影响，优化资源配置和战略决策。

title: Cultural Analysis of the Legend of the Little Widow
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Cultural Analysis of the Legend of the Little Widow
detail.abstract: This study examines the Colombian legend of La Viudita as a multifaceted cultural phenomenon, analyzing its social, ethical, emotional, and economic dimensions. The legend functions as a tool for transmitting values, reinforcing communal norms, and shaping territorial identity. Through frameworks of Durkheimian sociology, semiotics, behavioral pedagogy, and cultural capital, the research explores how the narrative adapts to modern media, evokes collective emotions, and generates cultural and economic resources. Findings highlight the legend's ongoing relevance as a mechanism for identity construction, moral guidance, emotional regulation, and cultural tourism development.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析哥伦比亚传说《La Viudita》作为多维度文化现象，探讨其在价值观传递、社区规范强化和地域认同塑造方面的作用，结合社会学、符号学和教育学理论框架，揭示该传说在现代媒体中的适应性及其在文化认同、道德引导和旅游发展中的持续相关性。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚传说《La Viudita》如何作为多维度文化现象，在社会、伦理、情感和经济层面发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 探索民间传说在现代社会中的持续文化功能，理解其如何通过不同维度（社会、伦理、情感、经济）影响社区认同和价值传递。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涂尔干社会学理论、符号学、行为教育学、文化资本理论
AI.method: 理论框架分析，结合文化现象的多维度考察（社会、伦理、情感、经济层面）
AI.findings: 该传说作为价值观传递工具，能够强化社区规范、塑造地域认同，适应现代媒体形式，唤起集体情感，并产生文化和经济资源
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了民间传说研究的理论框架，整合社会学、符号学和教育学视角，深化对文化资本生成机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为文化传承提供实践指导，支持文化旅游业发展，为社区认同建设和道德教育提供参考模式

detail.abstract: Business schools must rethink their role in addressing global sustainability challenges. This text offers a reflective guide-Head, Heart, Hands, and Place-to support transformative pedagogy and shares grounded practices we used to reorient our teaching and learning. We call on educators and higher education leaders to reimagine business education as a plural, critical, and context-sensitive practice.

AI.findings: 提出了支持变革性教学法的具体框架和实践方法，能够帮助商学院重新定位其教育角色

title: From Conflict to Complexity: Extending Dynamic Capabilities into Multi-Stakeholder Ecosystems through Value Web Strategy

detail.title: From Conflict to Complexity: Extending Dynamic Capabilities into Multi-Stakeholder Ecosystems through Value Web Strategy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: Classic strategy frameworks, such as Porter's Five Forces, the Value Stick, Blue Ocean Strategy, and Platform Strategy, have shaped decades of scholarship and practice. Yet they remain predominantly organization-centric, emphasizing competition, conflict resolution, or resource leverage. These models are less equipped for contemporary ecosystems where legitimacy, trust, coalition dynamics, cultural norms, and evolving narratives drive outcomes. This conceptual paper introduces Value Web Strategy, which synthesizes insights from the Resource-Based View, Dynamic Capabilities, and Playing to Win into a broader, stakeholder-centric paradigm. By articulating ten dynamics of stakeholder ecosystems, the paper argues that strategy must move from organizational competition to ecosystem stewardship, where value is co-created and legitimacy sustained across interdependent actors. Importantly, the framework is operationalized through two novel constructs: Mapping the Value Web (MAV) and Power-Value Distribution (PVD) to visualize stakeholder dynamics, and the Ecosystem Value Score (EVS) to quantify ecosystem health and value balance. These tools move the framework from conceptual insight to practical application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出价值网络战略框架，将传统组织中心战略转向利益相关者生态系统管理，通过MAV、PVD和EVS工具实现从概念到实践的转化。
AI.research_question: 如何在当代生态系统中发展超越传统组织中心战略框架的新战略范式？
AI.motivation: 传统战略框架（如波特五力模型、蓝海战略等）过于组织中心化，无法有效应对以合法性、信任、联盟动态和文化规范为驱动的现代生态系统挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合资源基础观、动态能力和Playing to Win理论，构建利益相关者中心的战略范式。
AI.method: 概念性论文，通过理论整合和框架构建方法。
AI.findings: 提出价值网络战略框架，包含十个利益相关者生态系统动态，强调从组织竞争转向生态系统管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了利益相关者中心的战略理论，扩展了传统战略框架的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供Mapping the Value Web (MAV)、Power-Value Distribution (PVD)和Ecosystem Value Score (EVS)三个实用工具，用于可视化和量化生态系统健康与价值平衡。

title: Innovating in Europe: Creating Value under Constraints Overcoming Risk Inhibitors to Unlock Innovation Value
affiliations: ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Innovating in Europe: Creating Value under Constraints Overcoming Risk Inhibitors to Unlock Innovation Value

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Faced with accrued competition in the race to innovate and unstable geoeconomics forces, Europe competitiveness is stymied, particularly in frontier innovations. While offering significant potential returns, frontier innovations are risky, and, in the event of failure, costs are substantial, largely because of restructuring costs disproportionately high, disincentivizing European companies and resulting in a loss of competitive value. In this context, a crucial question arises: how to optimize investments in frontier innovations to turn it into a driver of competitiveness while mitigating risks? One answer is to approach innovation as a value-creation enabler, harnessing strategic opportunity gains and minimizing its costs-accounting for trade-off and hidden costs. We propose a value-driven framework to create strategic value and competitive advantage, supported by multidimensional, contextual and dynamic indicators which encompass the potential impacts of innovations within its ecosystem. As a strategic and performance management tool, a value-driven approach to innovation investment can generate shared benefits.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种价值驱动的案案来优化欧洲在前沿创新领域的投资，通过综合考量战略机会收益和隐藏成本来提升竞争力并降低风险。

detail.title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Legend of the Patetarro
detail.abstract: This study explores the moralizing value of the Colombian legend of El Patetarro, understood as a myth functioning as a mechanism of social control and ecological preservation. Drawing on the theories of Machiavelli and Hobbes, the analysis examines the figure of the “anti-villain” as a feared being who, through fear, guides communities toward the common good. The research highlights how the pedagogy of terror operates as a didactic resource to reinforce social norms, prevent transgressions, and protect natural environments, thus demonstrating the myth’s cultural and political significance.

title: AI and Environmental Accountability: A New Index for Real-world Impact
affiliations: ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: AI and Environmental Accountability: A New Index for Real-world Impact

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is widely expected to advance corporate sustainability goals; however, its actual environmental contributions remain difficult to quantify. While existing sustainability metrics are valuable, they are not designed to isolate AI's specific impact across diverse sectors and often conflate technical potential with ecological outcomes. This paper introduces the AI and Green Innovation Index (AIGII), a structured, output-oriented framework that enables organizations to assess the observable environmental effects of AI adoption. Developed through a synthesis of sustainability accounting, digital transformation research, and ecological indicator design, the AIGII focuses on five key dimensions: energy efficiency, resource utilization, waste and circularity, lifecycle impact, and operational optimization. Unlike input-or capability-based assessments, the framework focuses on outcomes that organizations can monitor, compare, and take action on. In doing so, it provides a practical response to the growing calls for transparency, benchmarking, and accountability in AI-driven sustainability initiatives. By equipping stakeholders with a tool to evaluate whether digital transformation efforts align with environmental priorities, this paper contributes to a more evidence-informed approach to sustainable innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI与绿色创新指数（AIGII），这是一个以产出为导向的框架，用于量化评估AI采用对环境的具体影响，解决了现有指标无法分离AI贡献的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够准确评估AI采用对环境具体影响的量化框架？
AI.motivation: 虽然人工智能被广泛期望推动企业可持续发展目标，但其实际环境贡献难以量化，现有可持续性指标无法分离AI在跨行业的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合可持续性会计、数字化转型研究和生态指标设计理论，构建以产出为导向的评估框架。
AI.method: 开发AI与绿色创新指数（AIGII），聚焦五个关键维度：能源效率、资源利用、废弃物与循环性、生命周期影响和运营优化。
AI.findings: AIGII提供了一个实用的框架，使组织能够监测、比较AI驱动的可持续性举措的实际环境效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个专门针对AI环境影响的产出导向评估框架，填补了现有理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利益相关者提供了评估数字化转型是否与环境优先事项一致的工具，支持透明度、基准测试和问责制。

title: Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization Framework with ABC-XYZ Classification: Evidence from Simulation-Based Validation
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization Framework with ABC-XYZ Classification: Evidence from Simulation-Based Validation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses simulation and publicly available, non-identifiable operational datasets. No human participants, patient data, or animal experiments were involved; institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Data and code are publicly available via Mendeley Data (DOI: 10.17632/5vfhypcfy2.1).

detail.abstract: We develop and validate an inventory optimization framework for multi-SKU systems using ABC-XYZ dual classification with differentiated service strategies. The framework implements an (R,Q) inventory policy for 100 SKUs with heterogeneous demand patterns, targeting cycle service levels of 98%, 95%, and 90% for A, B, and C class items. A 12-month rolling simulation with stochastic demand and 10-day fixed lead times yields an inventory turnover of 41.0 times annually with an average total inventory of 96.4 million CNY. Analysis of warehouse configurations reveals that decentralization from a single to a dual warehouse requires 40.7% more inventory under unconstrained conditions and 14.0% under budget constraints, confirming theoretical risk pooling predictions for correlated demand. Lead-time sensitivity analysis reveals that re-optimizing policies for parameter changes produces 2.24-fold greater cost variability than maintaining fixed policies. Economic evaluation of 75 lateral transshipment opportunities identifies 16 viable transfers (21.3% success rate), generating 1.11 million CNY net benefit. The validated framework with publicly available data provides practitioners with tools for implementing inventory strategies in multi-echelon distribution networks.

AI.tldr: 基于ABC-XYZ双重分类的多SKU库存优化框架，通过差异化服务策略实现高库存周转率，分析了仓库配置、导期敏感性和横向转运的经济效益。
AI.research_question: 如何在多SKU系统中通过ABC-XYZ双重分类和差异化服务策略实现最优库存管理？
AI.motivation: 多SKU库存系统面临需求异质性、仓库配置、导期变化等复杂挑战，需要一个综合优化框架来提升库存效率和降低成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: ABC-XYZ双重分类法、(R,Q)库存策略、风险池理论、随机需求模型
AI.method: 建立100个SKU的(R,Q)库存模型，A类98%、B类95%、C类90%周期服务水平，进行12个月滚动模拟（随机需求+10天固定导期）
AI.findings: 年库存周转41.0次，平均库存96.4万元；双仓库比单仓库需要40.7%更多库存；导期变化使成本变动增加2.24倍；横向转运成功率21.3%，净收益111万元
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了相关需求情况下风险池理论的预测，提供了ABC-XYZ分类在多SKU库存优化中的实证基础
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实施差异化服务策略的具体框架，为实践者提供了仓库配置、导期管理和横向转运的决策支持

title: Adoption Barriers in the Last-Mile Ecosystem: Robotic Delivery vs. Electrified Modes
affiliations: Purdue University, Purdue University, Addis Ababa University, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, Purdue University, Thuong Mai University and La Trobe University

detail.title: Adoption Barriers in the Last-Mile Ecosystem: Robotic Delivery vs. Electrified Modes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: On behalf of all authors, the corresponding author states that there is no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding associated with this research.

detail.abstract: Advances in automation and information systems are fostering new models for last-mile delivery, such as autonomous road vehicles, sidewalk and indoor robots, drones, and cargo bikes. While promising to enhance logistical efficiency, these technologies face significant adoption barriers. This study begins by systematically evaluating and comparing these emerging modes based on their characteristics and application contexts. We then conduct a systematic review of peer-reviewed literature (2010-2025) to synthesize research on autonomous delivery robots-an area that remains understudied. Our analysis thoroughly explores the research and practical challenges of these robots in comparison to other modes, focusing on pilot projects, public acceptance, safety, privacy, security, technical development, and regulatory frameworks. The findings indicate that adoption scales not only through technological autonomy but also via social legibility and facilitating conditions. Furthermore, while safety perceptions are influenced by regulatory framing, technological advances must be paired with operational governance and co-design to improve public space interaction. This paper provides critical insights for policymakers to formulate relevant regulations, for transportation agencies to adapt infrastructure and legal frameworks, and for industry leaders to develop strategic implementation plans.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了新兴最后一英里配送模式（自动驾驶车辆、机器人、无人机等），通过文献综述分析了自主配送机器人的研究现状和实践挑战，发现技术自主性、社会可读性和促进条件共同影响采用规模，安全感知受监管框架影响，需要技术发展与运营治理相结合。
AI.research_question: 新兴自主配送技术面临哪些采用障碍？如何通过技术发展、社会接受度和监管框架来促进其规模化采用？
AI.motivation: 自动化和信息系统的发展催生了新的最后一英里配送模式，但这些技术面临显著的采用障碍，需要系统评估和比较以促进其有效实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术采用理论、社会技术系统理论和监管治理框架，分析自主配送技术的多维度挑战。
AI.method: 系统文献综述（2010-2025年同行评审文献），系统评估和比较新兴配送模式的特征和应用情境。
AI.findings: 1) 采用规模不仅取决于技术自主性，还依赖于社会可读性和促进条件；2) 安全感知受监管框架影响；3) 技术进步需要与运营治理和协同设计相结合以改善公共空间互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术采用理论在社会技术系统中的应用，提出了自主配送技术采用的多维度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者制定相关法规、交通机构调整基础设施和法律框架、行业领导者制定战略实施计划提供关键见解。

title: The Evolutionary Advantage of Neurodiversity: A Polygenic Threshold Model for Cognitive Specialization in Human Groups
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Evolutionary Advantage of Neurodiversity: A Polygenic Threshold Model for Cognitive Specialization in Human Groups
detail.abstract: Neurodevelopmental conditions such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), and dyslexia are present in all human populations at a stable prevalence of approximately 2-5% per trait, posing a paradox for evolutionary models that would predict the elimination of traits with apparent fitness costs. This paper synthesizes evidence from genetics, evolutionary biology, anthropology, and disability studies to propose a comprehensive framework that resolves this paradox. We argue that neurodiversity is not a collection of deficits but an evolutionary strategy maintained by balancing selection. This strategy promotes cognitive specialization within small, ancestral human groups (~150 individuals, per Dunbar's number), enhancing collective problem-solving and adaptability. The stable 2-5% prevalence is presented as a predictable outcome of a polygenic threshold model, where a specific number of common genetic variants must be inherited for a specialized cognitive profile to emerge. While critically engaging with the risks of romanticization and the lived realities of disability, this framework posits that neurodivergent traits conferred significant adaptive advantages in ancestral environments. We conclude by outlining a modern, applied neurodiversity framework for creating more inclusive and innovative educational, occupational, and therapeutic systems that align with this evolutionary heritage.

AI.tldr: 神经多样性不是缺陷而是进化策略，通过平衡选择维持，在小型祖先群体中促进认知专业化和集体适应性，2-5%的稳定患病率是多基因阈值模型的可预测结果
AI.research_question: 神经发育条件（如自闭症、多动症、阅读障碍）为何在所有人群中保持2-5%的稳定患病率，这与进化模型预测的消除具有适应成本的性状相矛盾
AI.motivation: 解决神经发育条件稳定患病率与进化理论预测之间的悖论，为神经多样性提供进化生物学解释
AI.theoretical_framework: 平衡选择理论、多基因阈值模型、邓巴数理论（小型群体规模约150人）、认知专业化理论
AI.method: 综合遗传学、进化生物学、人类学和残疾研究的证据进行理论框架构建
AI.findings: 神经多样性是进化策略，在祖先环境中提供适应优势，促进集体问题解决和适应性；2-5%患病率是多基因阈值模型的可预测结果
AI.theory_contributions: 提出神经多样性的进化框架，解决患病率稳定性悖论，将神经发育条件重新定义为认知专业化而非缺陷
AI.practical_contributions: 为创建更具包容性和创新性的教育、职业和治疗系统提供应用框架，与进化遗产保持一致

title: Flooding the Academic Zone with Shit? Academic Deepfakes and Climate Action in a Post-Truth Era
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Flooding the Academic Zone with Shit? Academic Deepfakes and Climate Action in a Post-Truth Era

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper enlightens an under-discussed risk associated with the use of AI in academia. By examining the recent publication of a pseudo-scientific academic article, co-authored by Grok 3 beta, which challenges the human origins of climate change, we introduce the concept of 'academic deepfake' and discuss its implications for academia. We show how academic deepfakes can be used as a tactic to manufacture doubt and "flood the academic zone with shit," with potentially dire societal consequences for academia and the legitimacy of science. While the academic world needs a coordinated response, we also point to the inherent risks and limits of available solutions (in particular the enforcement of boundaries and categories separating predatory journals from good science).

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析AI在学术界使用的风险，提出"学术深度假写"概念，讨论其如何被用作制造疑惑和污染学术领域的手段，以及对学术界和科学合法性的潜在威胁。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在学术界使用带来的深度假写风险是什么？它对学术界和科学合法性产生了哪些威胁？
AI.motivation: 识别和揭示AI在学术界使用中存在但很少被讨论的风险，特别是通过产生假学术文章来制造疑惑和污染学术领域的潜在危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术深度假写概念、科学社会学中的疑惑制造理论、学术质量控制理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过分析Grok 3 beta合作发表的伪科学文章来提出学术深度假写概念并讨论其影响。
AI.findings: 学术深度假写可以作为制造疑惑和"吐屎学术领域"的手段，对学术界和科学合法性造成严重威胁，而现有的解决方案（如区分谭鱼杂志与良好科学）存在内在风险和限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 创造性地提出了"学术深度假写"的概念，为理解AI在学术界造成的新型风险提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示学术界需要协调响应AI带来的深度假写风险，指出了现有解决方案的不足之处，为学术质量控制提供了实践意义。

title:
Brand Entropy
Why Good Brands Go Bad
affiliations: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM) and Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM)

detail.title:
Brand Entropy
Why Good Brands Go Bad
detail.abstract: When brands lose direction, they risk losing consumer trust and preference. This research shows how a breakdown in a brand's internal structure -what we call brand entropy- increases perceived risks and ultimately weakens brand preference. By combining theories of brand identity systems with ideas about organizational complexity, we aim to map the causal links between brand entropy and brand preference, highlighting risk perception as a key mediator. The research unites fragmented insights on how risk perception serves as a psychological barrier to forming brand preference. Using a Bayesian mediation model, we analyzed data from 615 brands across 17 product categories. The results show that higher brand entropy raises risk perception, which then dampens preference. About 55 % of the total effect of entropy on preference is explained by risk perception, while the remaining direct impact further erodes trust through cognitive dissonance and reduced brand resonance. This work introduces brand entropy as a dynamic concept and clarifies how risk perception mediates expectation disconfirmation theory. It connects theoretical frameworks -from attribution theory to cognitive dissonance- and underscores the practical challenges of maintaining global coherence. For managers, the findings suggest adopting centralized governance to avoid fragmented decision-making, implementing entropy-monitoring systems for early detection of inconsistencies, and communicating transparently about core values during disruptive periods (e.g., rapid expansion). Practitioners must balance innovation with strategic alignment, because even small spikes in entropy can trigger important losses in brand preference.

AI.tldr: 品牌熵（内部结构混乱）通过增加风险感知削弱品牌偏好，55%的影响由风险感知中介，其余直接影响通过认知失调降低信任。
AI.research_question: 品牌内部结构混乱（品牌熵）如何影响消费者品牌偏好，以及风险感知在其中扮演什么中介角色？
AI.motivation: 品牌失去方向会损害消费者信任和偏好，需要理解品牌内部结构混乱对消费者心理的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌身份系统理论、组织复杂性理论、归因理论、认知失调理论、期望确认理论
AI.method: 贝叶斯中介模型分析，涵盖17个产品类别615个品牌的数据
AI.findings: 品牌熵增加风险感知，进而降低品牌偏好；风险感知解释55%的总效应，其余直接影响通过认知失调和品牌共鸣减弱影响信任
AI.theory_contributions: 提出品牌熵作为动态概念，阐明风险感知在期望确认理论中的中介作用，连接多个理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用集中治理避免决策碎片化，实施熵监测系统及早发现不一致，在动荡时期透明沟通核心价值观，平衡创新与战略一致性

title: Fluid Models of Bilateral Matching Queues with Time-varying Arrivals
affiliations: Nanjing University, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) and Nanjing University - School of Management and Engineering

detail.title: Fluid Models of Bilateral Matching Queues with Time-varying Arrivals
detail.abstract: The double-ended matching queueing model has wide applicability across various real-life scenarios. In this paper, we analyze fluid models of bilateral matching queues with time-varying arrivals. The model contains fluid contents with general patience time distributions in a task queue and a worker queue, aiming to approximate the characteristics of bilateral queueing systems. We first prove the existence and uniqueness of the solution to the fluid model. When the arrival rates of both tasks and workers are constant, we determine the steady-state queue lengths and abandonment proportions for both sides of the queueing system. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the solution converges to an equilibrium state starting from any initial state. For situations involving time-varying arrival rates, satisfactory results from numerical experiments validate the reliability of the fluid model in describing the queueing system. Finally, we explore the matching problems within bilateral queuing systems and provide tailored solutions for various scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了具有时变到达的双边匹配排队流体模型，证明了流体模型解的存在唯一性，确定了稳态队列长度和放弃比例，验证了时变到达率下的模型可靠性，并为不同场景提供了匹配问题解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何建立和分析双边匹配排队系统的流体模型，特别是在时变到达率情况下？
AI.motivation: 双边匹配排队模型在现实生活中应用广泛，需要开发有效的分析方法来理解其特性和行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于排队论和流体极限理论，建立双边匹配排队系统的流体模型框架。
AI.method: 采用流体建模方法，分析具有一般耐心时间分布的任务队列和工作者队列，进行理论证明和数值实验验证。
AI.findings: 证明了流体模型解的存在唯一性；在恒定到达率下确定了稳态队列长度和放弃比例；验证了时变到达率下模型的可靠性；提供了不同场景的匹配解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了双边匹配排队系统的流体理论框架，为时变到达率的排队系统分析提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际双边匹配系统（如网约车、外卖配送等）的性能分析和优化提供了实用的建模工具和解决方案。

detail.abstract: The global market for satellite imagery dedicated to homeland security is undergoing significant expansion, driven by persistent geopolitical instability, climate-related disasters, and advancements in sensor technology [2]. Projections indicate a potential compound annual growth rate (CAGR) for the commercial imaging sector exceeding 18% by the early 2030s, signalling a dramatic increase in data availability [2]. However, this data proliferation creates a critical bottleneck between raw data acquisition and the delivery of actionable intelligence to operational end-users. This paper examines the emerging and essential role of specialised firms that provide end-to-end satellite data pipeline services, mitigating the complexities of data processing, analysis, and interpretation. Using Japan-based New Space Intelligence (NSI) as a case study, this analysis defines and explores how such services function as critical infrastructure in the modern geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) ecosystem [8]. Furthermore, the paper discusses the synergistic impact of SATCOM-enabled Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) on data collection, a development that intensifies the need for robust and efficient data pipelines to handle high-volume, real-time intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) data streams [1, 3]. It is argued that these specialised pipeline services are the primary enablers for unlocking the full operational value of Earth observation assets for national security.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了卫星数据管道服务在国土安全领域的关键作用，分析了日本New Space Intelligence公司如何通过端到端服务解决海量卫星数据处理瓶颈，并讨论了无人机与卫星通信结合对实时情报处理的新需求。
AI.research_question: 专业卫星数据管道服务如何在现代地理空间情报生态系统中发挥关键基础设施作用？
AI.motivation: 全球卫星影像市场快速增长导致原始数据获取与可操作情报交付之间存在关键瓶颈，需要专门的服务来解决数据处理、分析和解释的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理空间情报(GEOINT)生态系统理论、数据管道服务理论、关键基础设施理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以日本New Space Intelligence公司为研究对象
AI.findings: 专业卫星数据管道服务是现代GEOINT生态系统的关键基础设施，能够有效解决海量数据处理瓶颈，特别是随着SATCOM无人机的发展，对高效实时ISR数据处理管道的需求更加迫切。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了卫星数据管道服务作为关键基础设施的理论框架，丰富了GEOINT生态系统理论，为理解现代地理空间情报价值链提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国土安全机构提供了选择和应用卫星数据管道服务的实践指导，帮助企业识别在快速增长的市场中的商业机会，并为技术开发者指明了系统架构设计方向。

title: Forecasting Intermittent Demand using Large Language Models: Evidence from a Real World Industrial Dataset
affiliations: University of Piraeus, Hellenic Open University, Hellenic Open University and University of Piraeus

detail.title: Forecasting Intermittent Demand using Large Language Models: Evidence from a Real World Industrial Dataset

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not report studies with human participants or animals. Ethics approval and consent to participate is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no funding.

detail.abstract: Intermittent demand data, characterized by frequent zero values and unusual patterns, pose a distinct challenge for conventional and even advanced forecasting approaches. This paper introduces a novel framework that repurposes a lightweight GPT-2 model for forecasting in inventory-related settings, where demand signals are of an intermittent nature. The approach eliminates tokenisation by mapping raw numerical values directly into the Large Language Model (LLM) latent space and augments the decoder with an optional zero-inflated head to handle the high frequency of zero sales data. Experiments on three real-world Stock Keeping Units and four forecast horizons benchmark the proposed model against seven classical and machine learning (ML) baselines. The LLM reduces the Root Mean Squared Scaled Error by up to 27% compared to the best competing method in both short (7-day) and long (42 / 49-day) windows while remaining competitive in intermediate horizons. Complementary error metrics corroborate these gains. A preliminary pattern-recognition study links higher LLM improvements with greater intermittency and stronger chaotic signatures (mean Lyapunov exponent). These results establish that a properly fine-tuned, decoder-only LLM can serve as an accurate and adaptable forecaster in forecasting scenarios previously dominated by both classical intermittent-demand models and modern ML approaches such as LSTMs and gradient-boosted trees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于轻量级GPT-2模型的新框架，用于处理间歇性需求预测问题。该方法通过将原始数值直接映射到LLM潜在空间，并添加零膨胀头来处理高频零值数据。实验表明，该模型在多个预测窗口上相比传统方法将RMSSE降低了最多27%。
AI.research_question: 如何有效利用大型语言模型（LLM）来处理间歇性需求预测问题？
AI.motivation: 间歇性需求数据（频繁出现零值和不寻常模式）对传统和先进的预测方法都构成了独特挑战，需要新的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer架构的解码器语言模型（GPT-2），结合零膨胀分布理论来处理高频零值数据。
AI.method: 将原始数值直接映射到LLM潜在空间，避免分词过程；在解码器中添加可选的零膨胀头；在三个真实SKU和四个预测窗口上进行实验，与七种基准方法对比。
AI.findings: LLM模型在短期（7天）和长期（42/49天）窗口上将RMSSE降低了最多27%；模型改进程度与间歇性程度和混沌特征（平均Lyapunov指数）正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了经过适当微调的仅解码器LLM可以作为准确且适应性强的预测器，在间歇性需求预测场景中超越传统方法和现代ML方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为库存管理中的间歇性需求预测提供了新的有效解决方案，能够显著提升预测精度，特别是在高度间歇性和混沌性需求场景中。

detail.abstract: This article discusses the foundations of arbitration in Belgium, including topics such as the arbitration market, the arbitration community, arbitration practice, and arbitration institutions.  The interviews on which this article is based were performed as part of a research project funded by the United Kingdom’s Economic and Social Research Council.  Interviews were performed in 47 countries, including 127 cities and 1,086 interviewees.  Further information on the project is available on the project website (https://commercialarbitrationineurope.wordpress.com).  9 interviews were performed in Belgium, involving 21 participants, with 8 interviews performed in Brussels on 18-19 October 2023, and 1 interview performed in Antwerp on 20 October 2023.  All interviews were performed by the author.  Interviews were recorded and then professionally transcribed.

title: The Fortunate Demise of SEC Staff Legal Bulletin No. 14L
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: The Fortunate Demise of SEC Staff Legal Bulletin No. 14L
detail.abstract: In 2021, the SEC published its now rescinded Staff Legal Bulletin No. 14L (“the 2021 Bulletin”), revising its interpretations of the “ordinary business” and “economic relevance” exclusions under Rule 14a-8. This Article contends that the post-Bulletin landscape has proven undesirable. It empirically shows that environmental and social (“E & S”) shareholder proposals — including anti-E&S proposals — surged in response. Between 2022 and 2024 alone, E & S proposals accounted for 40% of all such filings in Russell 3000 companies over the entire 2014-2024 period, generating an estimated $23.3 million in additional processing costs for companies during that three-year window. Despite their volume, these proposals were largely unpopular among shareholders. The Article argues that rescinding the 2021 Bulletin was a necessary corrective — but not a sufficient safeguard. Although non-binding, SEC Bulletins exert significant influence on market behavior. Decisions about whether to facilitate or constrain the submission of E & S proposals, however, should not rest with the SEC staff discretion, particularly when such interpretative shifts are achieved through non-binding acts and carry large systemic consequences. Simply rescinding the 2021 Bulletin leaves open the possibility of future reversals, and is, therefore, insufficient to prevent future overuse of Rule 14a-8. To provide more durable protection, this Article proposes giving shareholders greater control over E & S resolutions — either by voting on whether such proposals should be solicited, or by allowing companies to adopt anti-E&S bylaw provisions. These mechanisms would preserve shareholder choice while reducing the costs and uncertainty generated by staff-driven interpretative changes.

AI.tldr: SEC 2021年发布的14L公告导致环境和社会股东提案激增，虽然该公告已被撤销，但仅撤销不足以防止未来滥用。文章建议通过股东投票或允许公司采用反E&S章程条款来提供更持久的保护。
AI.research_question: SEC 2021年14L公告对股东提案规则的影响是什么？如何建立更有效的保护机制来防止环境和社会提案的过度使用？
AI.motivation: SEC通过非约束性公告改变对Rule 14a-8的解释，导致环境和社会股东提案激增，给公司带来巨大处理成本，但提案在股东中并不受欢迎，需要建立更稳定的制度框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论和股东提案权理论，分析SEC监管公告对市场行为的影响，以及如何平衡股东民主与公司运营效率。
AI.method: 实证分析2014-2024年间Russell 3000公司的股东提案数据，特别关注2022-2024年E&S提案的数量、成本和股东支持率变化。
AI.findings: 2022-2024年E&S提案占2014-2024年总提案的40%，给公司带来2330万美元额外处理成本，但这些提案在股东中普遍不受欢迎。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非约束性监管公告对市场行为的重大影响，提出了股东提案权制度设计中民主与效率平衡的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两种具体解决方案：让股东投票决定是否征集E&S提案，或允许公司采用反E&S章程条款，为监管实践提供可操作的建议。

title: The Business Case for Human-Centric Organizing: Implications for Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption
affiliations: INSEAD

detail.title: The Business Case for Human-Centric Organizing: Implications for Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption

publicationDetails.journalName: INSEAD Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: A goal-centric perspective evaluates organizations by their effectiveness in achieving objectives , whereas a human-centric perspective evaluates them by the desirability of membership for their members. Building on extensive evidence that individuals systematically value non-monetary benefits from organizational membership-such as experienced autonomy, competence, and relatedness-I introduce the concept of Preferences for Organizational Contexts (POCs) to formalize how these benefits shape membership choices alongside monetary compensation. Regardless of how these benefits are weighted individually or in combination with each other and with pay, from the employer's viewpoint, declines in em-ployee's POC satisfaction must be offset by some mix of higher wages, greater supervision costs, or lowered expectations of discretionary effort. This demonstrates that human-centricity has economic as well as moral significance. I apply the framework to the case of Artificial Intelligence (AI), showing how its adoption can either erode or enhance human-centricity depending on how its deployment shapes organizational contexts. Because human capital is likely to remain indispensable despite algorithmic advances, the theory of human-centric organizing developed here provides both an analytic and practical tool for evaluating organizational designs, and a guide for ensuring that technology adoption strengthens rather than undermines organizations as natural habitats for humans.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了组织情境偏好（POCs）概念，从经济角度分析非货币福利对组织成员选择的影响，并将该框架应用于AI技术，探讨如何通过组织设计保持人本中心性。
AI.research_question: 如何从经济角度形式化非货币福利对组织成员选择的影响，以及AI技术采纳如何影响组织的人本中心性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要从目标中心视角评估组织效能，缺乏对人本中心视角的经济学分析，特别是非货币福利对成员选择的经济意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自我决定理论（自主性、能力感、关联性），结合组织经济学，构建组织情境偏好（POCs）理论框架。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，通过逻辑推理建立POCs与经济补偿的权衡关系，并将框架应用于AI技术情境分析。
AI.findings: 员工POCs满意度下降必须通过更高工资、更多监督成本或降低期望 discretionary effort 来补偿；AI采纳可能侵蚀或增强人本中心性，取决于部署方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将人本中心视角经济学化，提出POCs概念，为组织设计评估提供分析工具，拓展了组织经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计和技术采纳提供实践指导，帮助确保技术应用强化而非削弱组织作为人类自然栖息地的功能。

detail.abstract: This study examined the impact of Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS) on financial accountability in Bushenyi District Local Government, Uganda, addressing challenges in ensuring financial accountability critical for effective public resource management. Anchored on stewardship theory, the study employed a quantitative approach with correlational and descriptive research designs, involving 124 respondents from 180 local government officials. Data were gathered through self-administered and researcher-administered questionnaires and analyzed using SPSS version 27 with multiple linear regression analysis. The findings revealed that financial planning had an insignificant relationship with financial accountability, while financial reporting had a positive but statistically insignificant relationship, and internal controls had a significant positive impact. The study highlights the positive impact of IFMIS on financial accountability and recommends simplifying financial planning, streamlining financial reporting systems, strengthening internal control mechanisms, and providing targeted training programs. This research contributes to academia by providing insights into IFMIS effectiveness, offers recommendations for the Auditor General, and provides actionable outcomes for Bushenyi District Local Government to enhance financial accountability and transparency. The study's findings have practical implications for improving financial management practices, addressing a knowledge gap in existing literature, and informing policy decisions for effective public resource management.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了乌干达Bushenyi地区地方政府中综合财务管理信息系统(IFMIS)对财务问责制的影响，发现内部控制有显著正向影响，而财务规划和财务报告的影响不显著。
AI.research_question: 综合财务管理信息系统(IFMIS)对Bushenyi地区地方政府财务问责制的影响是什么？

AI.findings: 财务规划与财务问责制关系不显著；财务报告有正向但不显著的关系；内部控制有显著正向影响
AI.theory_contributions: 为学术界提供关于IFMIS有效性的见解，填补现有文献的知识空白
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计长提供建议，为Bushenyi地区地方政府提供可操作的改进措施，改善财务管理实践，为政策决策提供信息

title: A Systemic Problem of Economic National Sovereignty : High Incidence of Stock Market De-Listing and Irrelevance of Small/Medium Enterprises Listed on the Milan and other Stock Exchanges
